title: Postdoc in Dynamic Modelling, Simulation and Optimization of Power-to-X Processes
description:
At the Faculty of Engineering and Science, AAU Energy, a 24-month postdoctoral position in Dynamic Modelling, Simulation and Optimization of Power-to-X Processes is available from 1 January 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter. The project is primarily rooted in process engineering while also addressing interactions between Power-to-X plants and the electrical grid.

Your work tasksYou will develop and apply dynamic process models based on mass and energy balances, thermodynamics, reaction kinetics, and equipment behaviour to simulate integrated Power-to-X plants under changing operating conditions. The work will address renewable fuel production, particularly green methanol and sustainable aviation fuels through methanol-based and Fischer–Tropsch pathways. The work will focus on electrolysers, fuel-synthesis processes, energy storage, heat integration, and interactions with the electrical grid.

You will combine process simulation with operational optimization, process control, techno-economic assessment, and model validation to investigate flexible operation under varying renewable electricity generation and energy prices.

You will collaborate with academic and industrial partners, publish scientific results, contribute to project meetings and deliverables, and present findings at conferences and workshops. The position may also include limited teaching and supervision of bachelor’s and master’s students.

Your competenciesYou hold a PhD in chemical engineering, process engineering, or a closely related field, completed by the application deadline. You have documented research experience in process modelling and simulation, preferably including dynamic modelling of chemical or energy processes.

Hands-on experience with Aspen Plus, Aspen HYSYS, or Aspen Dynamics will be considered a strong advantage. Experience with gPROMS, Modelica, or comparable process-simulation tools is also relevant. Strong skills in MATLAB, Python, or a similar computational environment are expected.

Experience with Power-to-X, renewable fuels, optimization, process control, model validation, techno-economic assessment, or grid-integrated energy systems will strengthen your profile.

You will work closely with industrial and international partners. Therefore, the ability to translate research into practical solutions and communicate effectively across disciplines is essential. We value candidates who are proactive, structured, collaborative, and motivated to publish high-quality research and contribute actively to project activities.

Who we areYou will join the Fluid & Process research group at AAU Energy, Campus Esbjerg, where you will become part of an international and interdisciplinary research environment combining process, chemical, energy and electrical engineering. The group works with modelling, simulation, control, optimization and experimental validation of fluid and energy systems, with applications including Power-to-X, carbon capture and utilization, green fuels and sector coupling. The working culture is collaborative and informal, with close interaction among academic staff, postdoctoral researchers, PhD fellows and students. We share an ambition to contribute to the green transition through research with practical relevance. We offer laboratory and workshop facilities, and a collaborative environment that supports innovation, knowledge sharing, and professional development.

Learn more about AAU Energy at www.energy.aau.dk

Qualification requirements Appointment as postdoc requires academic qualifications at PhD level.

How to apply  Your application must include the following: 

  • Application, stating reasons for applying, qualifications in relation to the position, and intentions and visions for the position 
  • Curriculum Vitae (CV) 
  • Diplomas (master's degree diploma and PhD diploma) 
  • List of publications, with an indication of the attached publications that you wish to be taken into account in the assessment. You may attach a maximum of five publications. You must submit a co-author statement, see template for co-author statement 
  • Documentation of teaching qualifications if relevant.
  • Dissemination qualifications, including participation on committees or boards, participation in organisations etc. 
  • Additional qualifications in relation to the position 
  • References/recommendations 

You can read more about the requirements for your application here.    

The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website.  

Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position. 

Aalborg University has a policy of parallel language use. International staff are encouraged, with support from the university, to learn Danish during their employment in order to support their integration into the workplace and Danish society. 

Danish language courses will be offered as part of the employment. 

Do you have any questions? If you have any questions about the position, you are more than welcome to contact us. You will find contact persons at the bottom of the jobpost.     

Further information Read more about our recruitment process here   

The appointment process at Aalborg University involves a shortlisting process. You can read more about the shortlisting and appointment process here.  

The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace. 

Salary and terms of employment  The employment is in accordance with the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities and the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities. Furthermore, your terms of employment and salary are in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations and the state (AC collective agreement) and protocol on certain terms of employment of academic staff at universities.

You can find information about the salary and salary structure for the position in the Salary Overview for Recruitment - Scientific positions (VIP). Please refer to the introductory section of the page and the section entitled “Postdoc”.

There is a mutual probationary period of 3 months for the position.

Aalborg University - Knowledge for the worldAalborg University is an international workplace with more than 3,700 employees. We offer real-world-oriented education and create world-class research results through collaboration between researchers, students, and public and private companies. This is how we achieve insights, new solutions to societal problems, and knowledge that changes the world. Our main campus is in Aalborg, but we also have campuses in Esbjerg and Copenhagen.

title: One or more PhD Stipends in Direct Air Capture Technologies
description:
The future of climate action extends beyond reducing emissionsAtmospheric CO2 concentrations continue to rise despite global efforts to reduce emissions. Achieving climate neutrality will therefore require not only deep emission reductions but also large-scale carbon removal solutions. Direct Air Capture (DAC) is one of the few technologies capable of permanently removing CO2 directly from the atmosphere, but significant scientific and engineering challenges remain before DAC can be deployed at gigaton scale. Future DAC systems must be energy-efficient, economically viable, and designed around a fundamental understanding of how materials, processes, and system integration interact.

At Aalborg University, we are seeking ambitious PhD candidates who want to help develop the next generation of DAC technologies through advanced process modelling, experimental studies, and techno-economic evaluations.

The stipend is open for appointment from 1 January 2027 or soon hereafter. The duration of the position is three years.

In the future, removing CO2 from the atmosphere will become an essential part of climate action.Atmospheric CO2 is already changing the climate. Reducing emissions is essential, but it may not be enough. We must also learn how to remove carbon already present in the atmosphere. Future Direct Air Capture systems will not simply capture CO2:

They will integrate with renewable energy systems. They will operate flexibly and balance the energy systems. They will become scalable climate infrastructure.

What this PhD is really aboutThe stipends are designed to contribute to two ambitious research initiatives that aim to accelerate the development of Direct Air Capture technologies:

Development of process-aware methodologies for evaluating emerging DAC liquid and solid sorbents and technologies. Development of predictive frameworks linking sorbent properties to process-level DAC performance.

Together, these efforts seek to establish the scientific foundations required to move DAC development from empirical trial-and-error toward predictive, data-driven design and scale-up.

The research environment and culture you will step intoYou will join CarbonLab at Aalborg University, a growing research environment dedicated to carbon capture, carbon removal, and climate-positive technologies. We are a group of approximately 20 people currently represented by 7 different nationalities. Our research combines laboratory experiments, process modelling, experimental validation, techno-economic and LCA assessments, and system integration to accelerate the deployment of DAC solutions at scale.

At CarbonLab, we are building more than technologies; we are building a research community. Our researchers share ideas openly, collaborate across disciplines, and celebrate each other's successes. PhD students are treated as colleagues, encouraged to develop their own scientific identity, and supported in taking initiative from the very beginning. Whether presenting at international conferences, contributing to teaching, leading collaborations, or exploring new research directions, you will be part of a culture that combines scientific ambition with mutual trust and genuine support. We believe that excellent research and an excellent research environment go hand in hand.

Your research qualificationsWe are looking for highly motivated candidates who are passionate about addressing climate change through scientific research and technological innovation. The ideal candidate has a strong analytical mindset, enjoys solving complex engineering challenges, and is eager to contribute to the development of next-generation carbon removal technologies.

You should hold a master's degree (or be close to completion) in Chemical Engineering, Process Engineering, Energy Engineering, Chemistry, Physics, or a related discipline.

Experience in one or more of the following areas will be considered an advantage:

Direct Air Capture, carbon capture, or carbon removal technologies Chemical process engineering and process intensification Mass transfer, reaction engineering, and thermodynamics Experimental design and laboratory testing Spectroscopy and related analytical techniques such as Nuclear Magnetic Resonance (NMR). Measurement and interpretation of gas-liquid and gas-solid equilibrium data and breakthrough experiments. Process modelling and simulation (e.g., Aspen Plus, MATLAB, Python, or similar tools) Data analysis, optimization, and uncertainty assessment Techno-economic analysis and sustainability assessment Energy systems integration and renewable energy technologies

In addition, we value candidates who:

Demonstrate scientific curiosity and creativity Take initiative and ownership of their research Enjoy working both independently and collaboratively Communicate scientific results effectively in written and spoken English Thrive in an interdisciplinary and international research environment Are motivated to contribute to solutions with real-world climate impact

Previous research experience through master's projects, internships, conference contributions, or scientific publications is considered an advantage but is not a formal requirement.Qualification requirementsPhD stipends are allocated to individuals who hold a Master's degree. PhD stipends are normally for a period of 3 years. It is a prerequisite for allocation of the stipend that the candidate will be enrolled as a PhD student at the Doctoral School of Engineering and Science in accordance with the regulations of Ministerial Order No. 872 of 6 October 2026 on the PhD Programme at the Universities and Certain Higher Artistic Educational Institutions. According to the Ministerial Order, the progress of the PhD student shall be assessed at regular points in time. As part of the PhD study, you are among other things required to complete PhD courses corresponding to 30 ECTS, gain experience with teaching or other forms of knowledge dissemination and complete an external research stay outside of Aalborg University, preferably 3-6 months at a foreign research institution.

Who we are    AAU Energy is a research department at Aalborg University dedicated to the development of clean and sustainable energy systems. Our activities cover electrical, thermal and mechatronic energy technologies, and we work closely with industrial partners and other academic environments to address real-world energy challenges. The department is located in both Aalborg and Esbjerg, and this position is based at the Aalborg campus. AAU Energy employs around 250 staff members at different career stages and from a broad range of national backgrounds. This creates an international and interdisciplinary research environment with many opportunities for collaboration and knowledge sharing. English is widely used as the working language in research and teaching, which makes it straightforward for international colleagues to integrate. We offer access to advanced laboratories and workshop facilities and an environment where you can develop your academic profile through research, teaching and collaboration with both Danish and international partners. As a workplace we value a collegial and inclusive culture with room for professional discussion, initiative and mutual support in everyday life. New colleagues, whether they come from elsewhere in Denmark or from abroad, can draw on the university’s support services related to relocation, housing and practical matters. You can read more about AAU Energy at www.energy.aau.dk

How to applyYour application must include the following:

  • Application, stating reasons for applying and qualifications in relation to the position
  • Curriculum Vitae (CV)
  • Diplomas (bachelor's and master's degree diploma, including grades) 
  • Project description (2-5 pages), that describes the applicant’s initial thoughts and ideas related to the specific project applied for. This includes a brief state-of-the-art (including short list of references), a time schedule and how the applicant intends to shed light on the project objectives.

The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website.

The assessment of candidates for the position will be carried out by qualified experts.Shortlisting will be applied. This means that after the application deadline, the head of the department, with the assistance of the hiring committee, will select the applicants to be assessed. All applicants will be informed whether they have been shortlisted for assessment or not.

title: 1.assistent til rengøringsteam SMP - Nordjylland
description:
Vi søger en erfaren 1.assistent til vores rengørings-team i Nordjylland.

Er du serviceminded og kan lide et job med meget kørsel?

SMP Rengøringsservice er i rivende udvikling og søger derfor en erfaren medarbejder på fuldtid (37t), til vores i forvejen stærke team i Nordjylland.

Som 1.assistent er dit ansvar at sikre afviklingen af den daglige rengøring i samarbejde med din Serviceinspektør.

Andre opgaver kan også forekomme.

Du vil have direkte reference til din Serviceinspektør hos SMP rengøringsservice. Jobbet indebærer b.la. følgende arbejdsområder:

•   Skal stå for rengøring af egne pladser og øvrig bemanding iht. rengøringskalenderen

•   Skabe god relation til kunderne

•   Være behjælpelig med afløsning ved. ferie/sygdom

•   Hjælpe ved opstart af nye kunder og opgaver sammen med Serviceinspektør

•   Forefaldne opgaver i samarbejde med din Serviceinspektør

 

Det skal forventes, at timer kan ligge både tidlig morgen, eftermiddag og aften.

 

Hvem er du?

Vi søger dig, som trives i en omskiftelig hverdag, hvor opgaverne og dagene aldrig er ens.

Det er ikke vigtigt for dig, at du har faste rammer mandag-fredag fra 8-16, men tværtimod trives du med en flydende hverdag, hvor arbejdsugen kan variere med forskellige tidspunkter på dagen.

Som person kan du nikke genkendende til, at du:

•   Har erfaring med erhvervsrengøring

•   Trives i en til tider hektisk hverdag

•   Står til rådighed for rengøring af egne pladser

•   deler telefonvagt efter forudgående aftale

     står for sidemandsoplæring af rengøringspersonale

•   Er humoristisk anlagt og kan håndtere og omgås forskellige kulturer

•   Behersker dansk og engelsk i skrift og tale på et rimeligt niveau

•   Har kørekort

•   Kan fremvise straffeattest

Du får stillet en firmabil til rådighed, samt firmatelefon- iPad, og arbejdsbeklædning.

Vi glæder os meget til at lære dig at kende - så hvis du kan se dig selv i denne stilling, bedes du sende din ansøgning til: job@smpservice.dk  - husk at mærke ansøgningen ” 1.assistent Nordjylland”

 

Samtaler bliver holdt løbende.

 

Har du ikke hørt fra os inden den 20.11.2026, skal du betragte jobbet som besat til anden side.

 

SMP er en velrenommeret virksomhed i rengøringsbranchen, - og det vil vi gerne blive ved med at være

Vi beskæftiger i dag mere end 300 medarbejdere med kunder i en stor del af Danmark. Vi har landsdækkende og lokale aftaler inden for kontor, produktion, skoler, slagterier, bagerier, butikker, supermarkeder mv.

 

SMP har lokale afdelinger både på Fyn, Jylland og Sjælland

title: Arbejd med fødevaresikkerhed: Bliv tilsynstekniker i Kødkontrollen ved Tican i Brørup
description:
Vil du være med til at højne fødevaresikkerheden i Danmark, så er der mulighed for at blive en del af et fagligt dygtigt team ved Fødevarestyrelsens Kødkontrol ved Tican Fresh Meat A/S i Brørup. Om jobbet Som tilsynstekniker er din primære opgave post mortem-kontrol af slagtesvin. Kontrollen foregår som båndkontrol, hvor der i øjeblikket slagtes på én linje med en hastighed af 760 enheder i timen på både daghold og aftenhold. Foruden din primære opgave, vil du også kunne beskæftige dig med;
  • Andre tilsynsopgaver og prøveudtagning.
  • Diverse praktiske opgaver, som hører med til afdelingens dagligdag.
  • Deltagelse i afdelingsmøder, teammøder og interne kurser.
Om dig Vi leder efter dig, der er uddannet tilsynstekniker og som befinder sig godt i rollen som myndighedsperson. Vi ønsker os tilmed en kollega, som bidrager med godt humør, er fleksibel, hjælpsom og har gode samarbejdsevner. Vi lægger vægt på, at du;
  • Er fagligt interesseret og omhyggelig i dit arbejde
  • Er indstillet på at kompetenceudvikle dig, når der sker ændringer i regler og procedurer
  • Er klar til at give og modtage konstruktiv feedback, så vi sammen kan nå vores mål om at udvikle den bedste kødkontrol
  • Kan kommunikere på dansk
  • Har grundlæggende IT-kundskaber
Om os Styrelsen for Fødevarer, Landbrug og Fiskeri er en statslig organisation med stor samfundsmæssig betydning. Vi arbejder for, at fødevarer er sikre, og at dyr behandles forsvarligt. Kødkontrollen kontrollerer alle slagtedyr på danske slagterier og har fokus på smitsomme sygdomme, dyrevelfærd og fødevaresikkerhed. I vores sektion er vi ca. 48 medarbejdere – vi er dyrlæger, tilsynsteknikere, administrativt personale, elever, timelønnede og 1 sektionsleder. Vi spænder bredt i aldersfordeling og erfaringsgrundlag, og vi ser det som en styrke at få vores forskellige kompetencer i spil, så vi i fællesskab kan løse kerneopgaven. Vi har et kontinuerligt fokus på at optimere kvaliteten af kontrollen samtidig med, at vi er tilpasningsklar som følge af, at vi er en politisk styret organisation. Det praktiske Der er tale om faste fuldtidsstillinger på 37 timer ugentligt med tiltrædelse snarest muligt. Ansættelsesområdet er Fødevarestyrelsen. Tjenestestedet er Kødkontrollen ved Tican Fresh Meat A/S i Brørup, Markedsvej 9, 6650 Brørup. Virksomheden slagter både dag og aften og arbejdstiden i Kødkontrollen er derfor på daghold fra kl. 6.00 til kl. 14.00 mens arbejdstiden på aftenholdet er fra kl. 14.00 til kl. 21.15. Vi roterer mellem dag- og aftenhold, således at man hver anden uge arbejder aftenhold og tilsvarende hver anden uge arbejder daghold. Ansættelsen sker efter gældende Fællesoverenskomst mellem Finansministeriet og Offentligt Ansattes Organisationer samt organisationsaftale for tilsynsfunktionærer ved eksportautoriserede slagterier. Til tilsynsfunktionærer, der har gennemført uddannelsen som tilsynstekniker, gives et pensionsgivende teknikertillæg på 3.948 kr. pr. måned. Herudover indplaceres tilsynsteknikere på en basisløn på enten 27.972 kr. pr. måned (1. og 2. år) eller 28.389 kr. pr. måned (3. og følgende år). Herudover vil det være muligt at forhandle et kvalifikationstillæg alt efter den enkeltes kvalifikationer i relation til stillingen. Pensionsbidraget for tilsynsfunktionærer udgør 13,68 %. Sådan kontakter du os og søger stillingen Vi glæder os til at modtage din motiverede ansøgning, CV, kopi af eksamensbevis og eventuelle andre relevante bilag senest den 23. november 2026. Du søger stillingen ved at sende en mail til kkhr@fvst.dk med emnefeltet: ”Ansøgning til stillingen som tilsynstekniker i Brørup”. Du opfordres til at læse mere om Fødevarestyrelsen på www.fvst.dk. Fødevarestyrelsen betragter mangfoldighed som et aktiv og opfordrer alle uanset baggrund til at søge.

Factspilot.com – European Media Network

MinBy™ | Denmark

Journalism · Fact-checking · Artificial Intelligence · European Cooperation

WORK WITH US FROM YOUR OWN EU COUNTRY

Are you an experienced journalist, freelance journalist or media project manager living in an EU country outside Denmark?Do you have professional knowledge of your national media industry, established contacts and an interest in international journalism?

We would like to hear from you.MinBy™ is seeking experienced and independent media professionals to help establish and develop Factspilot.com, an international media and technology initiative.Our ambition is to build a European network of locally based journalists, media professionals and project coordinators working together across national borders.We are particularly interested in candidates who already understand their own country's media landscape and can contribute from the beginning.You will work from your own country. Relocation to Denmark is not required.

ABOUT FACTSPILOT.COMFactspilot.com is an international initiative developed by MinBy™, a Danish digital media network comprising 1,522 ultra-local media outlets across Denmark's 98 municipalities, alongside a portfolio of specialised digital magazine concepts.

Factspilot aims to develop a scalable European media infrastructure combining:

  • Independent journalism and news production.

  • Fact-checking, source verification and documentation.

  • Artificial intelligence and editorial technology.

  • Automated translation and multilingual publishing.

  • International news collection and distribution.

  • Cooperation between journalists and media organisations across Europe.

Our ambition is to connect national and local journalistic expertise with a shared international platform.

WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR?

We are recruiting candidates with experience in one or more of the following areas.

1. FREELANCE JOURNALISTS / MEDIA PARTNERS

We are looking for experienced freelance journalists interested in contributing to Factspilot's development in their own countries.

Your potential responsibilities include:

  • Researching and producing journalistic content.

  • Identifying reliable national and regional news sources.

  • Conducting fact-checking and source verification.

  • Establishing relationships with local journalists, editors and newsrooms.

  • Contributing to cross-border journalism and multilingual publishing.

  • Helping develop Factspilot's national media network.

You may already be working independently, seeking new assignments or interested in becoming part of a larger international media initiative.

You do not need to own a company to apply.

2. JOURNALISTS / EDITORS / MEDIA PROFESSIONALS

We are seeking journalists and media professionals with practical experience and strong knowledge of their national media environment.

Relevant backgrounds include:

  • Journalism and editorial production.

  • Investigative journalism and research.

  • Fact-checking and verification.

  • Digital publishing and news distribution.

  • Editorial coordination and media development.

We particularly value candidates who understand their country's media structures, professional standards and relevant sources.

3. MEDIA PROJECT MANAGERS / NATIONAL COORDINATORS

We are also seeking experienced project managers who can contribute to establishing and coordinating Factspilot's activities in their own countries.

Your potential responsibilities include:

  • Identifying relevant journalists and media contacts.

  • Building national professional networks.

  • Developing international cooperation opportunities.

  • Coordinating local project activities.

  • Contributing to project planning, budgets and implementation.

  • Supporting European partnerships and potential funding applications.

Experience with international media projects, European cooperation or EU funding programmes is an advantage.

YOUR LOCAL EXPERIENCE IS OUR PRIORITY

We are particularly interested in applicants who:

  • Live in an EU Member State outside Denmark.

  • Have professional experience in journalism, media or project management.

  • Understand their national media industry.

  • Have relevant professional contacts and relationships.

  • Speak and write the language of their country fluently.

  • Can communicate professionally in English.

  • Work independently and take responsibility for results.

  • Are comfortable using modern digital tools and AI-supported workflows.

  • Are interested in international cooperation and long-term project development.

An established professional network and practical experience may be more important than formal qualifications.

EUROPEAN PROJECT DEVELOPMENT

Factspilot is exploring opportunities for international project financing, including the European Union's Creative Europe – Journalism Partnerships programme.

Selected candidates may contribute to the development of European cooperation projects, including the identification of national partners, editorial activities and project coordination.

Experience with EU programmes or international project funding is particularly relevant for project management candidates, but is not required for journalists.

WHAT WE OFFER

We offer the opportunity to participate in the development of an ambitious international media initiative from an early stage.

Depending on your professional background and the project's development, opportunities may include:

  • Journalism and editorial assignments.

  • Fact-checking and research activities.

  • National media coordination.

  • International project development.

  • Participation in European media cooperation.

  • Longer-term professional collaboration.

You will have the opportunity to contribute your existing expertise while working from your own country.

WORK LOCATION AND EMPLOYMENT CONDITIONS

Location: Your country of residence within the European Union, excluding Denmark.Work arrangement: Remote, with activities carried out locally in your own country.Professional profiles: Journalists, freelance journalists, editors, media professionals and project managers.Employment and cooperation: Depending on the role, opportunities may include employment or paid freelance and project-based assignments.

Working hours, responsibilities, remuneration and contractual terms will be agreed individually before any engagement begins.

Factspilot is currently in a development phase. The availability and commencement of specific assignments depend on project progress and financing.

Applicants may be unemployed, employed or self-employed. A registered company is not required.

APPLICATION AND SELECTION

We are interested in your professional experience, local knowledge, independence and ability to contribute to Factspilot's development.

Please include the following information in your application:

  1. Country of residence – Where do you currently live and work?

  2. Professional profile – Journalist, freelance journalist, media professional or project manager?

  3. Experience – What is your relevant professional background?

  4. Local knowledge – What experience and contacts do you have within your country's media industry?

  5. Contribution – How could you help develop Factspilot in your country?

  6. International experience – Have you previously worked on international or EU-funded projects?

Please include your CV and, where relevant, links to published work, previous projects or professional references.

Selected applicants may be invited to complete a voluntary practical assignment designed to demonstrate relevant skills, independent thinking and professional initiative.

HOW TO APPLY

Applications must be submitted through MinBy™'s digital recruitment system.

Apply here:

https://minbymedie.dk/ansogning-formular/

We welcome applications from qualified candidates throughout the 26 EU Member States outside Denmark.

FACTSPILOT.COM

Local Knowledge. European Cooperation. International Reach.

An international media initiative developed by MinBy™ – Denmark.

Factspilot: https://factspilot.com

MinBy™: https://minbymedie.dk

Location: Copenhagen, Denmark

Working hours: 11:00 PM – 6:00 AM (23:00–06:00)

  • Supportive and helpful colleagues.

Would you like to become part of the CityRenhold ApS team?

We would be happy to hear from you!

henrik@cityrenhold.dk

We will conduct interviews on an ongoing basis and hire as soon as we find the right candidates.

We look forward to receiving your application!

CityRenhold ApS

Professional Cleaning – Quality, Responsibility and Service.

title: WE ARE HIRING – CLEANING SUPERVISOR
description:
WE ARE HIRING – CLEANING SUPERVISOR

Join the REMA GROUP Team!

Location: Copenhagen & Greater Copenhagen

Are you our new Cleaning Supervisor?

At REMA GROUP, we believe that professional cleaning is about much more than just clean surroundings. It's about people, responsibility, trust, and delivering quality that our clients can rely on every single day.

We take pride in our work, our employees, and the long-term relationships we build with our clients.

As we continue to develop our business, we are looking for an experienced, dedicated, and hands-on Cleaning Supervisor who shares our values and wants to become an important part of the REMA GROUP team.

We are looking for someone who doesn't just supervise cleaning operations, but takes ownership, leads by example, and understands that excellent service starts with motivated employees and attention to detail.

Does that sound like you? Then we would love to hear from you!

YOUR ROLE AT REMA GROUP

As our new Cleaning Supervisor, you will have an important role in ensuring that our daily cleaning operations run smoothly and that our clients consistently receive the high standards they expect from REMA GROUP.

You will be the link between our cleaning teams, our clients, and our management.

Your role will involve both practical supervision and daily coordination, and we expect you to be visible, approachable, and actively involved in maintaining our quality standards.

Your main responsibilities will include:

  • Planning, coordinating, and supervising daily cleaning operations across our client locations.

  • Leading, motivating, and supporting our cleaning employees.

  • Training and guiding employees in professional cleaning methods, hygiene, and safe working procedures.

  • Performing regular quality inspections and ensuring that our cleaning standards are consistently maintained.

  • Following up on quality issues and making sure improvements are implemented.

  • Ensuring that cleaning products, equipment, and materials are used correctly and responsibly.

  • Maintaining relevant documentation, quality reports, and operational follow-up.

  • Building positive relationships with clients and ensuring professional communication.

  • Supporting efficient daily operations while maintaining our commitment to quality, service, and sustainability.

WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR?

At REMA GROUP, we value attitude, responsibility, and professional pride.

We are looking for a supervisor who enjoys working with people, knows how to create structure in a busy working day, and understands the importance of being both a strong team leader and a reliable representative of our company.

We expect you to:

  • Have solid experience within professional or commercial cleaning.

  • Have previous experience as a Cleaning Supervisor, Team Leader, or in a similar position.

  • Be confident in planning, organizing, and supervising cleaning operations.

  • Have a natural ability to motivate, train, and support employees.

  • Be quality-conscious and have a strong eye for detail.

  • Be independent, reliable, flexible, and solution-oriented.

  • Have a positive attitude and take responsibility for your work.

  • Be comfortable communicating with both employees and clients.

  • Be able to communicate professionally in English.

  • Be willing to work flexible hours when required.

Most importantly, we are looking for someone who takes pride in doing things properly and who wants to make a positive difference every day.

WHY JOIN REMA GROUP?

We want our employees to feel that they are part of something meaningful.

At REMA GROUP, we work with a strong focus on quality, responsibility, sustainability, and long-term partnerships.

Our ambition is to deliver professional cleaning solutions while reducing our environmental footprint through responsible product choices, efficient cleaning methods, and environmentally conscious working practices.

We believe that good results come from good people, clear communication, and mutual respect.

What we offer:

  • A full-time position in a professional and growing cleaning company.

  • An important role with real responsibility and influence on daily operations.

  • A varied working day across different client locations in Greater Copenhagen.

  • A supportive working environment where teamwork and mutual respect matter.

  • Opportunities to develop your professional and leadership skills.

  • Long-term career opportunities within REMA GROUP.

  • Salary based on qualifications and experience.

POSITION DETAILS

Position: Cleaning Supervisor – Full-time

Location: Copenhagen & Greater Copenhagen

Working hours: Flexible according to operational requirements. Occasional early morning, evening, night, and weekend work may be required.

Start date: As soon as possible or by agreement.

Salary: Based on qualifications and experience.

READY TO BECOME PART OF REMA GROUP?

Are you ready to take the next step in your career and become part of a company where quality, responsibility, and people come first?

Then we would be happy to receive your application.

Please send your CV and a short personal application to:

info@remagroup.dk

Email subject: Cleaning Supervisor – Copenhagen

We review applications and invite candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis.

We look forward to welcoming the right person to the REMA GROUP team!

REMA GROUP

Green Heart. Green Footprints. Professional Cleaning.

IMPORTANT – APPLICATIONS BY EMAIL ONLY

Please note that we only accept written applications sent by email.

We kindly ask applicants not to contact us by phone regarding this position.

title: To konsulenter til politisk og ledelsesmæssig betjening samt til understøttelse af reformimplementering
description:
Trives du med en hverdag, hvor opgaverne er komplekse, varierede og tempoet er højt? Har du en skarp pen, et godt overblik og flair for politik og offentlig forvaltning? Og har du en god portion holdånd, en positiv grundindstilling og kan du arbejde selvstændigt? Så er du én af de to nye kollegaer, vi søger, til afdelingen Forebyggelse og Tværgående Koordinering i Center for Sundhed og Omsorg. 

Konkret søger vi to konsulenter, som skal indgå i teamet omkring centerledelsen og primært have opgaver indenfor politisk og ledelsesmæssig betjening på ældre- og sundhedsområderne samt opgaver i relation til understøttelse af reformimplementering.

Både sundheds- og omsorgsområdet undergår en rivende udvikling i disse år. Med både en national sundhedsreform og en ældrereform står centeret i en spændende tid, hvor sundheds- og omsorgsområderne skal fremtidssikres, mens der holdes fast i det allervigtigste: Tryghed for borgerne, en høj faglighed og et godt arbejdsmiljø for medarbejderne.

Den ene af de to stillinger, vi søger besat, vil primært løfte opgaver indenfor ældreområdet, som foruden politiske sager og ledelsesbetjening vil indebære opgaver indenfor administrativ understøttelse af en koordineret implementering af ældrereformens tiltag om bl.a. helhedspleje, mere selvbestemmelse, et tættere samspil med civilsamfundet samt generel forebyggelse på ældreområdet. 

Den anden af de to stillinger vil primært omhandle politisk og ledelsesmæssig betjening indenfor sundhedsområdet, herunder i forhold til implementering af sundhedsreformen, det tværsektorielle samarbejde med regionen, udarbejdelsen af en kommende nærsundhedsplan, samt ny folkesundhedslov og generelle kommunale sundhedsopgaver.

Om dig

Det er en væsentlig fordel, hvis du har kendskab til sundheds- og/eller ældreområdet, da det vil give dig et godt afsæt for at forstå og navigere i områdets opgaver, rammer og kompleksitet.

Du har en uddannelsesmæssig og/eller erhvervsmæssig erfaring og kompetencer i forhold til at varetage politisk og administrativ understøttelse.

Din uddannelsesmæssige baggrund eller din erhvervserfaring gør, at du besidder evnen til at gå analytisk til en opgave, sætte dig ind i et større skriftligt materiale, og arbejde selvstændigt med en skriftlig opgave. Tidligere erfaring med betjening af politiske udvalg eller andre lignende beslutningsorganer er ikke et krav men en fordel.  

Hvem du er som person er mindst lige så vigtigt for os som din baggrund og erfaring. Du er udadvendt og formår at bevare overblikket i en travl hverdag – og du trives med at arbejde indenfor til tider korte frister.

Du trives med at veksle mellem de større, komplekse opgaver og de mindre, løbende opgaver i det daglige, såsom at sikre gode Power Point-slides eller dagsordner til interne møder i administrationen.

Endelig har du flair for at arbejde med brug af data og har en grundlæggende forståelse for økonomi.

Hvem er Forebyggelse og Tværgående Koordinering?

Forebyggelse og Tværgående Koordinering udgøres af cirka 35 fagkonsulenter. Medarbejderne arbejder selvstændigt med opgaver indenfor sundhedsfremme og forebyggelse for borgere i alle aldre, udvikling af ældreplejen, herunder ift. frit valg for borgerne, forebyggende hjemmebesøg, demens, hygiejne og kvalitet, uddannelse af elever og studerende, ensomhed, velfærdsteknologi og IT-administration, tilsyn, tværsektorielt samarbejde mm.

Medarbejdere har forskellige faglige baggrunde, men fælles for alle er, at vi samarbejder på tværs af forskellige fagområder og på tværs af sektorer. Opgavetyperne spænder også vidt og indebærer alt fra drift til udvikling og projektfacilitering, betjening af centerledelse, direktion og politisk fagudvalg, undervisning, administration mm.

De konsulenter, vi søger, vil indgå i afdelingens team omkring centerledelsen.  

Dine opgaver bliver blandt andet:

Fællesnævneren for opgaverne, som skal løses i begge stillinger er, at du skal kunne give politisk og administrativ ledelse et oplyst grundlag at træffe beslutninger på af både strategisk og driftsnær karakter til gavn for en mere sammenhængende indsats af høj kvalitet for borgerne på Bornholm. Dette indebærer blandt andet:

- Produktion af politiske dagsordener og andre skriftlige oplæg til hhv. politisk og administrativ ledelse indenfor hhv. ældreområdet og sundhedsområdet

- Centralt for denne understøttelse er at kunne formulere hhv. problemstilling samt beskrivelse af forskellige scenarier/løsningsmuligheder og konsekvenser heraf

- Afsøgning af faglig viden, lovgivning mm. i samarbejde med kollegaer

- Arbejde tæt sammen med andre forvaltninger i kommunen om tværgående sager

- Indgå i samarbejde med eksterne parter, såsom Bornholms Hospital, andre kommuner, alment praktiserende læger, civilsamfundsorganisationer mm.

Du kan godt glæde dig

Vi er en flad, rummelig organisation med højt til loftet. Vi har en uhøjtidelig, om end professionel arbejdsform, hvor vi forsøger at udvikle os i fællesskab. Vi vægter faglighed højt, ligesom engagement, samarbejde, fleksibilitet og hverdagsinnovation er vigtige nøgleord for vores arbejde.

Du bedes i din ansøgning angive, om du har særlig interesse i stillingen på ældreområdet eller i stillingen på sundhedsområdet. Hvis du kan se dig selv i begge stillinger, så kan du også angive det.

Der kan blive to runder af samtaler, som vil finde sted i uge 51. Herudover kan der blive anvendt en skriveprøve forud for samtalen med ansættelsesudvalget.  

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår i henhold til gældende overenskomst og efter principperne i lokal løndannelse.

Der vil blive indhentet straffeattest ved ansættelse.

Stillingerne er på 37 timer pr. uge. 

Praktisk information

Send din ansøgning og CV samt dokumentation for uddannelse, via "Søg Jobbet" knappen. 

Ansøgningsfrist

08-12-2026

Samtaletidspunkt

uge 51

Ansættelsesdato

01-02-2027

Kontaktperson

leder af Forebyggelse og Tværgående KoorMette Kruse Hansen Sieben56926060 / 20131038

Arbejdssted

Forebyggelse og Tværgående KoordineringUllasvej 17, 3700 Rønne

En arbejdsplads, der binder øen sammen

BRK er en unik kommunal arbejdsplads, fordi øen er en selvstændig region. Vi arbejder derfor med strategier og opgaver inden for erhverv, turisme og trafik, som er ansvarsområder danske kommuner normalt ikke varetager. På brk.dk kan du læse mere om kommunen, der med 3.600 ansatte er øens suverænt største arbejdsplads.

BRK er en røgfri arbejdsplads. 

Vi hjælper dig på plads

Det er en stor beslutning at flytte til ’solskinsøen’ – derfor står du heller ikke alene med den. Vi har nemlig en tilflytterkonsulent, der hjælper med bolig, job til din ægtefælle og skole- eller fritidstilbud til familiens mindste. Læs mere her.

title: Rengøringsoperatør - fast aftenhold
description:
Er du interesseret i at blive en del af en moderne og førende maskinfabrik i vækst?Lige nu søger vi flere rengøringsoperatører til vores faste aftenhold, som vil være med til at sikre rene, ryddelige og sikre rammer på tværs af virksomheden.

Om teamet

Du bliver en del af vores Operations Support-team, som understøtter den daglige drift på tværs af virksomheden. Som rengøringsoperatør samarbejder du med kolleger fra flere afdelinger og bidrager til, at produktionsområder, fællesarealer og faciliteter fremstår rene, ryddelige og sikre.

Om jobbet

Din primære arbejdsfunktion er daglig rengøring af virksomhedens produktions- og industrilokaliteter. Som rengøringsoperatør får du en vigtig rolle i at sikre en høj rengøringsstandard på tværs af vores produktions- og fællesområder. Arbejdet udføres på fast aftenhold, hvor du i høj grad kan planlægge og gennemføre opgaverne uden at forstyrre den daglige produktion.

Dine opgaver vil variere, men vil blandt andet omfatte:

  • Daglig rengøring af produktionsområder, værksteder, fællesarealer og øvrige faciliteter.

  • Rengøring af gulve, overflader, inventar og sanitære områder.

  • Håndtering af affald og opfyldning af rengørings- og forbrugsartikler.

  • Betjening, rengøring og dagligt tilsyn med rengøringsudstyr og -maskiner.

  • Deltagelse i 5S-arbejde og praktiske ad hoc-opgaver med relation til rengøring, orden og affaldshåndtering.

  • Arbejdet er praktisk og fysisk, og udføres både manuelt og ved hjælp af rengøringsmaskiner.

Om dig

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Arbejder grundigt, systematisk og med blik for detaljen.

  • Er ansvarsbevidst, stabil og har en høj arbejdsmoral.

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og selv tage initiativ til at løse opgaver.

  • Er en hjælpsom kollega og samarbejder godt med andre.

  • Har fokus på kvalitet, hygiejne og sikkerhed.

  • Kan følge rengøringsplaner, instruktioner og gældende sikkerhedsprocedurer.

  • Trives med fysisk arbejde og med at arbejde på aftenhold.

Faglige kvalifikationer

Det vigtigste er, at du har lyst til at levere rengøring af høj kvalitet og er klar til at lære vores områder, udstyr og arbejdsgange at kende. Derudover er det en fordel, hvis du har:

  • Erfaring med erhvervsrengøring, gerne fra en produktionsvirksomhed.

  • Kendskab til rengøringsmidler, dosering og sikker håndtering.

  • Erfaring med rengøringsmaskiner eller lyst til at lære at bruge dem.

  • Evne til at kommunikere på dansk eller engelsk og følge skriftlige instruktioner.

 Vi tilbyder

  • Et fast job på aftenhold i en veletableret produktionsvirksomhed.

  • Grundig oplæring i vores rengøringsrutiner, udstyr og sikkerhedsprocedurer.

  • Gode kolleger, ordnede forhold og attraktive medarbejderfordele.

 

Vi tilbyder

Du bliver en del af en veletableret, dansk, familieejet eksportvirksomhed, hvor relationerne vægtes højt. Aasted er i 2026 blevet en del af Piovan Group, hvilket giver nye perspektiver og muligheder som en del af en større international koncern.

Kulturen i Aasted er kendetegnet ved, at vi alle er motiverede og stolte af det, vi laver, hvilket skaber et stærkt sammenhold og engagement. Vi har en åben, ærlig og direkte tone og gør en dyd ud af at opføre os ordentligt i alt, hvad vi foretager os.

Vi arbejder kontinuerligt mod at være en inkluderende arbejdsplads med lige udviklingsmuligheder for alle vores medarbejdere. Vi tilbyder en attraktiv barselsordning, sociale arrangementer og en sund kantine ved Meyers Kantine.

title: Experienced High Voltage Specialist wanted for Bravida El-Infrastruktur Øst

title: Demonstratør: Et fleksibelt job, der passer ind i din hverdag
description:
Demonstratører / Demonstratricer søges til hele landet

Et fleksibelt job, der passer ind i din hverdag

Søger du et meningsfuldt og socialt job, der passer ind i netop din hverdag?

Hos IN-STORE søger vi kollegaer til en spændende stilling som demonstratør. Som demonstratør bliver du vores ansigt udadtil og er med til at skabe gode oplevelser for både kunder og butikker. Du uddeler smagsprøver, fortæller om produkterne og giver kunderne lyst til at prøve noget nyt. Her kommer din livserfaring og evne til at tale med mennesker dig til gode.

Uanset om du er pensionist, der ønsker at supplere din indkomst, selvstændig, der søger et fleksibelt bijob, eller noget helt tredje, kan dette være det perfekte match for dig. Du bliver vores ansigt udadtil og er med til at skabe gode oplevelser for både kunder og butikker. 

Dine opgaver indebærer:

  • Let tilberedning og uddeling af smagsprøver. 

  • Engagerende samtaler og salg af produkterne.

  • Opsætning af en pæn og indbydende stand.

  • Skabe en god relation til de butikker, du besøger.

Vi tilbyder et job, der passer til dig

Vi ved at fleksibilitet og frihed er vigtigt - derfor tilbyder vi: 

  • Frihed til at planlægge: Du bestemmer selv, hvor mange vagter du ønsker om måneden. Vores vagter er 6-8 timer ad gangen og spredt over hele ugen - fredage og lørdage er dog altid vores mest aktive dage. 

  • Social og aktiv arbejdsdag: Du bliver en del af et team af kollegaer, der ligesom dig selv, sætter pris på at holde sig aktiv og social.

  • Udstyr derhjemme: Du opbevarer dit udstyr hjemme og tager det med, når du skal på arbejde.

  • Kørsel i egen bil: Du får skattefri kørselsgodtgørelse efter gældende regler.

 

Hvem er du?

Vi forestiller os, at du er imødekommende, ansvarsfuld og glad for at tale med mennesker. Din livserfaring er en stor fordel, da du er god til at tale med alle slags mennesker og skabe tillid. Erfaring som demonstratør er ikke et krav. Det vigtigste er, at du har lyst til at præsentere produkter og give kunderne en god oplevelse.

Derudover ser vi gerne, at:

  • Du er god til at kommunikere og er god til at formidle et budskab.

  • Du er ansvarsfuld og mødestabil.

  • Du trives med at arbejde selvstændigt.

  • Du er fortrolig med IT (smartphone, e-mail) og har bil til rådighed. 

 

Sådan søger du jobbet:

Send os din ansøgning med CV og et vellignende billede af dig selv via vores hjemmeside www.in-store.dk.

Du er velkommen til at kontakte vores HR Koordinator, Emilie Braagaard, på tlf. 52 18 64 09 eller mail embra@in-store.dk, hvis du har spørgsmål til jobbet.

 

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

title: Lead Game Programmer
description: Do you love designing clean game architecture, building multiplayer systems that run smoothly, and helping a team of programmers make the right technical decisions? Great! Let's talk.Triband is the award-winning studio behind the WHAT THE? comedy game series, played by millions worldwide. From our home in central Copenhagen, more than 60 wonderful humans are united by a simple mission: to make everyone laugh.We're building something unannounced, exciting, thoroughly goofy, and built to be played together online. We're now looking for a Lead Game Programmer to help building the underlying systems that make it all work, from the core architecture to the multiplayer tech that connects our players. You'll stay hands-on in the code and the Unity editor while helping the programming team make good technical decisions, stay aligned, and build systems that support creative experimentation. And just to be very clear: this is a technical leadership role, not a people-management position.Here's what that looks like day to dayIn collaboration with game designers, artists, and other programmers, you'll build new features and systems and continuously iterate on improvements. technical prioritiesYou'll help the programming team make architectural decisions, align around shared patterns, and navigate trade-offs between long-term code health and short-term needsYou'll review and improve technical solutions, share best practices, and support other programmers without becoming a gatekeeper or bottleneckYou'll proactively identify technical risks, messy systems, and missing foundations, and take responsibility for addressing them at the right timeOverall, you'll make sure the project is technically healthy and maintain the codebase in a way that makes it easy for others to build onThis includes things like...Designing an architecture that allows for easy gameplay implementation and flexibilityImplementing and maintaining online features such as matchmaking, invites and friendsProfiling and improving network performance, bandwidth and latency, and making sure the game holds up on real-world connectionsBreaking down complex technical challenges, helping decide what to prioritise, and ensuring important decisions are understood by the people they affectStaying close to the actual game: writing production code, debugging difficult problems, and improving systems as the project evolvesYou're a great match ifYou have at least ten years of professional game development experience across multiple shipped games and different stages of development, including significant technical ownership or leadership on a projectYou have experience setting technical direction and helping a programming team make and implement architectural decisions, with strong judgment in balancing flexibility, maintainability, performance and the needs of a creative productionYou're highly proficient in C# and have deep knowledge of the Unity engine and editorYou've shipped at least one online multiplayer game, had real ownership of its networking/online systems, and have hands-on experience with a Unity multiplayer framework (e.g., Coherence)You communicate clearly and can explain technical decisions and trade-offs to programmers and non-programmers alikeNice to havesYou have experience shipping iOS and macOS apps, including hands-on integration of Apple platform services such as GameKit and the Game Controller framework using Xcode and SwiftExperience with backend services, dedicated servers or cloud hosting for online gamesInterest in multiplayer game design and social featuresExperience working with automated build pipelines such as JenkinsExperience building systemic or open-world gamesWhat always matters to us at TribandYou thrive in taking ownership of your area: you spot problems, seek advice when needed, and implement creative solutions that push projects forwardYou're motivated by collaboration, mutual respect, inclusiveness and creativity while actively contributing to sustaining that cultureYou believe games are made by teams, not rockstars and that great ideas can come from anyoneYou bring curiosity, generosity, and flexibility, along with strong opinions, especially when they come with reasoning, openness, and a willingness to actually test themYou love exploration and experimentation but don't get too precious when the evidence tells you you're wrongYou value a positive work environment and contribute to keeping the studio a fun and supportive place to bePracticalitiesWe work on-site at our cozy office in central Copenhagen.For this role we also consider people located outside of Denmark and provide financial (and moral!) support with visa application and relocation.We work a 37-hour work week, with core hours 10-15, and the freedom to start and finish anywhere between 7 and 18.Our working language is English.We offerSilly but ambitious projects, and the chance to work on and impact great games that reach millions of players.A playful and ambitious work environment where experimentation is encouraged.Friendly and kind colleagues who love making each other laugh as much as making games.A professional development budget to invest in your growth.Social activities like Friday bars, hobby nights, board game nights, team events, you name it.Daily lunch at a local restaurant just a walk across the lakes away, with plant-based options (and soft ice on Thursdays).Six weeks of vacation (five standard plus one extra on us).Paid parental leave at full salary for the periods covered by state reimbursement.Child's first sick day on us, no questions asked.Pension plan and private health insurance.Endless amounts of Faxe Kondi.

title: PhD scholarship in Experimental Clearance Flow Research - DTU Construct
description:
The PhD candidate will, as part of a collaboration project between a private enterprise and DTU Construct, carry out experimental clearance flow research with ammonia and other sustainable marine fuels. Pressure and temperature conditions, resembling those in a marine engine booster pump, are created in an in-house designed clearance flow test rig. Measured clearance flow data will be used to develop and validate accurate flow models. The test rig will be further modified to enable testing and evaluation of different sealing solutions.Responsibilities and qualificationsThe PhD candidate will be responsible for continuing our development of a high-pressure ammonia flow rig, conduct test campaigns with different ammonia pump components and develop both theoretical and experimental foundation for developing ammonia compatible sealing techniques.The candidate should have significant experience with:
  • Safe handling of ammonia and other liquified gases in test setups.
  • Design and wiring electronic data acquisition and control systems using PC Schematics.
  • LabView programming.
  • Mechanical design and FEM analysis using Solid Works.
  • Data processing of large experimental sets of dynamic flow and pressure data using statistical methods in Matlab.
  • CMM (Coordinate Measurement Machine) measurement and preferably have experience with Calypso Software.
  • Data processing large complex geometric data sets from CMM measurements for 3-dimensional analysis of tested pump components.
You must have a two-year master's degree (120 ECTS points) or a similar degree with an academic level equivalent to a two-year master's degree.Approval and EnrolmentThe scholarship for the PhD degree is subject to academic approval, and the candidate will be enrolled in one of the general degree programmes at DTU. For information about our enrolment requirements and the general planning of the PhD study programme, please see DTU's rules for the PhD education. We offerDTU is a leading technical university globally recognized for the excellence of its research, education, innovation and scientific advice. We offer a rewarding and challenging job in an international environment. We strive for academic excellence in an environment characterized by collegial respect and academic freedom tempered by responsibility.Salary and appointment termsThe appointment will be based on the collective agreement with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. Please see DTU’s salary structure for scientific staff: www.inside.dtu.dk/en/human-resources/during-employment/salary/salary-structures.The period of employment is 3 years. Starting date is 1 January 2027 (or according to mutual agreement). The position is a full-time position.You can read more about career paths at DTU here.Further informationFurther information may be obtained from Anders Ivarsson, aniv@dtu.dk.You can read more about Department of Civil and Mechanical Engineering at www.construct.dtu.dk. If you are applying from abroad, you may find useful information on working in Denmark and at DTU at DTU – Moving to Denmark. Furthermore, you have the option of joining our monthly free seminar “PhD relocation to Denmark and startup “Zoom” seminar” for all questions regarding the practical matters of moving to Denmark and working as a PhD at DTU. Application procedureYour complete online application must be submitted no later than 19 November 2026 (23:59 Danish time). Applications must be submitted as one PDF file containing all materials to be given consideration. To apply, please open the link "Apply now", fill out the online application form, and attach all your materials in English in one PDF file. The file must include:
  • A letter motivating the application (cover letter)
  • Curriculum vitae
  • Grade transcripts and BSc/MSc diploma (in English) including official description of grading scale
You may apply prior to obtaining your master's degree but cannot begin before having received it. Applications received after the deadline will not be considered.All interested candidates irrespective of age, gender, disability, race, religion or ethnic background are encouraged to apply. As DTU works with research in critical technology, which is subject to special rules for security and export control, open-source background checks may be conducted on qualified candidates for the position.DTU Civil and Mechanical Engineering develops and utilises science and technical knowledge for the benefit of society and the sustainable development. We undertake research, education, innovation, and scientific advice of the highest quality within building design and processes, building construction and safety, building energy and technical services, solid mechanics, fluid mechanics, coastal and maritime engineering, materials technology, manufacturing engineering, engineering systems design, design for sustainability, and thermal energy.DTU – For the benefit of society since 1829DTU is one of Europe's leading elite technical universities. Through research and education at an international top level, we create solutions to the major societal challenges of our time and help secure Europe's global leadership in sustainable technological development. Since Hans Christian Ørsted founded DTU almost 200 years ago, our mission has remained the same: We develop and create value through the natural and technical sciences for the benefit of society. DTU has 13,800 students, 1,600 PhD students, and 6,500 employees. We work in an international environment and have an inclusive, stimulating, and informal work culture. DTU has campuses in all parts of Denmark and in Greenland and collaborates with the best universities around the world.

title: Senior Video Editor hos Coho – Skab visuelt stærkt kommercielt indhold
description:
Location: Remote | Cape Town, Poland, Romania or locations close to the EU time zone.

Experience: 5+ years

Company: Coho

About the role

Coho is looking for a highly skilled Senior Video Editor with a strong commercial eye and the ability to turn raw footage into polished, engaging work.

We are looking for someone who combines excellent editing craft with strong visual judgement. You should be comfortable owning projects from edit through final delivery, while also being able to collaborate with and help develop other editors.

This is a senior role for someone who understands pacing, storytelling, sound and colour, and knows how to create work that feels sharp, contemporary and commercially effective.

What you'll be doing

  • Editing high-quality commercial video content from raw footage to final delivery

  • Working primarily in DaVinci Resolve

  • Bringing strong storytelling, pacing and visual judgement to every edit

  • Working with colour grading and sound design as an integrated part of the edit

  • Using AI tools and workflows where they can improve the creative or production process

  • Collaborating closely with the wider creative and production team

  • Giving constructive feedback to other editors and helping raise the overall quality of the team's work

  • Managing multiple projects while maintaining a consistently high creative standard

What we're looking for

You have:

  • 5+ years of professional video editing experience

  • Advanced experience with DaVinci Resolve

  • A strong portfolio or reel demonstrating commercial editing work

  • Strong skills in video editing, storytelling and pacing

  • Experience with colour grading

  • A good understanding of sound design

  • Experience integrating AI into creative or post-production workflows

  • The ability to work independently and take ownership of an edit

  • Experience helping, mentoring or leading other editors

Motion design experience is a plus, but not a requirement.

We are particularly interested in editors coming from strong commercial post-production environments, as well as experienced freelance editors looking for a more consistent collaboration.

Where you can work from

For this role, we are primarily looking for candidates based in:

  • Cape Town, South Africa

  • Poland

  • Romania

  • Or anywhere close to the EU time zone

These locations allow for close collaboration across similar European working hours.

Interested?

We care much more about the quality of your work than a perfectly polished CV. When filling

When applying, please include as an requirement:

  1. Link to your portfolio or showreel
