Digital Presence: Manage our social media channels to showcase our vibrant dishes, culture, and events.

Who We Are Looking For:

· Experience: 3–4 years of proven leadership experience in the hospitality industry is essential.

· Cuisine Expertise: Deep knowledge of Indian cuisine is essential; prior management experience in an Indian restaurant is highly preferred.

· Language: High-level fluency in English.

· Personality & Presence: Outgoing, hardworking, and naturally hospitable. You bring a "service with a smile" mentality and project a welcoming, highly professional presence on the floor.

· Bonus Skills: Hands-on experience with beverage pairing, craft cocktails, and premium coffee making will give you a significant advantage.

What We Offer:

· A highly competitive salary.

· Autonomy to shape the service culture and FOH operations.

· A vibrant, fast-paced work environment with a passionate team.

· Opportunities for long-term career growth.

Ready to lead our service?

Please send your CV (including a professional headshot) and a cover letter describing your experience and motivation to info@tandooritwist.dk.

title: DIAS Professor in Clinical Translational Psychiatry and Centre Leader for the Elite Centre for Clinical and Translational Psychiatry at Odense University Hospital and the University of Southern Denmark
description:
The Danish Institute for Advanced Study (DIAS), the Department of Clinical Research at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU), and the Region of Southern Denmark seek an outstanding candidate to fill a fully tenured Professor position in the field of clinical translational psychiatry. The candidate is expected to start by agreement.

The candidate is expected to start by agreement.

We seek an exceptional researcher with demonstrated excellence in their discipline and a proven ability to push boundaries, challenge conventions, and engage in groundbreaking interdisciplinary research. The successful candidate will be expected to contribute to cutting-edge advancements in their field while fostering collaboration across disciplines, embracing DIAS’s mission of curiosity-driven research. The ideal candidate will have a strong international research profile, an outstanding record of attracting competitive research funding, and a demonstrated ability to conduct interdisciplinary research. The successful candidate will be attached to the Department of Clinical Research, DIAS, and the Region, and must be prepared to engage in multiple and diverse research environments at SDU and in the Region of Southern Denmark. 

What we offer

  • The opportunity to lead a new elite centre for clinical and translational psychiatry, with five-year funding of DKK 17 million (equivalent to Euro 2.3 million), with the potential for a five-year extension.

  • A strong interdisciplinary research environment through DIAS, comprising leading academics across medicine, science, and the humanities, with the opportunity to collaborate with outstanding researchers across SDU’s five faculties.

  • Access to state-of-the-art research facilities at the newly built Odense University Hospital (OUH), where psychiatry and somatic care are integrated to foster collaboration between these fields.

  • Comprehensive research support services from DIAS and SDU, targeting prestigious funding such as DNRF, ERC, and grants from Danish private foundations.

  • If recruited from abroad or from industry, the candidate will be eligible for a fast-track DKK 11 million  (equivalent to Euro 1.5 million ) Lundbeck Foundation Start-Up grant.

  • Reduced teaching obligations compared to a standard professorship, allowing the candidate to focus on research and leadership within the elite centre.

Who we are looking for 

We are seeking a highly accomplished researcher with expertise in the field of clinical translational psychiatry, who is eager to engage in collaborative activities within the DIAS framework. 

The ideal candidate should demonstrate:

  • A commitment to engaging in boundary-crossing interdisciplinary research and dialogue. 

  • A record of internationally competitive research activities at the highest level of ambition. 

  • Publications in high-level peer-reviewed academic journals and leading innovative research programmes in clinical psychiatry. 

  • An ability to attract significant external funding to support independent and collaborative research initiatives.

  • Engagement in the international academic society. 

  • Extensive experience in building and leading multidisciplinary research teams that integrate basic and clinical sciences, with an emphasis on translational research spanning from laboratory findings to clinical trials.

  • A research focus in areas such as child and adolescent psychiatry, clinical psychopharmacology, epidemiology, molecular neurobiology, substance use disorders, or serious mental illness.

  • The ability to develop a translational research programme in one or more of the mentioned fields, with a focus on building cooperative, multidisciplinary teams that bridge basic science and the design and execution of early-phase clinical trials.

  • A demonstrated commitment to mentorship, teaching, and leadership, fostering the next generation of researchers in interdisciplinary research environments.

  • Experience at Full or Associate Professor level within relevant fields.

  • Fluency in English

The Danish Institute for Advanced Study (DIAS)

DIAS at SDU is a hub for interdisciplinary excellence at and beyond the frontier of knowledge, bringing together outstanding researchers from various disciplines to foster groundbreaking interdisciplinary research and bold innovation. DIAS nurtures a collaborative and curiosity-driven environment, encouraging scholars to think outside the box and challenge conventional boundaries. The institute values open-minded exploration and an ambitious yet collegial atmosphere with a strong sense of community. Researchers affiliated with DIAS are expected to contribute actively to DIAS activities, mentor DIAS fellows, and engage in interdisciplinary collaborations across faculties and departments, both nationally and internationally.  

The Department of Clinical Research

The Department of Clinical Research does translational research spanning from basic research to patient care, within both somatics and psychiatry. The interdisciplinary research aims to improve patient treatment, health, and well-being. Researchers at the institute often have joint appointments between clinic, research, and education, ensuring a strong academic foundation for the research at Odense University Hospital (OUH) and in psychiatry. The researchers at the Department of Clinical Research primarily consist of doctors, nurses, and other healthcare professionals with main employment at OUH.

The Centre for Clinical and Translational PsychiatryThe centre will be based at the new Odense University Hospital, which integrates psychiatric and somatic care to promote close collaboration between the fields. The hospital includes a state-of-the-art adult psychiatric department with around 600 employees, 142 single rooms, and specialized sections for joint somatic-psychiatric care, rehabilitation, telepsychiatry, and more. The child and adolescent psychiatric department cover the entire region with about 600 employees, two inpatient wards with a total of 34 beds, and outpatient clinics at four geographical sites.The centre’s aim is to advance novel psychiatric research through innovative approaches that will significantly impact future patient care. This includes translating discoveries from the laboratory to clinical settings, whether within narrow clinical fields or through broader cross-disciplinary collaborations that involve various clinical functions, professions, and institutions.

Additional informationFor further information about being a professor at DIAS, please contact DIAS director Sten Rynning at +45 6550 2193 or via email at director-dias@sdu.dk For further information and questions about the position, please contact the Head of the Department of Clinical Research Rikke Leth-Larsen at +456550 3477 or via email at rllarsen@health.sdu.dk or Medical Director Bjarne Dahler-Eriksen, Odense University Hospital, at +4523284068 or via email at bde@rsyd.dk. You may also contact the Vice Dean for Research and Innovation at the Faculty of Health Sciences, SDU, Uffe Holmskov at +45 6550 3775 or via email at uholmskov@health.sdu.dk regarding the position.

Application, salary, and employment terms

This position will be attached to the Department of Clinical Research in Odense. The successful candidate will be expected to regularly engage in DIAS activities and interdisciplinary cooperation in Odense. 

The successful applicant will be employed in accordance with the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC). 

For more details on salary and taxation, please refer to the provided links about salary and taxation.

Teaching obligations will be reduced compared to a standard professorship at SDU, allowing more time for research and leadership activities.

Application requirements

Applications must be submitted electronically via the "Apply now" link provided below.

If you experience technical problems, please contact hcm-support@sdu.dk. 

The application must include the following:

  • A motivation letter.

  • A detailed Curriculum Vitae (CV), including contacts for possible references.

  • Copies of relevant certificates/diplomas.

  • A teaching portfolio detailing previous teaching experience.

  • A complete list of publications, highlighting those most relevant to the position.

  • Up to ten of the most relevant publications

  • A research and publication plan for the next five years, including a description of synergy with the department's activities and the potential to benefit from DIAS’s interdisciplinary environment.

All application materials must be submitted in English, and only applications written in English will be considered.

Submission guidelines

  • Files must be submitted in PDF format, with each file no larger than 10 MB.

  • If multiple files are needed for a single section, combine them into one PDF file.

  • Zip files, image files (jpg, png, etc.), and password-protected PDF files will not be accepted. All PDF files must be unlocked to allow binding.

  • The application deadline is February 7, 2027, at 23:59 CET. Applications received after the deadline will not be considered.

Applications that are incomplete with regards to the above-mentioned requirements will not be assessed by the committee. Shortlisting and tests may be used in the recruitment process and references may be obtained.  

We recommend that international applicants take the time to visit the websites of Work in Denmark and the International Staff Office at SDU. Here you will find information and facts about moving to, working, and living in Denmark.

Assessment

Shortlisting may be used as part of the recruitment process. Read about shortlisting at SDU. 

Assessment of shortlisted applications will be done under the existing Appointment Order for universities. Shortlisted applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. The committee may request additional information, and, if so, it is the responsibility of the applicant to provide the necessary material.  

When the assessment committee has submitted its report, the applicants will receive the part of the evaluation that concerns themselves.

About SDU

SDU is committed to fostering a diverse staff that reflects society’s diversity. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of personal background.

SDU was founded in 1966 and now has over 27,000 students, nearly 20% of whom are international. SDU employs more than 3,800 staff and offers 115 study programmes across disciplines such as the humanities, social sciences, natural sciences, health sciences, and engineering. title: High School Psychologist / Social-Emotional Counsellor
description:
Role Overview

The High School Psychologist / Social-Emotional Counsellor is a member of the Student Support Team and shares responsibility for student wellbeing, inclusion and mental health across the High School. The role provides direct counselling, psychological support, consultation, and system-level guidance to students, families and staff, with particular attention to students who are socially, emotionally or psychologically vulnerable. Working hours and days are flexible and can be arranged to fit your existing schedule. You have the freedom to allocate your working hours across the week in a way that suits your availability while meeting the needs of students and the school.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide individual social-emotional counselling to students aged 15–19, supporting their mental health, resilience, relationships and academic wellbeing.

  • Design and implement preventive and systemic interventions at class and year-group levels to promote student wellbeing and positive group dynamics.

  • Develop, implement and review individual student support plans in alignment with the IB Access and Inclusion Policy.

  • Collaborate with the student wellbeing team, student support staff, teachers and parents to coordinate appropriate support.

  • Guide students and families through the Danish public and private healthcare and youth support systems, including PPR, specialist clinics and pathways to diagnostic assessment.

  • Prepare professional referrals and supporting documentation for external assessments, including neuropsychological or psychiatric evaluations, within the scope of professional competence.

  • Follow safeguarding, confidentiality and data protection requirements; identify students requiring specialist intervention and coordinate appropriate follow-up and support.

Qualifications and Experience

  • Relevant qualifications and training in psychology, counselling or social-emotional support. A qualification as a psychologist, including assessment and diagnosis, is preferred; demonstrated expertise in social-emotional counselling will also be considered.

  • Knowledge of the Danish healthcare and youth support systems, including PPR.

  • Experience with psychological screening and assessment tools such as WISC, WAIS, BASC, and BRIEF is an advantage.

  • Experience working within the International Baccalaureate (IB) system is desirable but not required.

Position Details

  • Reports to: High School Principal / Programme Principal

  • Works closely with: the Learning Support Team, Student Wellbeing Team, teaching staff, parents and external specialists

  • Position: Part-time (50%)

  • Start date: January 2027, or by agreement

  • Closing date for applications: 20 November 2026

Give Steel A/S is a manufacturing engineering and steel construction company that develops, designs, manufactures, and erects load-bearing steel structures and steel trusses. You will become part of an international company with strong technical expertise and opportunities for professional development. Collaboration, responsibility, and integrity are key values in our daily work.

title: Communications Student Assistant – Partnerships, Advocacy and Communications Team
description:
About ICARS The International Centre for Antimicrobial Resistance Solutions (ICARS) is an independent international organisation established by the Danish Government to support low- and middle-income countries in developing evidence-based and context-appropriate solutions to antimicrobial resistance (AMR). Working across the One Health spectrum, ICARS collaborates with governments, research institutions and global organisations to bridge research, policy and implementation. About the role We are looking for a Student Assistant to join our Partnerships, Advocacy and Communications Team. This is a great opportunity for a student interested in digital communications, creative media, data management and global health and development. You’ll support our day-to-day activities and help communicate ICARS’ work on AMR in LMICs. We’re looking for someone with strong technical skills who also takes initiative to bring fresh ideas to the team. Alongside delivering assigned tasks, you will be encouraged to suggest improvements and take ownership of agreed activities, with support and feedback from colleagues. Key responsibilities Website management:
  • Maintain and update content on ICARS’ WordPress website, keeping it accurate, accessible and user-friendly.
  • Track website performance using analytics tools and suggest improvements based on the findings.
  • Proactively identify outdated content, gaps and opportunities to better showcase our work.
Graphic design & visual content:
  • Create engaging infographics, social media graphics and report layouts that align with ICARS’ brand.
  • Help develop templates and designs for reports and presentations, bringing fresh ideas for communicating complex information clearly.
  • Video editing & multimedia:
  • Edit videos for ICARS’ social media, presentations and events.
  • Support video production and identify opportunities to turn existing footage into useful, engaging content.
Social media support :
  • Support ICARS’ LinkedIn presence through content creation and community engagement.
  • Keep an eye on relevant conversations, project updates and sector developments, suggesting timely stories and opportunities for ICARS to contribute.
Internal communications support:
  • Maintain our internal SharePoint, including keeping our media library organised and up to date.
  • Support colleagues with designing clear, engaging PowerPoint slides and formatting Word documents.
Press Office and external communications support:
  • Assist with event promotion and Mailchimp newsletter creation.
  • Monitor our communications mailbox, respond to routine enquiries and coordinate with colleagues on requests from stakeholders, including regional and national press.
  • Flag relevant media and communications opportunities for the team to consider.
Data and stakeholder information management:
  • Support the team in entering and maintaining accurate, up-to-date data and contact information in ATLAS, our CRM system.
  • Other tasks related to deliverables of the Partnerships, Advocacy and Communications Team.
Desired profile We are seeking an organised and curious student who enjoys both developing ideas and getting things done in a pro-active and structured manner. You take the initiative to find information, ask useful questions and suggest practical next steps. You can work independently, recognise when to seek guidance and lead tasks through to completion, while keeping colleagues informed. You are comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where priorities can change quickly, and you bring strong digital fluency, technical skills and the ability to pick up new tools with ease. Required qualifications:
  • Currently studying for a Master’s degree in IT, Media Studies, Marketing, Graphic Design or a related field.
  • Proficiency in WordPress and basic website management.
  • Experience using MS Office, particularly Excel, Word and PowerPoint.
  • Experience with graphic design tools, such as Canva or Adobe Creative Suite.
  • Basic video editing skills, using Premiere Pro, Final Cut or similar software.
  • Strong organisational skills, working in a structured manner and with attention to detail.
  • Ability to prioritise and manage multiple tasks.
  • Ability to identify opportunities, propose ideas and take responsibility for delivering agreed tasks.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in perfect and fluent English, including the ability to adapt content for different audiences.
Preferred qualifications:
  • Knowledge of Google Analytics, or a willingness to learn.
  • Experience using CRM platforms (Dynamics 365)
  • Skills and interest in drafting technical and scientific communication material.
What we offer
  • Hands-on experience: Contribute to drafting communications material, external stakeholder management and partnerships, developing your skills through practical work and feedback.
  • Impact: Help communicate solutions to one of the world’s most critical global health and development challenges, with space to contribute your own ideas and see them put into practice.
  • Flexible working hours: Our working hours between 8 am and 5 pm with accommodation of your academic schedule.
  • International environment: Work alongside experts and colleagues from diverse backgrounds in a global organisation.
If you enjoy turning ideas into action and want to use your communications skills to support global health, we would love to hear from you! Terms of employment The position as student assistant will be covered by the terms of the collective agreement between The Danish Finance Ministry and the Organisation of Public Employees (OAO-S-Fællesoverenskomsten) and the organizational agreement between The Danish Finance Ministry and the Organisation for Salaried Employees HK/Stat (Organisationsaftale for kontorfunktionærer, laboranter og it-medarbejdere (HK)), according to chapter 6 in the agreement concerning hourly paid employees. The successful candidate is enrolled at graduate level in a Danish University with at around two years of studies remaining. They will predominantly work from the ICARS HQ office, based at the Statens Serum Institut in Copenhagen, Denmark. Application and recruitment process Press “apply for the position” and submit your CV along with a cover letter outlining your suitability for the role and motivation for applying. We would like to receive your application by 20 November 2026 and expect to conduct interviews 24-27 November 2026. For questions about the role, please contact Communications Officer Chloe Modvig-Cole (checo@icars-global.org) and for other questions about the position you may contact Head of Partnerships and Global Relations Theresa Hogenhaug (tcah@icars-global.org). We are committed to cultivating a fair and healthy environment, where everyone can be themselves and thrive. We are happy to discuss flexible working options for all roles. We work to ensure that our recruitment processes are as inclusive as possible to everyone. This includes adjusting for people who have a disability or long-term condition. We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Renovationsarbejde
description:
WTS Service ApS søger en stabil, ansvarsbevidst og arbejdsom renovationsmedarbejder til udførelse af forskellige opgaver inden for affaldshåndtering, affaldssortering og genanvendelse af byggematerialer.

Vi søger en medarbejder, der har lyst til at indgå i en alsidig arbejdsdag, hvor arbejdsopgaverne blandt andet foregår på byggepladser, genbrugspladser og andre arbejdsområder med håndtering af affald og byggematerialer.

Arbejdsopgaver

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver vil blandt andet omfatte:

  • Sortering og håndtering af forskellige affaldstyper.

  • Sortering af byggeaffald og byggematerialer, herunder træ, metal, beton, plast og øvrige genanvendelige materialer.

  • Indsamling, flytning og transport af affald.

  • Farlig affald sortering

  • Kørsel og håndtering af affald mellem forskellige arbejdssteder og genbrugspladser.

  • Sortering og organisering af affald på genbrugspladser.

  • Af- og pålæsning af byggematerialer og affald.

  • Medvirken til at sikre korrekt håndtering og bortskaffelse af forskellige affaldstyper.

  • Almindeligt forefaldende arbejde i forbindelse med virksomhedens renovations- og serviceopgaver.

Fremtidige arbejdsopgaver – asbest

Som en del af virksomhedens fremtidige arbejdsområder kan stillingen også omfatte håndtering og arbejde med asbestholdige materialer.

Det er derfor et krav, at medarbejderen er indstillet på at gennemføre relevante asbestkurser og den nødvendige uddannelse, så medarbejderen kan varetage sådanne arbejdsopgaver i overensstemmelse med gældende regler og arbejdsmiljøkrav.

Arbejdet med asbest vil først blive påbegyndt, når de nødvendige uddannelses-, sikkerheds- og lovgivningsmæssige krav er opfyldt.

Kvalifikationer

Vi forventer, at du:

  • Er mødestabil, ansvarsbevidst og arbejdsom.

  • Har en positiv indstilling til fysisk arbejde.

  • Er fleksibel og kan varetage forskellige praktiske arbejdsopgaver.

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt såvel som sammen med kolleger.

  • Er omhyggelig med sortering og håndtering af affald og materialer.

  • Er villig til at deltage i relevante kurser og efteruddannelse, herunder asbestkursus.

  • Har kørekort B. Kørekort til andre kategorier er en fordel, men ikke et krav.

Erfaring med renovationsarbejde, affaldssortering, genbrugspladser eller byggepladsarbejde er en fordel, men ikke et krav, da oplæring vil finde sted.

Vi tilbyder

  • En alsidig arbejdsplads med varierende arbejdsopgaver.

  • Mulighed for at udvikle dine kompetencer inden for affaldshåndtering og genanvendelse.

  • Relevant oplæring og mulighed for deltagelse i nødvendige kurser.

  • Et arbejdsmiljø med fokus på sikkerhed, samarbejde og ansvarlighed.

Vi ser frem til at modtage din ansøgning.----------------------------------WTS Service ApS – Waste Management Worker

WTS Service ApS is seeking a reliable, responsible and hardworking Waste Management Worker to carry out various tasks within waste management, waste sorting and the recycling of construction materials.

We are looking for an employee who is interested in a varied working day, with duties carried out at construction sites, recycling centres and other locations involving the handling of waste and construction materials.

Job Responsibilities

Your primary duties will include, but are not limited to:

  • Sorting and handling various types of waste.

  • Sorting construction waste and building materials, including wood, metal, concrete, plastic and other recyclable materials.

  • Collecting, moving and transporting waste.

  • Sorting hazardous waste.

  • Driving and handling waste between different work locations and recycling centres.

  • Sorting and organising waste at recycling centres.

  • Loading and unloading construction materials and waste.

  • Helping to ensure the correct handling and disposal of different types of waste.

  • Performing general duties related to the company's waste management and service operations.

title: Rethinking Converter Synchronization: 2-Year Postdoctoral Position in Battery Energy Storage Systems
description:
Are you eager to contribute to a bold experimental research project at the forefront of power electronics and energy storage? We are offering an exciting 2-year postdoctoral position for a talented researcher to investigate advanced converter synchronization and control methods for Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS), with particular emphasis on exploiting naturally occurring acoustic and vibration information. The project combines converter control, sensing, signal processing, and experimental validation to explore new approaches toward simpler, more robust, and scalable BESS operation. This position is expected to start from 1st of January 2027, or as soon as possible hereafter.

About the projectThe position is affiliated with the VILLUM Experiment project A-choir and the EMI/EMC In Power Electronics research group at AAU Energy. The project investigates new synchronization concepts for multi-converter BESSs by combining power electronics, sensing, signal processing, and control. A particular focus is placed on whether physical signatures naturally generated during converter operation can provide useful information for synchronization and coordination. 

You will join a research environment working across power electronics, EMI/EMC, converter control, multi-physics analysis, and experimental validation with applications including battery energy storage systems and other converter-dominated energy systems, with opportunities for collaboration across disciplines. The position also offers opportunities for international scientific exchange, participation in leading conferences, and may include research visits to relevant academic or industrial partners.

Your work tasksYou will:

  • Develop and investigate synchronization and coordination methods for power electronic converters.
  • Develop sensing and signal-processing methods for acoustic and vibration measurements.
  • Establish and evaluate relationships between physical signatures and converter switching/operating behaviors.
  • Implement and validate the developed methods using real-time control platforms, HIL, and experimental converter setups.
  • Assess the proposed approaches under representative BESS operating conditions, including robustness to interference and multi-converter interactions.
  • Contribute to the coordination of related research activities, and disseminate results through scientific publications, conferences, and project deliverables.

The position may also include a limited amount of teaching and supervision in areas related to your expertise.

Your competenciesWe expect you to have:

  • A PhD in Electrical Engineering, Energy Engineering, or a closely related field.
  • Documented experience in power electronics, power converter modelling and control, converter synchronization, signal processing, EMI/EMC, or related areas.
  • Strong programming and experimental skills using DSP, MATLAB/Simulink, PLECS, hardware-in-the-loop implementation or comparable tools.
  • Experience with one or more relevant methods, such as synchronization and coordination control, digital signal processing, time-frequency analysis, data-driven modelling, or machine learning.
  • Good knowledge of battery storage systems or multi-converter systems; experience with synchronization control, hierarchical control, hardware design, or AI-assisted signal would be an advantage.
  • A strong scientific publication record appropriate to your career stage.
  • The ability to conduct independent research, collaborate across disciplines, and communicate effectively with academic and industrial partners.
  • Excellent written and spoken English.

You are not expected to be an expert in all technical areas covering power electronics, acoustic/vibration sensing, signal processing, or machine learning. Strong competence in power converter control and synchronization, together with solid experimental skills and the ability to work across sensing, EMI/EMC, and system-level interactions, is particularly important. We value scientific independence, critical thinking, strong experimental skills, and a rigorous approach to modelling, implementation, validation, and documentation.

Who we areThe position will be based in the section for “Applied Power Electronic Systems” at Department of Energy in Aalborg University (AAU Energy). AAU Energy is an international research department at Aalborg University dedicated to developing clean and sustainable energy systems across electrical, thermal, and mechatronic energy technologies. We offer an interdisciplinary research environment, advanced laboratory facilities, and extensive collaboration with industry and academic partners. The department has campuses in Aalborg and Esbjerg; this position is based at the Aalborg campus. Read more at www.energy.aau.dk

Qualification requirements Appointment as postdoc requires academic qualifications at PhD level.

How to apply  Your application must include the following: 

  • Application, stating reasons for applying, qualifications in relation to the position, and intentions and visions for the position 
  • Curriculum Vitae (CV) 
  • Diplomas (master's degree diploma and PhD diploma) 
  • Documentation of teaching qualifications if relevant.
  • Dissemination qualifications, including participation on committees or boards, participation in organisations etc. 
  • Additional qualifications in relation to the position 
  • References/recommendations 

You can read more about the requirements for your application here.    

The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website.  

Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position. 

Aalborg University has a policy of parallel language use. International staff are encouraged, with support from the university, to learn Danish during their employment in order to support their integration into the workplace and Danish society. 

Danish language courses will be offered as part of the employment. 

Do you have any questions? If you have any questions about the position, you are more than welcome to contact us. You will find contact persons at the bottom of the jobpost.     

Further information Read more about our recruitment process here   

The appointment process at Aalborg University involves a shortlisting process. You can read more about the shortlisting and appointment process here.  

The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace. 

Salary and terms of employment  The employment is in accordance with the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities and the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities. Furthermore, your terms of employment and salary are in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations and the state (AC collective agreement) and protocol on certain terms of employment of academic staff at universities.

You can find information about the salary and salary structure for the position in the Salary Overview for Recruitment - Scientific positions (VIP). Please refer to the introductory section of the page and the section entitled “Postdoc”.

There is a mutual probationary period of 3 months for the position.

Aalborg University - Knowledge for the worldAalborg University is an international workplace with more than 3,700 employees. We offer real-world-oriented education and create world-class research results through collaboration between researchers, students, and public and private companies. This is how we achieve insights, new solutions to societal problems, and knowledge that changes the world. Our main campus is in Aalborg, but we also have campuses in Esbjerg and Copenhagen.

Key Responsibilities

•         Conduct regular QA/QC inspections of passive fire protection and insulation works on-site.

•         Verify that installations comply with approved drawings, installation instructions, project specifications, and applicable requirements.

•         Identify non-conformities and follow up on corrective actions to ensure proper close-out.

•         Prepare and maintain quality documentation, inspection records, and reports, including the registration and follow-up of quality-related issues in Dalux and BIM models.

•         Provide technical guidance to installers on approved installation methods and demonstrate correct workmanship when required.

•         Coordinate with the project team regarding technical clarifications, site activities, and quality-related matters.

About You

We are looking for a responsible, structured, and solution-oriented individual with strong attention to detail. You are comfortable working both on construction sites and in a site office, and you can communicate effectively with different trades and project stakeholders.

We expect you to:

•         Have a good technical understanding and a strong interest in quality assurance and quality control.

•         Be able to read and interpret construction drawings and technical documentation.

•         Work independently, systematically, and take ownership of your tasks.

•         Communicate effectively in English or Danish, both verbally and in writing.

•         Be comfortable using digital tools for inspections and quality documentation.

•         Be confident in guiding installers and following up on the quality of completed work.

 

It would be an advantage if you have:

•         Previous experience in QA/QC, quality inspections, or construction site supervision.

•         Knowledge of passive fire protection, insulation, or similar construction activities.

•         Experience working with Dalux and BIM.

•         Hands-on construction site experience, including providing technical guidance to installers.

•         Good Danish language skills and knowledge of additional languages.

A specific educational background is not required. We value relevant practical experience, technical understanding, and the right attitude.

What We Offer

•         A permanent, full-time position with a minimum of 37 working hours per week.

•         Start date as soon as possible or by agreement.

•         Competitive salary based on qualifications and experience, including pension and other employment benefits in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and employment contract.

•         Company phone and the possibility of a company vehicle, depending on project requirements.

•         A varied workday combining on-site inspections with office-based QA/QC activities.

•         A supportive and informal working environment with opportunities for professional development.

About Firesafe Danmark A/S

Firesafe Danmark A/S specialises in passive fire protection and related technical services within the construction industry.

Our work contributes to protecting people, buildings, and assets by ensuring that fire protection systems are correctly installed, inspected, and documented in accordance with project specifications and applicable requirements.

You will become part of a team where quality, teamwork, and accountability are at the core of our daily operations.

How to Apply

Interested in joining our team?

Please submit your CV along with a short description of your motivation for applying to info@firesafe.dk

If you have any questions about the position, feel free to contact Søren Christiansen soeren.christiansen@firesafe.dk for further information.

We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Lead Game Programmer
description:
Do you love designing clean game architecture, building multiplayer systems that run smoothly, and helping a team of programmers make the right technical decisions? Great! Let’s talk.Triband is the award-winning studio behind the WHAT THE? comedy game series, played by millions worldwide. From our home in central Copenhagen, more than 60 wonderful humans are united by a simple mission: to make everyone laugh.We're building something unannounced, exciting, thoroughly goofy, and built to be played together online. We're now looking for a Lead Game Programmer to help building the underlying systems that make it all work, from the core architecture to the multiplayer tech that connects our players. You'll stay hands-on in the code and the Unity editor while helping the programming team make good technical decisions, stay aligned, and build systems that support creative experimentation. And just to be very clear: this is a technical leadership role, not a people-management position.Here’s what that looks like day to day

  • In collaboration with game designers, artists, and other programmers, you’ll build new features and systems and continuously iterate on improvements. We all work in Unity with C#, with every team member hands-on in the editor

  • You’ll set and communicate the project’s technical direction, turning creative goals and production needs into clear technical priorities

  • You’ll help the programming team make architectural decisions, align around shared patterns, and navigate trade-offs between long-term code health and short-term needs

  • You’ll review and improve technical solutions, share best practices, and support other programmers without becoming a gatekeeper or bottleneck

  • You’ll proactively identify technical risks, messy systems, and missing foundations, and take responsibility for addressing them at the right time

  • Overall, you’ll make sure the project is technically healthy and maintain the codebase in a way that makes it easy for others to build on

This includes things like...

  • Designing an architecture that allows for easy gameplay implementation and flexibility

  • Implementing and maintaining online features such as matchmaking, invites and friends

  • Profiling and improving network performance, bandwidth and latency, and making sure the game holds up on real-world connections

  • Breaking down complex technical challenges, helping decide what to prioritise, and ensuring important decisions are understood by the people they affect

  • Staying close to the actual game: writing production code, debugging difficult problems, and improving systems as the project evolves

You’re a great match if

  • You have at least ten years of professional game development experience across multiple shipped games and different stages of development, including significant technical ownership or leadership on a project

  • You have experience setting technical direction and helping a programming team make and implement architectural decisions, with strong judgment in balancing flexibility, maintainability, performance and the needs of a creative production

  • You're highly proficient in C# and have deep knowledge of the Unity engine and editor

  • You've shipped at least one online multiplayer game, had real ownership of its networking/online systems, and have hands-on experience with a Unity multiplayer framework (e.g., Coherence)

  • You communicate clearly and can explain technical decisions and trade-offs to programmers and non-programmers alike

Nice to haves

  • You have experience shipping iOS and macOS apps, including hands-on integration of Apple platform services such as GameKit and the Game Controller framework using Xcode and Swift

  • Experience with backend services, dedicated servers or cloud hosting for online games

  • Interest in multiplayer game design and social features

  • Experience working with automated build pipelines such as Jenkins

  • Experience building systemic or open-world games

What always matters to us at Triband

  • You thrive in taking ownership of your area: you spot problems, seek advice when needed, and implement creative solutions that push projects forward

  • You’re motivated by collaboration, mutual respect, inclusiveness and creativity while actively contributing to sustaining that culture

  • You believe games are made by teams, not rockstars and that great ideas can come from anyone

  • You bring curiosity, generosity, and flexibility, along with strong opinions, especially when they come with reasoning, openness, and a willingness to actually test them

  • You love exploration and experimentation but don’t get too precious when the evidence tells you you’re wrong

  • You value a positive work environment and contribute to keeping the studio a fun and supportive place to be

Practicalities

  • We work on-site at our cozy office in central Copenhagen.

  • For this role we also consider people located outside of Denmark and provide financial (and moral!) support with visa application and relocation.

  • We work a 37-hour work week, with core hours 10-15, and the freedom to start and finish anywhere between 7 and 18.

  • Our working language is English.

We offer

  • Silly but ambitious projects, and the chance to work on and impact great games that reach millions of players.

  • A playful and ambitious work environment where experimentation is encouraged.

  • Friendly and kind colleagues who love making each other laugh as much as making games.

  • A professional development budget to invest in your growth.

  • Social activities like Friday bars, hobby nights, board game nights, team events, you name it.

  • Daily lunch at a local restaurant just a walk across the lakes away, with plant-based options (and soft ice on Thursdays).

  • Six weeks of vacation (five standard plus one extra on us).

  • Paid parental leave at full salary for the periods covered by state reimbursement.

  • Child's first sick day on us, no questions asked.

  • Pension plan and private health insurance.

  • Endless amounts of Faxe Kondi.

WHAT THE TRIBAND?Triband is the award-winning studio behind the WHAT THE? comedy game series, which is played by millions worldwide. From our home in central Copenhagen, more than 60 wonderful humans are united by our mission to make everyone laugh. To do so, we focus on exploring comedy through gameplay. We like to break player expectations, use wonderful music, slick art, and create a quirky atmosphere. We experiment a lot, and it doesn't always work out, but we always learn something.We put people first and strive to create a safe and creative working environment. We believe that teams, not individuals, make games, and we believe diversity makes for better teams. For these reasons, we look for people who bring new perspectives and will challenge us and our way of doing things.For more info about Triband, check out: triband.net/about

title: Produktionsmedarbetare till industrin i Vasaregionen
description: Vi söker motiverade och pålitliga produktionsmedarbetare för våra kundföretags behov i Vasaregionen. Vi rekryterar kontinuerligt medarbetare till varierande arbetsuppgifter inom industri, energiteknik, metallindustri, elektronikindustri, montering, logistik och produktionsstöd hos några av regionens mest betydande arbetsgivare.Genom denna ansökan blir du en del av vårt kandidatnätverk, vilket gör det möjligt för oss att matcha dig med arbetsmöjligheter som motsvarar din kompetens, erfarenhet och dina karriärmål. Du kan vara en erfaren industrimedarbetare eller i början av din yrkeskarriär.Vi värdesätter särskilt:- Ett initiativrikt, ansvarsfullt och säkert arbetssätt- Noggrannhet, pålitlighet och kvalitetsmedvetenhet- En positiv attityd och vilja att lära sig nytt- God fysisk grundkondition- Beredskap att arbeta i skift- Förmåga att följa säkerhetsföreskrifter och arbetsinstruktioner- Kunskaper i svenska, finska och/eller engelska beroende på arbetsuppgiftTidigare erfarenhet från produktions-, industri- eller lagermiljö samt lämplig utbildning ses som en fördel, men är inte ett krav i alla uppdrag. title: UN Human Rights Advocacy
description: (1) conduct interdisciplinary research, collaborate with other NGOs (especially local and national) which share the same mission, and write reports to the relevant UN human rights mechanisms, in order to contribute to the enforcement of the relevant UN conventions surrounding "organized covert torture"as defined in the following report of our NGO to the UN Human Rights Committee:https://tbinternet.ohchr.org/_layouts/15/treatybodyexternal/Download.aspx?symbolno=INT%2FCCP R%2FICS%2FTHA%2F70410&Lang=en(2) present oral statements on organized covert torture at the relevant UN human rights mechanisms;(3) write the application for the UN ECOSOC consultative status by May, 2027; conduct all the required follow-up with the application.(4) reach out to and collaborate with other NGOs with the same or similar missions across the globe, to promote the enforcement of the relevant UN conventions to end organized covert torture in the countries that ratified the said UN conventions, through the criminal prosecution of the perpetrators;(5) engage in (mostly online) media campaign to elucidate the internal mechanism of organized covert torture, structurally caused and undergirded by psychosocial disability discrimination, and to report our NGO's progress at the UN while raising social awareness on this subject.Eligibilities:1. at least a bachelor degree in a relevant field, such as international human rights law, political science and sociology (such as the sociology of law). Interdisciplinary education on human rights is highly appreciated. 2. experiences (at least one year) in advocacy for organized overt torture victims at the UN human rights mechanisms, including writing shadow reports.Please include in the emailed application:1. the URL of your report on organized covert torture on the website of the UN Office of the High Commissioner for Human Rights, such as the human rights treaty body database URL that contains the report you drafted on behalf of an NGO.2. the C.V. 3. the digital copy of the diploma.Further informations:The duration of the work contract is 2 years, not permanent.HomeworkAbout the employer:Ending Organized Covert Torture (https://www.uid.admin.ch/Detail.aspx?uid_id=CHE-418.021.541) is a small international human rights NGO (UN Partner ID: 40942; Canadian Corporation number: 1830473-4).

title: Kokki, Porvoon Rosso / Kock, Rosso i Borgå
description: Primary location:PORVOOHAETAAN KOKKIA PORVOON ROSSOON, 20 H / VK, VAKITUINEN TYÖSUHDEHaluatko olla mukana luomassa annoksia ja ravintolaelämyksiä, joiden vuoksi asiakkaat palaavat meille yhä uudelleen? Etsimme nyt kokkia vakituiseen työsuhteeseen Porvoon Rossoon.Rosso Porvoossa laatu, hyvä ruoka ja lämmin asiakaspalvelu ovat sydämen asioita. Tiimissämme tehdään töitä yhdessä, autetaan toisiamme ja otetaan uudet työkaverit vastaan avosylin.Rosson monipuoliselta ruokalistalta löytyy herkullisia à la carte -annoksia, pastoja ja pizzoja. Rosso Porvoo tunnetaan myös maukkaista pihveistään, jotka ovat vuosien aikana saavuttaneet vankan suosion asiakkaidemme keskuudessa. Toivomme, että sinulla on kokemusta näiden annosten valmistamisesta ja ylpeyttä laadukkaasta käsityöstä.Työhön kuuluu ruoanvalmistuksen lisäksi esivalmisteluja, astiahuoltoa sekä varastonhallintaa. Tehtävä sopii henkilölle, joka viihtyy vauhdikkaassa ympäristössä ja nauttii ravintola-alan monipuolisesta arjesta. Työvuoroja on erityisesti iltaisin ja viikonloppuisin, jolloin ravintolamme on parhaimmillaan täynnä elämää.Tule mukaan Rosso Porvoon tarinaan tekemään makumuistoja yhdessä timanttisen tiimin kanssa.Mitä toivomme sinulta?- Kohtaat sekä asiakkaat että työkaverit sydän kohdallaan <3- Kokemusta kokin työstä sekä à la carte -annosten, pizzojen valmistuksesta.- Reipasta ja oma-aloitteista työotetta: osaat tarttua tehtäviin ja pidät huolta työpisteestäsi.- Työssä kävellään ja kannetaan paljon, joten hyvä fyysinen kunto on eduksi.- Halua oppia uutta ja kehittyä osana tiimiä.- Suomen kielen taito, jotta pääset helposti mukaan tiimimme arkeen ja yhteiseen tekemiseen.Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?- Työpaikan, johon kiva tulla ja myös kiva lähteä kotiin.- Tiimiä, jossakaveria ei jätetäja jossa esihenkilöt ovat mukana arjen tekemisessä.- Alennuksia S-ryhmän tuotteista ja palveluista eli esimerkiksi ruoasta, elektroniikasta, ravintoloista, hotelleista ja monesta muusta mukavasta asiasta.- MaRa:ntyöehtosopimuksen mukaista palkkausta joka on kokemusvuosista riippuen 13,32 €/h - 14,62 €/h + työaikalisät- 5 % kielilisä, jos asiakaspalvelu onnistuu vähintään suomeksi ja ruotsiksi.- Koko henkilökunnan yhteistä tulospalkkiota, jopa 1,70 € / tehty työtunti yrityksentuloksen ja toimialakohtaisten mittarienperusteella.- Kulttuuri- hyvinvointi- ja liikuntaetuja.Jätä siis hakemuksesi, jos haluat liittyä joukkoon, jossa laatu, tiimihenki ja asiakaskokemus ovat kaiken tekemisen ytimessä.Etenemme rekrytoinnissa jo hakuaikana, joten jätä hakemuksesi mahdollisimman pian, mutta viimeistään 22.11.2026. Tarkempia tietoja tehtävästä antaa ravintolapäällikkö Sari Luhanko, sari.luhanko@sok.fi. Työt alkavat sopimuksen mukaan.---VI SÖKER EN KOCK TILL ROSSO BORGÅ, 20 H/VECKA, FAST ANSTÄLLNINGVill du vara med och skapa rätter och restaurangupplevelser som får kunderna att komma tillbaka till oss gång på gång? Vi söker nu en kock för fast anställning till Rosso Borgå.På Rosso Borgå är kvalitet, god mat och varm kundservice hjärtesaker. I vårt team arbetar vi tillsammans, hjälper varandra och tar emot nya kollegor med öppna armar.Rossos mångsidiga meny bjuder på läckra à la carte-rätter, pastarätter och pizzor. Rosso Borgå är också känt för sina smakrika biffar, som under årens lopp har vunnit stor popularitet bland våra kunder. Vi hoppas att du har erfarenhet av att tillreda dessa rätter och är stolt över kvalitativt hantverk.Utöver matlagning hör förberedelser, diskunderhåll och lagerhantering till arbetet. Uppgiften passar dig som trivs i en fartfylld miljö och njuter av restaurangbranschens mångsidiga vardag. Arbetspassen infaller särskilt på kvällar och helger, när vår restaurang är som mest full av liv.Följ med på Rosso Borgås berättelse och skapa smakminnen tillsammans med ett fantastiskt team.Vad önskar vi av dig?- Du möter både kunder och kollegor med hjärtat på rätt ställe. <3- Erfarenhet av arbete som kock samt av tillredning av à la carte-rätter och pizzor.- Ett raskt och initiativrikt arbetssätt: du tar tag i uppgifter och håller ordning på din arbetsstation.- Arbetet innebär mycket gående och bärande, så god fysisk kondition är en fördel.- Vilja att lära dig nytt och utvecklas som en del av teamet.- Kunskaper i finska, så att du enkelt kommer med i teamets vardag och gemensamma arbete.Vad erbjuder vi dig?- En arbetsplats dit det är roligt att komma och också roligt att gå hem från.- Ett team där ingen lämnas i sticket och där cheferna är med i vardagen.- Rabatter på S-gruppens produkter och tjänster, det vill säga till exempel på mat, elektronik, restauranger, hotell och mycket annat trevligt.- Lön enligt MaRas kollektivavtal, som beroende på erfarenhetsår är 13,32 €/h – 14,62 €/h + arbetstidstillägg.- 5 % språktillägg om kundservicen fungerar på minst finska och svenska.- En gemensam resultatpremie för hela personalen, upp till 1,70 € / arbetad timme, baserat på företagets resultat och branschspecifika mätare.- Kultur-, välbefinnande- och motionsförmåner.Lämna alltså in din ansökan om du vill ansluta dig till ett gäng där kvalitet, laganda och kundupplevelse är kärnan i allt vi gör.Vi framskrider med rekryteringen redan under ansökningstiden, så lämna in din ansökan så snart som möjligt, men senast 22.11.2026. Närmare information om tjänsten ger restaurangchef Sari Luhanko, sari.luhanko@sok.fi. Arbetet börjar enligt överenskommelse.

title: Principal Technical Consultant, Google Cloud (GCP)

We look forward to hearing from professionals who are passionate about cloud technology, technical leadership, and helping clients succeed through innovation and modern engineering practices.Recruitment is managed by Barona IT Talent on behalf of its client.

description: Haemme asiakasyrityksellemme kunnossapitoasentajaa vakituiseen työsuhteeseen. Työhösi sisältyy myös jyrsintä ja sorvaus manuaalikoneilla sekä mahdollisesti hitsausta sekä muita koneistajan tehtäviä.Reissutyön luonteen vuoksi työaika on joustava. Työt alkavat sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.Palkkaasi vaikuttaa koulutuksesi ja kokemuksesi vastaavanlaisista töistä. Palkassasi noudatetaan teknologiateollisuuden työehtosopimusta, alkaen 15,62 euroa tunnilta.Yritys on erikoistunut teollisuuden kunnossapitoon ja vaativiin korjaustöihin. Yritys huoltaa ja koneistaa teollisuuden laitteita sekä tekee korjaushitsauksia, pinnoituksia ja asennuksia. Yritys tarjoaa monipuolisia tehtäviä erilaisissa projekteissa sekä mahdollisuus kehittää ammattitaitoasi.Työkieli on suomi, työtehtävät ja työssä käytettävät työohjeet ovat suomenkielisiä, joten tehtävässä tarvitaan riittävää suomen kielen taitoa.**Parhaiten kunnossapitoasentajan tehtävässä onnistut, jos sinulla on:**- Aiempaa kokemusta teollisuuden kunnossapitotehtävistä - Soveltuvaa koulutusta - Työpiirustusten lukutaitoa - Valmiutta liikkuvaan työhön **Tämä kunnossapitoasentajan tehtävä tarjoaa sinulle:**- Majoituksen matkustuskohteissa - Pääset kehittämään ammattitaitoasi koulutuksen ja perehdytyksen avulla - Ammattitaitosi mukaisen palkkauksen - Vakituisen työsuhteen **Kiinnostuitko työtehtävästä? Tavoitat minut parhaiten ma - pe klo 09.00 - 15.00: 050 380 2656 / Anne Järvelä. Voit myös lähettää viestin sähköpostilla osoitteeseen hr.alrekry@alrekry.fi.Etsitään sinulle yhdessä mieleisesi työpaikka! Pitkä kokemuksemme on osoittanut, että voit luottaa meihin.Tavoitteemme on luoda mahdollisuuksia jokaiselle työntekijällemme onnistua työssään. Alrekyllä on jatkuvasti uusia työpaikkoja monien alojen työntekijöille. Olemme parhaiten edustettuna palvelu-, logistiikka-, teollisuus-, metalli- ja elintarvikealoilla.Alrekry -_Hyvää työtä tarjolla_\-

title: Metallityöntekijä
description: Haetaan metallipajalleen työntekijää monipuolisiin metallialan avustaviin ja valmistaviin työtehtäviin. Työ soveltuu myös henkilölle, jolla ei vielä ole pitkää kokemusta metallialalta mutta joka on motivoitunut oppimaan käytännön työssä.**Työtehtävät**Työhön kuuluu muun muassa:- metallimateriaalien käsittelyä, siirtämistä ja valmistelua - mittaamista, sahaamista, poraamista ja hiontaa - kappaleiden valmistelua hitsausta varten - hitsattujen kappaleiden puhdistusta ja viimeistelyä - pintakäsittelyn valmistelutöitä - työvälineiden ja työpisteen kunnossapitoa sekä muita metallipajan työtehtäviä. Työtehtäviin perehdytetään käytännössä. Itsenäistä hitsaustaitoa ei edellytetä. Koneita ja laitteita käytetään vasta asianmukaisen perehdytyksen jälkeen.**Odotamme hakijalta**Huolellista ja turvallista työskentelyotetta, luotettavuutta, halua oppia uusia työtehtäviä sekä kykyä tehdä fyysistä metallipajatyötä. Aikaisempi kokemus metallialalta katsotaan eduksi, mutta se ei ole välttämätöntä.Työtehtävien turvallinen ymmärtäminen ja annettujen ohjeiden noudattaminen ovat välttämättömiä. Perehdytys voidaan järjestää työntekijän kielitaito huomioiden.**Työsuhde:** Toistaiseksi voimassa oleva, kokoaikainen **Työaika:** Maanantaista perjantaihin klo 7.00–15.00, sisältäen 30 minuutin palkattoman ruokatauon. Säännöllinen työaika 37,5 tuntia viikossa.**Palkka:** Aloituspalkka 11,00 €/h brutto tai sovellettavan työehtosopimuksen edellyttämä korkeampi palkka. Palkkaa tarkistetaan osaamisen, kokemuksen, työn vaativuuden ja itsenäisen työskentelyn kehittyessä. **Työehtosopimus:** Teknologiateollisuuden työntekijöiden työehtosopimus.

title: Työkalu- ja kuljetuskoordinaattori
description: Etsimme Vantaan Truck Centeriin motivoitunutta ja huolellista henkilöä, jonka tehtävänä on huolehtia jätehuollosta, työkalujen hallinnasta ja huollosta sekä varaosien toimittamisesta ja kuljettamisesta. Työ sisältää muun muassa eri jakeiden (metalli, pahvi, energiajae, lasi, puu ja muut korjaamon jätteet) kuljettamista jätepisteelle, pahvipaalien siirtämistä keräyspisteeseen sekä jätepisteiden siisteyden ja järjestyksen ylläpitoa. Lisäksi tehtävään kuuluu jäteastioiden täyttöasteen seuranta ja tyhjennystarpeista ilmoittaminen sekä yleisen siisteyden vaaliminen. Vastuullasi on korjaamon työkalujen järjestäminen, työkalupisteiden ylläpito sekä rikkoontuneiden työkalujen ilmoittaminen ja vaihtaminen. Osaat huoltaa, puhdistaa ja tarkastaa työkalujen kunnon. Eduksi katsomme kokemuksen kuljetus ja korjaamo ympäristöstä.Odotamme sinulta oma-aloitteisuutta, tarkkuutta ja kykyä toimia tiimissä. Kokemus vastaavista tehtävistä katsotaan eduksi, mutta tärkeintä on reipas asenne ja halu oppia uutta. Tehtävä on keskeinen rooli korjaamolla, jotta korjaamolla työt päästään tekemään sujuvasti.Tarjoamme sinulle:- Ison talon edut, tuen ja turvan- Mukavat ja osaavat työkaverit- Työtäsi arvostavat asiakkaat ja työnantajan- Vakaan työnantajan, joka on sitoutunut turvallisuuteesi ja hyvinvointiisi- Valoisat, viihtyisät ja siistit tilat- Oman huoltokoulun alan parhaan koulutustarjonnanTarjoamme sinulle mukavan ja rennon työyhteisön, hyvän perehdytyksen tehtävääsi sekä ajantasaiset tietojärjestelmät, joilla teet työtäsi. Tule osaksi osaavaa ja mukavaa joukkoamme! Täytä hakemuksesi jo tänään tai viimeistään 29.11.2026. Käsittelemme hakemuksia jo hakuaikana ja täytämme tehtävän heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä. title: Raskaskoneasentaja, Kankaanpää
description: Raskaan kaluston asentaja vakituiseen työsuhteeseen. Etsitkö vakaata työpaikkaa, jossa on reilu meininki, mahdollisuus kehittyä ja osaamista arvostava palkkaus?Asiakkaamme on pitkään toiminut ja hyvämaineinen huoltokorjaamo, joka etsii nyt tiimiinsä kokoaikaista ja vakituista raskaan kaluston asentajaa. Tässä roolissa pääset työskentelemään monipuolisesti kuorma-autojen, perävaunujen ja erilaisten työkoneiden parissa. Työskentelet pääasiassa arkipäivisin klo 7.00–17.30 välillä. Toivomme kuitenkin joustavuutta, sillä työpäivien pituudet saattavat vaihdella työtilanteen mukaan. Tulevaisuudessa yrityksessä on mahdollista siirtyä 2-vuorotyöhön, ja toisinaan töitä tehdään myös viikonloppuisin. Saat vahvan tuen ja perusteellisen perehdytyksen – meillä kaveria ei jätetä yksin. Palkkaus määräytyy AKT:n huoltokorjaamoalan työehtosopimuksen ja kokemuksesi mukaan. Erikoisosaamisesta olemme valmiita maksamaan erillistä ekstraa.Mikäli muutat työn perässä toiselta paikkakunnalta, voimme auttaa sinua asunnon hankinnassa. Odotamme sinulta alan koulutusta ja jonkin verran aikaisempaa työkokemusta raskaan kaluston parista, oikeaa asennetta ja vastuuntuntoa sekä tiimihenkeä. Suomen kielen C1 (Taitavan kielitaidon perustaso) vaaditaan työturvallisuuden vuoksi, sekä sujuvaan kommunikointiin muiden työntekijöiden ja asiakkaiden kanssa. Mikäli tämä työ kiinnostaa sinua, laita hakemuksesi tulemaan samantien sillä käymme niitä läpi jo hakuaikana ja paikka täytetään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä. Toivomme sinulta:- Hyvää asennetta ja halua sitoutua mukavaan työpaikkaan ja työympäristöön- Joustavuutta työaikojen suhteen- Voimassa olevaa Työturvallisuuskorttia- Hyvää fyysistä kuntoa- Ajokorttia c-kortti iso plussa hakijalle- Oma-aloitteisuutta ja ahkeruutta- Mielellään kokemusta raskaan kaluston asennuksista  Tarjoamme sinulle: - Luotettavan ja hyvän työnantajan- Kattavan perehdytyksen työhön- Laadukkaat työvarusteet- Mahdollisuuden työllistyä pitkäaikaiseen työhön- Työterveyshuollon Palkkausperuste: Tuntipalkka 16,47-19,85 €/hBenevanilla arvostamme: - Luotettavuutta - tehdään mitä sovitaan- Asennetta -teet aina parhaasi ja olet oma-aloitteinen- Työturvallisuutta - arvostamme työntekijöitä, joille työturvallisuus on tärkeää- Uskallus tarttua uusiin haasteisiin

title: Vårdare
description: Vi söker en vårdare med närvårdarutbildning till Octavens verksamhetscenter. Arbetet är i allmän arbetstid, dagtid måndag-fredag.Octavens serviceenhet på Lästmakarvägen 19, är en svenskspråkig enhet som erbjuder dagverksamhet för personer med intellektuella funktionsvariationer. Enheten sysselsätter cirka 25 servicetagare i fem basgrupper med olika inriktningar. Nu söker vi en vårdare som vill bli en del av vårt team på åtta personer.Du kommer i först hand att jobba i en basgrupp som erbjuder sysselsättning i varierande former, men även enskilt med personer inom autismspektrumet. Du bör vara trygg i dig själv och din arbetsroll samt förstå innebörden av lågaffektivt bemötande. I arbetet ingår också hjälp och stöd i personlig vård. Har du erfarenhet eller intresse av att lära dig om arbete med personer med intellektuella funktionsvariationer så är du den rätta personen för oss. Vi erbjuder dig ett meningsfullt och varierande jobb med engagerade kollegor. Du får ta del av Helsingfors stads mångsidiga utbildnings- och utvecklingsmöjligheter samt personalförmåner som t.ex. kultur- och motionsförmåner, rabatt till kollektivtrafiken och cykelförmån. Närvårdares yrkesutbildning och registrering i Valviras centralregister över yrkesutbildade personer.Goda muntliga och skriftliga kunskaper i svenska samt nöjaktiga muntliga och skriftliga kunskaper i finskaDen sökande ska före antagningsbeslutet förete företagshälsovårdens bedömning om sina förutsättningar att sköta uppgiften.Personen som blir vald till tjänsten måste före arbetsförhållandet börjar presentera arbetsgivaren med ett bevis på drogtest.I uppgiften krävs vaccineringsskydd enligt lagen om smittsamma sjukdomar 48 §, samt utredning över tuberkulos enligt 55§.Den som blir vald till tjänsten bör innan hen tar emot tjänsten, uppvisa ett brottsregisterutdrag för dem som arbetar med personer med funktionsnedsättning (lagen om tillsyn över social- och hälsovårdstjänster 741/2023, 28 §).I uppgiften krävs att LOP/LOVe LOP-läkemedelstillståndet genomförs godkänt inom prövotiden.Vi räknar som en merit:Tidigare arbetserfarenhet inom branschen.Vi värdesätter mångfald och jämställdhet i vår arbetsgemenskap. Vi välkomnar sökande av olika åldrar och kön, personer med funktionsnedsättning samt personer som tillhör olika språkliga, kulturella eller eventuellt andra minoriteter. Vi strävar efter att garantera en lättillgänglig rekryteringsprocess för alla sökande. Om du behöver anpassningar eller har önskemål gällande tillgängligheten under ansökningsprocessen, kan du kontakta oss via e-post på: sotepe.monimuotoinen.rekrytointi@hel.fi. Meddelandena hanteras separat från den rekryterande enheten, och kontakten vidarebefordras inte till den rekryterande förpersonen utan den sökandes samtycke.

title: Vårdare

Arbetet är i allmän arbetstid, dagtid, i regel måndag-fredag. Arbetsspråket är svenska. Treklangens arbets- och dagverksamhet är en svenspråkig enhet och finns på Kånalavägen i Kånala, Helsingfors. Vi erbjuder arbetsverksamhet samt dagverksamhet för vuxna personer med intellektuella funktionsvariationer. Enheten sysselsätter cirka 55 klienter i sex basgrupper med olika inriktningar. Nu söker vi en vårdare till vårt team inom Stukturverksamheten. Vi söker dig som är pedagogisk, strukturerad och har förmåga att planera och leda en målmedveten verksamhet som engagerar, motiverar och utvecklar klienter. Har du erfarenhet eller intresse av att lära dig om arbete med personer inom autismspektrum så är du den rätta personen för oss.Vi söker en arbetstagare som är trygg i sig själv och sin arbetsroll samt vet innebörden av lågaffektivt bemötande. Inom strukturverksamheten lägger vi mycket fokus på den enskilda individens behov och utvecklar verksamheten utgående från det. Till arbetsuppgifter hör bland annat att planera samt utföra verksamhet, både i individuellt jobb med klienter och grupp samt utveckla meningsfullt innehåll i klienternas vardag på enheten. Hos oss arbetar vi socialpedagogiskt, med fokus på klienternas delaktighet, självbestämmanderätt och valfrihet. Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet och söker dig som är intresserad av att arbeta med människor med funktionsvariationer och trivs med att jobba med människor. Du är empatisk, har ett gott bemötande och en öppen attityd. Vi värdesätter även ett positivt förhållningssätt och lyhördhet inför klienternas behov. Vi erbjuder dig ett meningsfullt och varierande jobb med engagerade kollegor. Du får ta del av Helsingfors stads mångsidiga utbildnings- och utvecklingsmöjligheter samt personalförmåner som t.ex. kultur- och motionsförmåner, rabatt till kollektivtrafiken och cykelförmån. title: Hydraulic Supplier Development Engineer
description: **Hydraulic Supplier Development Engineer**At Kongsberg Maritime, we are transforming the future of sustainable oceans through innovation, technology, and collaboration. Behind every vessel, propulsion system, and integrated solution stands a network of highly capable suppliers who help us deliver reliability, safety, and performance to customers worldwide.We are looking for a **Hydraulic Supplier Development Engineer** who is passionate about engineering excellence, supplier relationship, and continuous improvement. If you enjoy solving complex technical challenges, influencing global suppliers, and seeing your work make a tangible impact on products operating around the world, this could be your next career move.As a **Hydraulic Supplier Development Engineer**, you will play a key role in developing and strengthening our global supplier network for hydraulic systems and components. You will work at the intersection of engineering, quality, sourcing, and manufacturing, helping suppliers achieve world-class standards while ensuring our products continue to meet the highest expectations for reliability and performance.This is not just a supplier quality role. It is an opportunity to influence technology, shape supplier strategies, and drive long-term business success.**What you will be doing**- Develop and manage suppliers for quality aspects across the global hydraulic supply chain. - Drive supplier capability, quality, delivery performance, and continuous improvement through audits, technical reviews, and development initiatives. - Collaborate with engineering teams and suppliers to ensure manufacturability, product quality, and successful new product introductions. - Strengthen supply chain resilience through risk mitigation, supplier development, and sustainability initiatives. **We think you should have** You combine technical expertise with the ability to influence and develop others. You are comfortable challenging suppliers, facilitating improvements, and building trust-based relationships.- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Hydraulic Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related discipline. - Experience in supplier development, supplier quality, manufacturing engineering, or hydraulic engineering. - Good understanding of hydraulic systems and industrial manufacturing processes. - Strong communication skills and ability to work effectively in an international environment. - Experience within maritime, offshore, heavy machinery, automation, or industrial equipment industries is an advantage. - Knowledge of quality methodologies such as APQP, PPAP, FMEA, FAIR, 8D, Lean, or Six Sigma. - Willingness to travel to supplier locations when needed. - Fluent in written and spoken English **Why join us**- **Make an impact** – Help shape technologies that power vessels and marine operations worldwide. - **Work globally** – Collaborate with suppliers, engineers, and manufacturing teams across an international network. - **Grow your career** – Develop your technical and supplier management expertise within a global technology leader. - **Drive innovation** – Contribute to sustainable maritime solutions through advanced technology and continuous improvement. - **Be empowered** – Join a culture built on trust, collaboration, and opportunities to make a real difference. **What we can offer you** With us, you will be offered a competitive salary, a good benefit package, flexible working hours, and good development opportunities in an international environment. In accordance with our remote work policy, you have the opportunity to work remotely for part of your working time. By choosing Kongsberg Maritime, you will work in an inspiring and safe work environment with sustainable and high-quality solutions for the future.**Where you will be working** This role is preferably based in Rauma, Finland, or Kraków, Poland, although Turku and Espoo, Finland, may also be considered for the right candidate.**Interested in knowing more?** Contact Sanna Kinnunen, SDE Manager, Supply Chain – Thrusters by calling +358504079176 during: 11.11. 8 – 11 am 17.11. 8-12 am 25.11. 8 – 11 am**Ready to make waves?** If you are motivated by technical challenges, passionate about supplier development, and excited about contributing to world-class maritime solutions, we would love to hear from you. Join us and help build the supplier partnerships that power the future of sustainable oceans. Please send in your application through our Careers page by 29.11.2026. Please note, that we will review applications already during application period.**Kongsberg Maritime is a global leader in maritime technology.** We deliver advanced solutions to the merchant fleet, offshore, fishing, and naval vessels, setting new standards for safe, efficient, and sustainable operations - both for new builds and existing fleets. In close collaboration with customers and research environments, we develop technology that solves real challenges at sea. Today, more than **30,000 vessels** operate with our systems on board. Kongsberg Maritime has more than **8,300 employees in 35 countries.**Our **Propulsion and Handling division** delivers world class products for propulsion, handling systems and waterjet for all marine industry sectors including merchant, offshore and naval. Our products enhance operational efficiency and deliver safe, secure, reliable and sustainable products to our valued customers.

title: Manager, Application Security and Data Protection
description: Application security starts with embedding security into development from the very beginning. In this role, you will help application teams and developers make secure choices and put common application security practices into action across K Group. At the same time, you will develop technical data protection controls and take ownership of the Cloudflare platform.What will you do?As Manager, Application Security and Data Protection, you will act as a trusted advisor to application teams, developers and other technical specialists on application security matters. You will help teams identify security risks, interpret common security requirements and find solutions that integrate security into application design, development and the entire application lifecycle.You will define and maintain application security requirements and secure development practices and support their practical adoption. You will advise application teams on topics such as security assessments, threat modelling and security testing. Your role will focus on consulting, guidance and coordination, while application teams, developers and service providers remain responsible for application development and the execution of technical controls and checks.You will help make security a natural part of development and release processes. You will support teams in implementing security controls related to areas such as code, dependencies and configurations, as well as in prioritising findings based on risk.In the area of technical data protection, you will define and coordinate controls related to areas such as data classification, access rights, encryption, retention and secure deletion. You will support application and development teams in interpreting and implementing requirements together with data owners and privacy and legal specialists.One of the key responsibilities of the role is ownership of the Cloudflare platform. You will be responsible for the platform roadmap, service lifecycle, governance model, access rights and vendor collaboration, as well as monitoring service performance and costs. You will guide and coordinate the use of Cloudflare's security capabilities in line with the agreed service scope.You will monitor application security and technical data protection risks, the effectiveness of controls and the progress of development initiatives. You will maintain a prioritised development roadmap and ensure that application security, data protection and the Cloudflare service are integrated with ITSM processes.In this role, you will have a broad impact without direct line management responsibility. Success will depend on your ability to bring the security perspective into discussions at the right time, make requirements understandable and help different teams find appropriate solutions.To succeed in this role, you need practical knowledge of application security and the ability to use your technical expertise to support other teams.We expect you to have: - at least three years of professional experience in roles involving application security and technical data protection - strong understanding of secure development practices, common application vulnerabilities, security testing and risk-based remediation - experience in consulting, supporting or guiding developers, application teams and other technical stakeholders on security matters - experience in platform or service ownership, as well as hands-on experience with Cloudflare or a comparable application security platform - fluency in both Finnish and English, as you will work and communicate with different stakeholders in both languages.You will also benefit from an understanding of web application protection, access management and technical data protection controls.We do not require a specific educational background. Relevant experience and expertise are what matter most.What do we offer?You will take responsibility for application security and technical data protection across K Group, as well as ownership of the Cloudflare platform. You will have the opportunity to shape how security is implemented in application development across different teams. You will build common ways of working and help application teams and developers put them into practice.The role combines technical expertise, consulting, development of operating practices, technology ownership and collaboration with a broad network of stakeholders.We work in a hybrid model, combining office and remote work in a way that suits the role and the team. On office days, you will work at K-Kampus in Kalasatama, Helsinki, with excellent transport connections. The campus offers collaboration and break-out spaces, a gym, occupational health services, a café and a staff restaurant.K Group employee benefits include a mobile phone benefit, Epassi, staff discounts at K Group stores, occupational health services and leisure-time accident insurance. You will also have access to a range of changing partner benefits covering areas such as sports, wellbeing, travel and accommodation, as well as opportunities to develop your expertise through internal training and online learning.Interested?Submit your CV and, if you wish, a free-form application by 20.11.2026.We at K Group value diversity and believe that different backgrounds and perspectives are key to success. We strive to create a work environment where everyone has the opportunity to grow. Equality, non-discrimination, and fairness are our core principles in recruitment, compensation, and career development.

title: Network Engineer (m/w/d) (Techniker/in - Informatik (Netzwerktechnologie)/Bachelor Professional in Technik)

description: Join our team in FinlandAt Cortrium, we are improving cardiac diagnostics with innovative and user-friendly ECG technology used by healthcare professionals in over 20 countries.We are looking for a dedicated nurse or Cardiac Technician with experience in ECG analysis and interpretation to strengthen our team and contribute to our continued growth.About the roleOur ECG Analysis Department is an international team of 40 dedicated professionals based in Denmark, bringing together a diverse range of expertise, including cardiac nurses, cardiac technicians, laboratory technicians, cardiologists, and general practitioners.We are now expanding our operations to Finland, where we are establishing a small, dedicated team.
