title: Director Biostatistician at Asahi Kasei Therapeutics
description: About AKTXAsahi Kasei Therapeutics is the global specialty pharmaceutical business of Asahi Kasei. AKTX is a commercial-stage company committed to positively impacting health by expanding therapeutic options that improve the lives of patients around the world. Drawing upon their strong heritage of scientific innovation, AKTX aim to help reshape care in transplantation, nephrology, immunology, infectious diseases and other underserved conditions.The Asahi Kasei Group operates with a commitment of creating for tomorrow. Their business sectors, Material, Homes, and Health Care, contribute to the development of society by anticipating the changing needs of those around the world. AKTX is looking for candidates that offer a fresh perspective and a variety of skills to help them achieve their commitment.AKTX’s MissionPioneering innovation to continue addressing unmet medical needs, now and into the futureAKTX’s VisionPositively impacting health by expanding therapeutic options that improve the lives of patients around the worldAKTX’s ValuesAgility, Integrity, Innovation, Expertise and AccountabilityDiversity, Equity & InclusionAt Asahi Kasei Therapeutics, they believe that diverse perspectives strengthen innovation and help them better serve patients, colleagues, and communities around the world. They are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone is treated with dignity, respect, and fairness and where all employees can contribute and succeed.AKTX is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome applications from qualified candidates regardless of race, ethnicity, nationality, religion, sex, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.About the position as Director BiostatisticianAs Director Biostatistician, you will be the strategic statistical lead for clinical development programs, responsible for statistical rigor, consistency and quality across all studies within each program. Partnering closely with cross-functional leaders, you will help shape development strategy and guide study designs, as well as recommend the methodologies, estimands and endpoints that best support program objectives.The role also includes overseeing statistical deliverables from internal and external partners, providing clear direction for outsourced work and acting as the escalation point for complex statistical issues. In addition, you will contribute to integrated database planning and, where applicable, the use of external and real-world data, while anticipating data needs for interim analyses, adaptive trials and regulatory interactions.The analyses you oversee will underpin regulatory strategy, publications, safety evaluations and internal decision-making. When engaging with health authorities, you will act as the statistical representative, preparing responses to their questions and attending regulatory meetings in compliance with ICH guidelines and best practices in clinical statistics. Within cross-functional teams, safety review committees and governance meetings, you will translate complex statistical concepts into clear, actionable insights for non-statisticians.Key responsibilities include:    Provide strategic input into clinical development plans, target product profiles, and overall program strategy.    Advise on quantitative decision making, including go/no go criteria, dose selection, and adaptive design strategies.    Collaborate with Clinical Development to design scientifically sound and efficient clinical trials across phases (First-in-Human through registration)    Provide oversight and review of statistical sections of protocols, SAPs, and mock TLFs for individual studies.    Oversee statistical and programming activities conducted by CROs and external vendors across all studies in the program.    Work with Data Management to ensure data collection standards, CDISC compliance, and data structures are optimized for cross study analysis.    Provide clear interpretation and communication of statistical results to clinical, regulatory, and senior leadership stakeholders.    Lead statistical components of regulatory submissions (e.g., IND, CTA, BLA, MAA).    Provide mentorship and guidance to study statisticians and junior team membersAbout youYou have the ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive strategic decisions, and you have a strong collaboration mindset with high attention to scientific and operational quality. You are comfortable with a hands-on role, stepping in as a subject matter expert where needed and you lead with clarity, integrity and accountability. You work well across functions, locations and cultures.Requirements:    MSc or PhD in Biostatistics or Statistics    Significant experience (7+ years) in clinical trial statistics within biotech/pharma.    Proven track record of leading statistical activities across multiple programs.    Strong working knowledge of regulatory guidelines (ICH, FDA, EMA) and statistical principles in drug development.    Expertise in SAS; familiarity with R is beneficial.    Excellent communication, leadership, and problem-solving skills.    Ability to balance hands-on work with strategic program oversightPreferred qualifications:    Demonstrated ability to manage CROs and external statistical partners.    Experience with adaptive or innovative designs.    Exposure to early-stage development or rare/complex diseases.    Experience collaborating with Medical AffairsWhat AKTX offersMake an ImpactContribute to therapies that improve the lives of patients around the world.Build Something NewHelp shape the future of Asahi Kasei Therapeutics as they bring together expertise, people, and capabilities into one global organization.One Global TeamWork alongside colleagues across Europe, the United States, and Japan in a collaborative and inclusive environment.Grow With AKTXEnjoy opportunities for development, flexible working arrangements, and competitive local benefits.

title: Driftchef
description: Park- och trafikavdelningen har ett omfattande ansvar för allt från planering till drift av Gotlands parker, gator och kollektivtrafik. Den 1 januari 2027 införs en ny organisation för att stärka samordningen, tydliggöra ansvarsområden och skapa ett nära ledarskap i vardagen. Vårt mål är att skapa en arbetsplats där medarbetarna trivs och där vi tillsammans gör vårt yttersta för Gotlands bästa.Som en central del i detta söker vi nu en driftchef till vår driftsorganisation. Verksamheten omfattar fyra specialiserade enheter: två parkenheter, en gatuenhet samt en enhet för fordon och anläggning. Uppdraget är brett och ansvarsfullt; det innefattar drift och underhåll av kommunala anläggningar på gatu- och parkmark, yttre underhåll av kommunala fastigheter samt förvaltning av statsbidragsberättigade enskilda vägar. Direkt underställd driftchefen finns tre driftsamordnare, vars främsta uppgift är att effektivt planera och samordna driften.Verksamheten drivs i en kombination av egen regi och externa entreprenörer, där ett strategiskt fokus på effektiv planering och samordning är nyckeln till vår framgång.Dina arbetsuppgifterSom driftschef ansvarar du för planering, ledning, utveckling och uppföljning av den operativa verksamheten inom park-, gatu- och vägdrift samt renhållning i offentlig miljö. Rollen säkerställer att Gotlands offentliga miljöer är säkra, funktionella, attraktiva och väl underhållna i enlighet med lagstiftning, politiska beslut, budget och uppsatta kvalitetsmål. I rollen ingår du i avdelningens ledningsgrupp där chefer med ansvar för planeringsfunktioner ingår samt ansvarar för driftverksamhetens ledningsgrupp. Du förväntas bidra till att utveckla avdelningens verksamhet i sin helhet både kort- och långsiktigt. Samverkan mellan drift och planering är avgörande för att Gotlands offentliga miljöer ska utvecklas och förvaltas framgångsrikt och ett av driftschefens viktigaste fokusområden är att främja till och bidra i denna samverkan.Du har ansvar för personal, ekonomi och budget, arbetsmiljö och säkerställa leverans inom ansvarsområde samt följa upp verksamhetens resultat, ekonomi, kvalitet och måluppfyllelse. I rollen ansvarar du för att beslutsunderlag levereras till avdelningschef, förvaltningsledning och politisk nämnd samt företräda verksamheten i kontakter med myndigheter, organisationer, media, företag och allmänhet med flera. Rollen kräver ett tydligt, närvarande och tillitsbaserat ledarskap samt förmåga att samarbeta, att skapa förtroende hos fackliga parter, medarbetare och externa parter. I rollen kommer du att leda enhetschefer och medarbetare med varierande kompetenser och ansvarsområden. De enhetschefer du leder ansvarar i sin tur för att skapa riktning och struktur, kommunicera mål och förväntningar samt ge medarbetarna stöd och förutsättningar att ta ansvar och utvecklas i sina roller.Vem är du?Tjänsten kräver en person med relevant högskoleutbildning inom samhällsbyggnad, teknik eller anläggning, alternativt motsvarande erfarenhet, samt B-körkort. Personen ska ha flera års erfarenhet av chefsroller inom drift eller entreprenad, med särskilt fokus på budgetansvar, offentlig upphandling och entreprenadstyrning. Goda kunskaper i svenska samt kunskap om lagstiftning rörande arbetsmiljö, miljö och säkerhet är ett krav.Meriterande är certifieringar som BAS-P, BAS-U och projektledarutbildning, samt erfarenhet av att leda andra chefer och arbete inom offentlig sektor. Kunskap om bland annat kommunallagen, trafikförordningen och kalkylering av driftskostnader ses också som ett plus.Som person är du en strukturerad och resultatorienterad ledare med förmåga att motivera andra och kommunicera tydligt. Du är lyhörd och samarbetsvillig i dina sociala kontakter, samtidigt som du besitter en strategisk helhetssyn och kan prioritera utifrån verksamhetens övergripande bästa.Varför välja Region Gotland? Vi är öns största arbetsgivare – med över 200 olika yrken och över 6800 medarbetare i Sveriges enda kombinerade region och kommun. Tillsammans utvecklar vi ett hållbart, tryggt och välmående Gotland för alla som bor på och besöker ön.På Gotland finns ett rikt kulturliv, storslagen natur och en kreativ entreprenörsanda. Över 61 000 personer har valt att kalla Gotland för sitt hem, året runt. Är du inte en av oss än, men nyfiken på att bli? Läs mer om livet på ön på www.gotland.com/flytta-hit Vi värnar om våra medarbetare och är stolta över våra förmåner. Läs gärna mer på www.gotland.se/formanerPå Instagramkontot @viarregiongotland kan du följa våra medarbetare och se bredden i våra olika verksamheter.Så rekryterar viVi arbetar enligt kompetensbaserad rekryteringsmetod och lägger därför stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet i enlighet med de kompetenser som beskrivs i annonsen. På så vis jobbar vi även aktivt för att motverka diskriminering. Vi är måna om säkerhet och kvalité i våra rekryteringar och du kan därför komma att omfattas av kontroller inför anställning. Om det är aktuellt får du mer information av rekryterare. ID-handling och personbevis behöver alltid uppvisas.Tjänsten tillsätts under förutsättning att den inte behöver erbjudas medarbetare med företrädesrätt.

title: Academic Advisor to the Stockholm School of Economics
description: The Education Office (EdO) is one of SSE’s Professional Services units and consists of around 58 colleagues. As a central part of the SSE journey, we support and develop key academic services for students and stakeholders across our BSc, MSc, and PhD programs. Our work spans assessment, program management, scholarships, international collaborations, academic support, central course and exam coordination, as well as degrees and certificates.We are looking for an Academic Advisor to join our Guidance and Wellbeing Office (GWO). As an Academic Advisor at SSE, you will work closely with students across our Bachelor and Master programs, providing guidance and support throughout their studies. The GWO team consists of two Academic Advisors and one Student Wellbeing Counsellor. Together, the team provides a first point of contact for students who need support related to their studies, their individual educational needs, or challenges that may affect their ability to study. The team also coordinates support for students with specific educational needs. As an Academic Advisor, you will:     Provide individual guidance to students on study-related matters, helping them navigate challenges and make informed decisions about their studies.     Meet students with a wide range of needs and circumstances and help identify appropriate forms of support.     Coordinate support for students with specific educational needs and work with relevant colleagues to ensure appropriate arrangements.     Work closely with the Student Wellbeing Counsellor and the other Academic Advisor to provide coordinated support to students.     Guide students to other relevant functions or professional support when their needs fall outside the scope of academic advising.     Collaborate with faculty and other colleagues across SSE on student-related matters.     Contribute to developing routines, information and ways of working within GWO     Participate in preventive and student-focused initiatives aimed at creating good conditions for students to succeed in their studies. What we offer youAt SSE, you’ll join a small, close-knit GWO team and work across a lively academic community. The role combines one-to-one work with students and collaboration with faculty and colleagues throughout the School. You’ll have the opportunity to shape how GWO supports students, develop its ways of working and contribute to initiatives that strengthen the study experience. It’s a varied role with room to take initiative, build strong working relationships and be part of students’ academic journeys.About youYou are an attentive, confident communicator who can build trust while maintaining clear professional boundaries. You are comfortable meeting students with varied needs, including in challenging or sensitive situations.You listen with care, ask thoughtful questions and can work out what kind of guidance or support may be most useful. You are calm and practical when situations are complex, and you enjoy working closely with colleagues who bring different areas of expertise. You are also ready to contribute to initiatives that strengthen students’ wellbeing and study experience.QualificationsWe are looking for someone with:    A Bachelor’s degree in Study and Career Guidance (Swedish: Studie- och yrkesvägledarexamen).    Experience in student support, academic advising, counselling, education or another role involving professional guidance and individual support.    Spoken and written Swedish and English.Meritorious    Knowledge of educational support for students with disabilities or other specific educational needs.    Experience using Nais and Ladok.    Experience working in higher education.Other:This is a full-time, permanent position with an initial six-month probationary period. The position is based in Stockholm and start date is according to agreement.We encourage you to apply promptly as we are actively reviewing applications on an ongoing basis. We look forward to receiving your application.About the Stockholm School of EconomicsThe Stockholm School of Economics is ranked as the top business school in the Nordic and Baltic countries and enjoys a strong international reputation. World-class research forms the foundation of our educational offering, which includes Bachelor, Master, PhD, MBA, and Executive Education programs. Through creativity and collaboration, the Stockholm School of Economics provides an environment where ambitious students and accomplished researchers meet to address contemporary challenges within business and economics, particularly those concerning sustainability, diversity and innovation.Apart from delivering world class education within business and economics, SSE students are trained to be successful decision makers and leaders of the future. Our educational mission has over the years strengthened SSE students, and you can read more about it here.SSE is a member of the Stockholm Dual Career Network (SDCN), a collaboration between universities, research institutes and companies in the Stockholm region. Through SDCN, partners of international recruits are offered professional support in establishing their careers in Sweden, including career coaching, networking opportunities, seminars and access to a broad professional network. We recognize the importance of supporting accompanying partners in international relocations and are committed to facilitating a smooth transition for the whole family.SSE is committed to a balanced gender distribution and values a variety of backgrounds and experiences among our employees. We therefore welcome all applicants regardless of their gender, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, disability, sexual orientation, age, or religion or other beliefs. We strive to have a fair and inclusive recruitment process.

title: Commissioning Engineer
description: We have an exciting opportunity for a Commissioning Engineer to join Suir Engineering. This will be based in Sweden. We deliver leading edge next generation solutions to clients by designing, building, and installing Data Centres, Pharma and Medical Device plants and Renewable Energy Systems.Here in Suir Engineering we are a leading international provider of innovative Mechanical, Electrical and Instrumentation Engineering Solutions. Our core sectors are Energy, Power and Renewables, Pharma, Food & Beverage, and Data Centres. We provide best in class contracting solutions with in-house, flexible resources capable of delivering a personable and consistent service to our customers. Over the past 40 years we have delivered projects for Irish and multinational clients across the globe. We are currently expanding significantly, and are delivering large scale projects across Ireland, the U.K, Germany, Denmark and Sweden.  Overall Role ObjectiveThe Electrical Commissioning Engineer is responsible for the design, development, and maintenance of electrical control systems and/or components to required specifications, focusing on economy, safety, reliability, quality and sustainability. The Senior HV Electrical Commissioning Engineer will be involved in projects from the concept and detail of the design through to implementation, testing and handover. What you will be doing?    Development and review of schematic drawings and single line diagrams    Developing HV system studies including protection coordination, arc flash, voltage regulation, load flow and fault level reports    Pre-commissioning and commissioning of GIS and AIS Substations    Complying with specific project safety requirements    Detailed design covering all aspects of High & Low voltage equipment and control and protection systems    Specification, selection and procurement of the range of equipment    Preparation and interpretation of technical specifications and enquiry documentation    Assist with the preparation of technical and contract documentation for issue.    Monitor progress against the program and issue progress reports.    Prepare method statements and risk assessments..    Liaising and co-ordinating with clients, other members of the design team and contractors on technical issues.    Managing all technical queries on site and assist project team in all site electrical engineering issues to include: the management, the planning, the testing and commissioning and the handover of all project systems..    Plan, schedule, conduct, and coordinate program of assigned engineering work and projects.    Assemble bid, approval, and construction issue drawing packages.    Evaluate the effectiveness of the design and change if necessary.    Estimate cost, reliability, and safety factors.    Use computers extensively to produce and analyse designs.    Supervise technicians and other engineers during development phase.    Build, test and modify product prototypes.    Any other reasonable and relevant duties as requested by your manager, necessary to meet the ongoing needs of the company. Is this the job for me?Suitable Candidates must have a third level degree in Electrical Engineering with 2+ years’ experience working as an Electrical Project Engineer in the HV Energy and Renewable Sector.    Excellent oral and written communication skills.    Ability to prioritise workload according to deadlines together with a high attention to detail.    Ability to influence colleagues at all levels.    Enjoy working as part of a high performing team. In return from Suir ….    25 days annual leave     Rotation available     Overseas allowance    Educational Assistance, CPD, Chartership supports and upskilling opportunities     Accommodation / transport and flights (available for rotation) Our way of working is called the Suir Way, designed to help us continually improve. The benefit for employees is:    Our people are empowered to make changes to ensure a quality install through effective ways of working.    Our people have a voice and feel empowered.    We have an in-built culture of innovation, learning and continuous improvement.    Value is delivered every step of the journey. Our efficient processes deliver value.    We have a standard, consistent and fully integrated health, safety, environment, and quality system within the business. At Suir Engineering are an equal opportunities employer, we value our greatest asset …. our People.

title: Integration Specialist - 20756

Responsibilities    Design, develop, and maintain REST, SOAP, and GraphQL APIs and associated integration flows.    Implement message transformation, orchestration, mediation, and routing between Service (AKS), kubectl, Helm, ingress, VNET, scaling, monitoring, and observability.    Infrastructure: Linux virtual machines, databases, load balancers, networking, and high-availability API management certifications, microservices integration experience, infrastructure-as-code expertise, and exposure to AI/ML tool-use protocols are advantageous. Swedish language proficiency is considered beneficial.

title: Financial Controller needed!

title: Quantitative Risk Analyst (Credit Risk)
employer: Nordea Bank Abp, filial i Sverige
description: Job ID: 6765Would you like to take a central role in shaping Nordea’s credit risk modelling landscape and add real business value for Nordea? Then this opportunity is for you. We are looking for a Quantitative Risk Analyst to join our IRB modelling functions and drive the design, enhancement, and implementation of credit risk models across the organisation. The role combines advanced modelling, practical implementation of the models in our IT infrastructure and a sound understanding of banking. You need to enjoy working with large datasets, solve problems and find new and innovative solutions.About our teamMeet the Risk Models Methodology & IRB models team. Our role is to develop and maintain models under IRB, and support other functions in the value chain. We strive to develop models that help business in their decisions and comply with relevant regulatory environment across multiple countries.Our team adds value by accurately estimating the IRB risk parameters for Nordea’s customers. As a Quantitative Risk Analyst you will play a valuable role in developing, maintaining and using models which accurately estimate Nordea customers’ credit risk and anchor these firmly in the business lines.Given the nature of our data and regulatory requirements, we use advanced modelling techniques and big data technology. In addition to using leading techniques for modelling and data, the team’s role is general risk governance within credit risk modelling and methodology, including management of models, model implementation, data quality, documentation and model use.Collaboration. Ownership. Passion. Courage. These are the values that guide us in how we work and how we make decisions – and that we imagine you share with us.Main responsibilities in this role:    Develop technical tools that can be used for model development and other analysis, using tools such as Python.    Work on a subset of model lifecycle related activities like: data pipeline, data quality work, development, documentation, implementation, maintenance, monitoring, requirement setting, and user acceptance tests within credit and impairment models.    Contribute to methodological standards, modelling tools, coding practices, and continuous improvement of the modelling framework.    Drive projects within the IRB Models, and manage stakeholder relationships in the Risk, IT and Business organisations.    Present & justify analyses, results, and their implications to stakeholders, either through periodic activities or through ad-hoc requests.    Provide technical guidance, review the work of other modellers, and support setting modelling strategy and priorities.    Stay informed on regulatory developments and industry practices.You’ll join an international team with a variety of backgrounds and skills. We work closely with other teams across the bank which provides you with excellent opportunities for personal and professional development. Our working language is English.The role is based in Stockholm, Helsinki, Oslo or Warsaw. Flexible working conditions with respect to working from premises / from home apply according to the Nordea rules of working at least 60% from the office.Who you areThis is the right role for you if you are:    Curious, enjoy learning and are excited about brining your ideas to the table.Take ownership of the task but enjoy collaboration with others.    Confident in advanced quantitative modelling and eager to challenge ideas constructively.    Communicate complex statistical or methodological concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.    Enjoy working with large datasets and navigate well in tools used to analyse them.    Work well in a dynamic environment with varying workload.    Are keen to find solutions and not only raise concerns.    Able to think big picture but know that the devil is in the details. You are good at judging which details require extra attention.    Committed to deliver high-quality work.    Interested in coding and development of technical tools.Your background and skills include:    A Master’s or PhD in a quantitative field, for instance economics, engineering, business, mathematics, science, statistics, finance, or similar.    Interest or hands-on experience working with data & modelling and conducting complex data analysis in financial services.    revious experience with large volumes of data and programming. We use mainly Python / SQL.    Interest in understanding of regulatory requirements related to IRB, IFRS9 and stress testing and different modelling techniques.Seniority [Assistant/Regular/Senior/Lead] of the role and remuneration will depend on the level of the candidate’s experience in the relevant fields.What we offerPeople come here when they want to get somewhere. For some, it’s to take their career to the next level. For others, it’s to break new ground within their area of expertise – in other words, with us, you will always move forward.A culture that fosters performance and growth in one of the largest Nordic banks, offering various opportunities to evolve, develop and learn from brilliant colleagues with diverse backgrounds in a vibrant working environment.Hybrid working model – we believe in the value of bringing people together and at the same time we embrace the freedom of flexibility.Diversity and inclusion are a natural part of our daily work. We know that an inclusive workplace is a sustainable one. We genuinely believe that our diverse backgrounds, experiences, characteristics and traits make us stronger together. If this sounds like you, get in touch!We enable dreams and aspirations for a greater good.We build relationships. We add a personal touch to everything we do – when advising our customers, collaborating with colleagues, and meeting our potential candidates.We learn and develop. We take pride in being experts and thinking ahead. We use our expertise to meet our customers’ needs, from the simplest to the most complex. We lead change. We are responsible and aware of the impact of our decisions, both for our customers and for our local and global communities. We are Nordea. We have a 200-year history of supporting and growing the Nordic economies and our values are deeply rooted in these open, progressive and collaborative societies. For union information, please contact finansforbundet@nordea.se or SACONordea@nordea.com.

title: Senior / Expert IT Analyst
employer: Nordea Bank Abp, filial i Sverige
description: Job ID: 6322 #Core of the core #Heart of the bank Would you like to be part of the journey to create an even better version of us? At Nordea, we know our customers’ needs are changing – and we’re deeply committed to meeting them with financial solutions of tomorrow. We are looking for a Senior or Expert IT Analyst (depending on seniority) to join Local Systems Operations in Sweden. Local Systems is a team loaded with experience, professionalism and passion. The Operations Unit within Local Systems is responsible for running our applications in a stable and compliant way. Now we need to add talent to the team, to stay in strength and competence also for the future. About this opportunity Welcome to the Local Systems team. We add value by providing stable, efficient and innovative IT services in the core banking system areas such as Deposits, Payments, Customer data and Loans, serving virtually all other business areas of the bank. As a Senior / Expert IT Analyst you will play a vital role in keeping Nordea’s fundamental banking applications running stable and compliant. You will support Application Providers working on a portfolio of applications constituting the foundation of the bank. In your role, you will support Nordeas vital Incident, Problem and Change processes. You will work on internal as well as external audits of different kinds, and provide technical support to Application Providers and other stakeholders. What you’ll be doing:     Be a technical support to Application Providers    Follow up on and guide our vendors, who are doing the bulk part of daily application operations.    Support and perform the activities in the Change, Incident and Problem Processes    Conduct compliance reviews, and if needed implement corrective measures    Cooperate with Application Providers to create an optimal environment for the applications evolution, including access to sufficient application competence over time As the Senior/ Expert IT Analyst, you will focus on the applications health in a short and long term perspective, making sure Nordea has access to applications with world class functionality, scalability, maintainability and performance, now and in the future. To achieve this, you will be cooperating with many parts of Nordea, inside and outside Local Systems. Vendor Management will be a crucial activity, as many of the operational services of the applications are purchased from external vendors. The Local Systems application portfolio is mainly built on the IBM z/OS (“Mainframe”) technical platform. A smaller part of the application portfolio is built on Midrange technologies, such as Java. To be successful, we believe you are well acquainted with these platforms, with a primary focus on the Mainframe. This role is based in Stockholm, Sweden. This is a permanent, full-time, position. Who you are Collaboration. Ownership. Passion. Courage. These are the values that guide us in being at our best – and that we imagine you share with us. To succeed in this role, we believe that you:     Have worked five years with banking applications    Are good at grasping rules and regulations, and realizing their practical consequences    Are well acquainted with IT Operations work    Have a structured mind with attention to detail    Can act independently, and identify the actions you need to take.    Have a positive attitude and cooperate easily with those you have contact with in your daily work    Have the capability to work with English speaking colleagues from all over the world. Your experience and background:    You have five years of experience from the financial sector, primarily focused on software maintenance and/or development    You are skilled in and enjoy analysing IT solutions    Several years of experience from working with mainframe systems    Experience from ITIL and IPC Process work    Acquaintance with Nordeas systems, products and processes will be a big advantage What we offer People are driven by many different factors. For some, it’s to take their career to the next level. For others, it’s to break new ground within their area of expertise – in other words, with us, you will always move forward. A culture that fosters performance and growth in one of the largest Nordic banks, offering various opportunities to evolve, develop and learn from brilliant colleagues with diverse backgrounds in a vibrant working environment. Hybrid working model – we believe in the value of bringing people together and at the same time we embrace the freedom of flexibility. Diversity and inclusion are a natural part of our daily work. We know that an inclusive workplace is a sustainable one. We genuinely believe that our diverse backgrounds, experiences, characteristics and traits make us stronger together. Every day we strive to find new ways to improve diversity and inclusion within our community e.g. we have signed the European Diversity Charters in the countries where we operate to show our commitment and engage with others to continue learning and improving. If this sounds like you, get in touch! Next steps Submit your application no later than 20/11/2026. For more information, you’re welcome to contact Head of Local Systems Operations and Local Systems Application Management, Johan Larsson at johan.larsson@nordea.com. The recruitment process consists of the following steps:    Preliminary CV selection    Phone conversation with the recruiter or hiring leader    Online interview with the hiring leader    Reference check For union information, please contact Finansförbundet at finansforbundet@nordea.se or SACO at SacoNordea@nordea.com.

Are you someone who believes in encouraging and elevating those around you?About KustomKustom was born in 2024 in Stockholm, Sweden, when Klarna Checkout became so successful it earned a life of its own. Since then, we’ve grown into one of Europe’s leading checkout solutions, with a team of more than 100 people all driven by the same mission: giving every business the checkout it deserves.We believe the best solutions aren't built in isolation. Kustom gives merchants the freedom to shape their own checkout by connecting to a growing network of 100+ partners. We handle the complexity behind the scenes, making sure every shopper enjoys the best possible experience. That way, growth happens freely, without compromises or closed loops.Today, Kustom serves more than 24,000 merchants across 170 markets and has converted more than 25 million shoppers.The roleAs Legal Counsel, you'll be responsible for Kustom's day-to-day commercial legal work, from merchant and partner agreements and complex negotiations to automating our legal processes. As a trusted internal advisor, you'll lead your matters independently, from first draft to signature.Commercial work is the core of the role, but it doesn't stop there. You'll also take part in larger projects including M&A and post-acquisition integration and product legal projects covering, among other things, data privacy, payments and consumer legislation.You'll work in a fast-paced environment where Legal is a key enabler of growth. We use AI as a tool to work efficiently, so we can spend our time where legal judgment matters most. We focus on the risks that are material to the business, and build processes that let standard agreements be signed without legal involvement.You'll be part of a small legal team in Stockholm and report to the Head of Legal.Things you’ll be doing    Commercial contracting. Draft, review and negotiate merchant, partner and vendor agreements, from standard terms to bespoke deals with larger counterparties. Your counterparties range from merchants to platform and e-commerce partners, payment service providers, banks and technology vendors.    Advise the business. Be the first point of contact for the commercial organisation and a pragmatic sparring partner to the product, operations, risk and finance teams. Give clear advice fast and if needed negotiate directly with counterparties and their lawyers.    Scale legal with AI. Develop how we use AI in our legal work, and improve templates, playbooks and approval flows so straightforward agreements move without legal involvement.    M&A and integration. Work on M&A together with the Head of Legal, including the legal side of post-acquisition integration, covering everything from contract migration to merchant and partner transitions.    Product legal projects. Work with the product team on larger legal projects, such as data privacy, payments legislation and consumer law.    Corporate and company law. Support on company law matters across the group, including board and shareholder matters and corporate housekeeping.Skills and experience you’ll need    A Swedish law degree (jur.kand. or juristexamen).    Around three years of experience, either from a top-tier business law firm with a focus on commercial contracts and/or M&A and corporate law or in-house experience from fintech, payments or e-commerce.    A track record of owning negotiations end to end and drafting high-quality agreements.    Hands-on experience of using AI tools in your legal work.    Fluent in Swedish and English, spoken and written.    Experience of data privacy, payments regulation or consumer credit legislation is a plus.We believe you’ll thrive in this role if you    Take ownership and move things forward without waiting to be told what to do.    Enjoy a high pace and stay structured when many matters compete for your time.    Are commercially minded and know how to balance legal risk against business priorities.    Like working close to the business and can make complex questions simple.    Are always looking for smarter ways of working and see AI as a natural part of how legal work gets done.Benefits    Secure your future with a competitive pension package, including both national and occupational pension contributions.    Comprehensive health coverage with extensive health insurance, long-term illness protection, and flexible salary exchange options.    Invest in your wellbeing with an annual wellness allowance of 3,000 SEK to spend on the activities that keep you healthy and energized.    More time to enjoy life with an extra day off when major holidays, such as Christmas Eve or New Year’s Eve, fall on a weekend.A place to growAt Kustom, you won’t just be another face in the crowd. This is a place where we elevate each other and celebrate success as a team. We believe in our ability to create excellence - and have fun doing it!We know we set high expectations, but we also know that the road to success isn’t a straight line. We support and encourage each other to try, to fail, to try again. Because that’s how we grow, individually and together.Does this sound like the place for you?

title: Payroll Specialist
description: Looking for the next step in your payroll career within a global organization? Our colleague is retiring, and we are now looking for a new team member to join our payroll team in Karlstad. This is an exciting opportunity to become part of a global organization where people are at the heart of everything we do. In this role, you will take ownership of complex payroll processes, contribute to continuous improvement initiatives, and play a key role in delivering payroll services and an excellent employee experience. You will work with payroll administration, time and attendance processes, compliance, reporting, and process development while collaborating with colleagues and stakeholders across the business. If you enjoy combining payroll expertise with problem-solving and continuous improvement, this could be the next step in your career.Your responsibilities     You will manage payroll administration processes for operations across Sweden, Norway, and Denmark, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and timely delivery.      You will perform payroll corrections, reconciliations, and reporting related to vacation balances, compensatory time, accounting transactions, tax reporting, and pension processes.     You will own time and attendance administration, including schedule management and absence-related processes.      You will support employees, managers, authorities, and external stakeholders by handling payroll-related inquiries through our case management system.      You will contribute to process improvements, participate in year-end payroll activities, and help develop payroll policies, routines, and training initiatives.  Expectations for you     You have at least three years of experience working with payroll administration and complex payroll calculations.     You have strong knowledge of payroll legislation, employment law, taxation, and payroll compliance requirements.     You are experienced in payroll systems, and experience from Agda PS is considered an advantage.     You have excellent analytical skills, strong attention to detail, and a structured approach to your work.     You communicate fluently in both Swedish and English, written and spoken.  Payroll certification is considered a merit. To succeed in this role Success in this role requires solid payroll expertise, a thorough understanding of payroll legislation, and the ability to manage complex payroll processes with a high degree of accuracy. You are proactive, self-driven, and comfortable taking ownership while collaborating with colleagues and stakeholders. You stay up to date with changes in regulations and continuously look for ways to improve processes and service quality. We also expect you to align with Valmet’s Leadership Principles - practical behaviours that guide how we lead, collaborate, and succeed together:     Take accountability – Act with ownership, set clear expectations, and follow through     Lead with courage – Champion change, try bold ideas, and learn quickly     Build on trust – Listen to understand, be open, and create psychological safety     Collaborate for growth – Work across boundaries, value diverse perspectives, and focus on customer value We offer You will join a dedicated payroll team responsible for delivering high-quality payroll and time management services while ensuring compliance and a positive employee experience. The team plays an important role in supporting employees and managers, driving process improvements, and maintaining efficient payroll operations across multiple countries.Valmet offers an inspiring and challenging position with excellent opportunities for professional growth and development. We value our employees and provide a comprehensive benefits package, including wellness benefits, healthcare insurance, wellbeing initiatives, and learning opportunities. We encourage internal mobility and support continuous competence development to help our people grow throughout their careers. Want to know more? For further information about the position, please contact Ulrika Lindegren, Payroll Manager, Northern Europe at ulrika.lindegren@valmet.com. Please note that applications cannot be accepted via email and must be submitted through our careers site.If you are interested in becoming part of the team, you can apply by December 1. We review applications continuously and may fill the position before the application deadline, so we encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible.We perform background checks and alcohol/drug testing for all employees in Sweden, in line with our commitment to a safe and secure workplace. When everything works together Valmet is where the best talent from a wide variety of backgrounds comes together. We work together with our customers throughout the entire lifecycle, delivering cutting-edge technologies and services as well as mission-critical automation and flow control solutions. Backed by more than 225 years of industrial experience and a global team of over 18,500 professionals close to customers, we are uniquely positioned to transform industries toward a regenerative tomorrow. At Valmet, diversity of thought drives innovation. We are committed to a respectful and inclusive environment, where people can be themselves and are supported to contribute at their best. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and make hiring decisions based on skills, experience, and potential, never on personal characteristics such as gender, gender identity, age, ethnicity, nationality, disability, neurodiversity, religion, sexual orientation, or political views. Join the team – and lead the way with us! www.valmet.com/careers

title: Doctoral student in Mechanical Engineering - specialisation in wire drawing
description: Örebro University and the School of Science and Technology are looking for a doctoral student for the doctoral programme in Mechanical Engineering, concluding with a doctoral degree.Start date: January – March 2027.Project descriptionSteel wire is an essential component of countless products and applications, from everyday items such as ballpoint pens and car tyres to critical infrastructure such as buildings and bridges. As industry advances towards more sustainable manufacturing, there is an increasing need to produce steel wire products with greater resource efficiency, improved material performance, and reduced environmental impact.This doctoral project aims to advance the knowledge and technologies needed to make wire drawing processes more efficient, robust, and sustainable. The research is carried out in close collaboration with the wire drawing industry, ensuring that scientific developments address real industrial challenges and contribute to more sustainable production of steel wire products. Particular emphasis will be placed on improving process understanding and developing and evaluating innovative drawing tools.The research will combine experimental investigations of wire drawing processes, tool behaviour, and resulting wire properties with sensor-based measurements, data analysis, and modelling. A central objective is to understand how material properties, process conditions, lubrication, and tooling interact and influence process performance, tool wear, and wire quality. This knowledge will support the development of practical solutions that improve resource utilisation, extend tool life, and enhance the efficiency and sustainability of industrial wire drawing.As a doctoral student, you will plan and conduct experiments, analyse data, develop models, and communicate your findings through scientific publications and presentations. You will work closely with academic researchers and industrial partners, contributing to research that bridges fundamental scientific understanding and practical industrial applications.The project offers an interdisciplinary research environment at the intersection of mechanical engineering, manufacturing technology, materials engineering, measurement technology, modelling, and control engineering. By addressing challenges associated with resource efficiency, production performance, and the green transition, the research aims to contribute to the development of next-generation wire drawing processes and tools that support more sustainable steel wire production.Supervision: The doctoral student will be supervised by Christer Korin (principal supervisor) and Joakim Larsson (assistant supervisor).The programme and the doctoral studentshipThe doctoral programme consists of courses and an independent research project that you will present in a doctoral thesis. The programme concludes with a doctoral degree and comprises 240 credits, which corresponds to four years of full-time study.Our ambition is for your doctoral studies to be stimulating and purposeful throughout the programme until you have obtained your doctoral degree. A thorough introduction will therefore get you off to a good start and provide a solid foundation on which you can build your studies. As a doctoral student at Örebro University, you will be offered a specially tailored seminar series, covering matters ranging from doctoral programme rules and careers to support during the study period and networking.The place on the programme is linked to a full-time doctoral studentship for the duration of the study programme, which corresponds to four years of full-time study. More information on doctoral studentships, part-time studies and part-time doctoral studentships can be found on https://www.oru.se/english/study/doctoral-studies/how-to-become-a-doctoral-student/. The initial salary for a doctoral studentship is SEK 32 300 a month (salary period 2025-2026).Entry requirements and selectionTo see the job advertisement in its entirety, visit: https://www.oru.se/english/career/available-positions/job/?jid=20260303InformationFor more information about the programme and the doctoral studentship, contact Joakim Larsson, Associate Senior Lecturer, joakim.larsson@oru.se, +4619303378 or Christer Korin, Senior Lecturer, christer.korin@oru.se, +4619303082.At Örebro University, we expect each member of staff to be open to development and change; take responsibility for their work and performance; demonstrate a keen interest in collaboration and contribute to development; as well as to show respect for others by adopting a constructive and professional approach.Application to the programme and for the doctoral studentshipThe application is made online. Click the button “Apply” to begin the application procedure.For the application to be complete, the following electronic documents must be included:    CV    Copies of the original certificate and official transcript for Bachelor's degree    Copies of the original certificate and official transcript for Master's degree    Independent project (degree project)    Other relevant documents, course and degree certificates verifying eligibilityAs a main rule, application documents and attachments are to be written in Swedish, Danish, Norwegian, or English. Certificates and documents in other languages verifying your qualifications and experience must be translated by an authorised translator to Swedish or English. A list of authorised translators can be obtained from Kammarkollegiet (the Legal, Financial and Administrative Services Agency), http://www.kammarkollegiet.se/engelska/start.When you apply for admission, you automatically also apply for a doctoral studentship.More information for applicants will be found on our career site:  https://www.oru.se/english/career/available-positions/applicants-and-external-experts/The application deadline is 2026-12-18. We look forward to receiving your application!As we have already made our choices in terms of external collaboration partners and marketing efforts for this recruitment process, we decline any contact with recruitment agencies and advertisers.As directed by the National Archives of Sweden (Riksarkivet), we are required to deposit one file copy of the application documents, excluding publications, for a period of two years after the appointment decision has gained legal force.

title: Competence Development Specialist
description: Every day, we get opportunities to make a positive impact - on our colleagues, partners, customers, and society. Together, we're pioneering the solutions of the future and unlocking the full potential of precious resources. Trusted to act on initiative, we challenge conventional thinking to develop world-leading technologies that inspire progress in vital areas, including energy, food, water, and shipping.  As we push forward, the innovative, open spirit that fuels our 140-year-old start-up culture and rapid growth also drives our personal growth. So, as we shape a more resourceful, less wasteful world, we build our careers too. About the job Are you a technically interested person with hard skills within heat exchangers AND have a passion for sharing knowledge and educating others? Then we believe this might be your dream role. As a Competence Development Specialist, you will be part of a global competence development team and play a key role in shaping the skills and expertise of colleagues and partners worldwide.  Your job is to deliver comprehensive product and application training sessions focused on Hygienic Heat Exchangers for the food and pharmaceutical industries. You will facilitate both on-site and hands-on training at global product training hubs, with sessions typically lasting two to five days.  Key Responsibilities:     Support the development and delivery of training, engaging with process and project engineers as well as field service professionals.     Collaborate with regional product and application teams, acting as a "train the trainer" to ensure consistent and effective knowledge transfer across regions.     Contribute ideas and feedback to enhance learning materials and methods.     Assess training needs and adapt programs to meet the requirements of diverse audiences, including field sales, technical support, and service teams.     Provide ongoing mentorship and support to trainees, fostering knowledge retention and practical application.     Maintain and update training documentation to ensure accuracy and relevance. Trips often combining multiple sessions to deliver impactful learning experiences and you will be away for one week at a time. We have a solid understanding for our employees need to be able to balance work and family life and travels are mostly planned. We offer you a role with diverse, multicultural environments where collaboration and inclusion are highly valued. With Alfa Laval you will get to grow a global network of professionals. You are curious and open-minded and have the drive to inspire others and continuously seek new ways to make learning engaging. You thrive in diverse, multicultural environments, are approachable, eager to grow and enjoy working as part of a team. Merit:     Experience with practical application of AI in a, for this role, relevant area.  If you're motivated to make a real impact through competence development and enjoy connecting with people from all backgrounds, we'd love to hear from you.   We are conducting a continuous review of received applications, and the ad might be closed before ending date. We do not accept applications via email, due to General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). Please send your application no later than November 25, 2026. While we typically welcome applicants from all locations, for this particular role, we are prioritizing candidates who are currently residing in Lund (Sweden) or Kolding or Søborg (Denmark) or have an established presence in the area. title: Researcher in plant breeding, genomics, and sensory and nutritional quality
description: Department of Plant BreedingWe are seeking a highly motivated researcher with a strong background in genetics, genomics and crop improvementAbout the positionThe position focuses on understanding the genetic basis of disease resistance and grain nutrient quality in wheat and lentil, with particular emphasis on micronutrients such as iron and zinc. The overall objective is to identify genetic regions and markers associated with resistance, nutritional and quality traits which can contribute to future breeding efforts. The position will also contribute to the development of data-driven approaches for crop improvement and food innovation. The successful candidate will contribute to integrating advanced genomic and phenotypic approaches with metabolomic and ionomic analyses, food processing and emerging artificial intelligence approaches, within a research environment working at the interface of genetics and pre-breeding/crop improvement.The candidate will lead experimental and analytical work within the subject and collaborate with other researchers and students in the group as well as outside the organisation.The work will include:    Analyse Genotyping by sequencing (GBS) data (quality control, read mapping and SNP calling)    Genome-wide association studies (GWAS)    Field evaluation and phenotyping of diverse germplasm    Data analysis, interpretation, and preparation of scientific publications within the subject    Participate in collaborative research activities and supervision of students    Apply for external research fundingYour profileQualification requirementsThe following qualifications are required:    A PhD in plant genetics, plant breeding, agriculture, or a related field    Good understanding of the genetic basis of complex quantitative traits    Experience with GBS data and GWAS    Experience with nutritional quality traits in crops    Experience with metabolomic and ionomic profiling including the integration and analysis of multi-omics datasets    Experience with advanced statistical methods for analysing genetic and phenotypic data    Practical experience with field experiments, data collection and phenotyping    Good skills in the programming language R or a comparable language    Very good written and oral English skillsThe candidate must be able to take a leading role in research development as well as to collaborate in research groups and have good overall communication skills.Additional qualificationsThe following qualifications are meritorious:    Experience in plant pathology and/or plant physiology    Machine learning, artificial intelligence or other data-driven approaches to biological datasetsAssessment criteriaAssessment will be based on the applicant’s scientific competence and experience relevant to the research area of the position. Emphasis will be placed on documented experience in field phenotyping and analysis of genetic data.The evaluation will also consider the applicant’s ability to conduct independent research, collaborate within a multidisciplinary research environment, and communicate scientific results through publications and presentations.About usThe position focuses on understanding the genetic basis of disease resistance and grain nutrient quality in wheat and lentil, with particular emphasis on micronutrients such as iron and zinc. The overall objective is to identify genetic regions and markers associated with resistance, nutritional and quality traits which can contribute to future breeding efforts. The position will also contribute to the development of data-driven approaches for crop improvement and food innovation. The successful candidate will contribute to integrating advanced genomic and phenotypic approaches with metabolomic and ionomic analyses, food processing and emerging artificial intelligence approaches, within a research environment working at the interface of genetics and pre-breeding/crop improvement.For more information about the department or division visit: https://www.slu.se/en/about-slu/organisation/departments/vf_en/Read more about our benefits and working at SLU by visiting: https://www.slu.se/en/about-slu/work-at-slu/Location:AlnarpForm of employment:Permanent positionScope:100%Start date:2027-02-01 or as agreedApplication:Please submit your application before deadline 24 of November 2026. You can submit your application by clicking the button below. Applications cannot be submitted through the recruitment system on 20–22 November due to a system update.Union representatives:https://internt.slu.se/en/my-employment/employee-associations/kontaktpersoner-vid-rekrytering/ The Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences (SLU) has a key role in the development for sustainable life, based on science and education. Through our focus on the interaction between humans, animals and ecosystems and the responsible use of natural resources, we contribute to sustainable societal development and good living conditions on our planet. Our main campuses are located in Alnarp, Umeå and Uppsala, however, the university also operates at research stations, experimental forests and teaching sites throughout Sweden. SLU has around 4,000 employees, 6,000 students and doctoral students and a turnover of over SEK 4,5 billion. We are investing in attractive environments on all of our campuses. We strive to provide a work environment characterised by inclusivity and gender equality, where different experiences generate conversations between people and pave the way for science, creativity and development. Therefore, we welcome applications from people with diverse backgrounds and perspectives.

title: Lead Mechanical Engineer | Sweden
description: Permanent position available with a considerable portfolio of works for the next 5+ years    To build your career by assisting in the delivery of ‘leading edge’ engineering projects.    To work with a vibrant, agile and multi-functional team in delivering projects on time, safely, to budget and to the required quality standards.    To benefit from Kirby’s Career Development Programmes that will enhance your leadership capability.    To work with the best.    Excellent package on offer with room for negotiationsAbout Kirby Group EngineeringKirby Group Engineering is an international multi-disciplinary engineering services contractor and leading provider of high-value engineering services to a number of ‘blue chip’ companies. Operating across Ireland, the UK, Europe and South Africa, Kirby has become the engineering service provider of choice in growth segments such as pharmaceuticals, data centres and power transmission and distribution. Our culture is innovative, collaborative and performance focused. The successful candidate will have the opportunity to grow and develop in a company committed to developing talent and rewarding performance.Lead Mechanical Engineer – Data Centre ProjectThis is not a role for someone who wants to hide behind procedures or wait for instructions.We’re looking for a Lead Mechanical Engineer to take full ownership of mechanical engineering and commissioning delivery on a major data centre project. This role sits right at the centre of the project — technically, operationally and commercially.If you enjoy complexity, accountability and leading engineers in an environment where mistakes are expensive and success is visible, you’ll feel at home here.The RoleAs Lead Mechanical Engineer, you are responsible for planning, managing and coordinating all mechanical engineering and commissioning activities on the project.You lead the mechanical engineering function end to end — design, procurement, installation, testing, commissioning and handover — while mentoring engineers and maintaining standards under pressure.This is a hands‑on leadership role. You are expected to make decisions, solve problems and keep things moving.What You’ll Be Doing You will:    Take full responsibility for mechanical engineering delivery on the project    Lead and manage the mechanical project engineering team, assigning engineers to work packages    Own the design management process, either directly or through appointed leads    Own the commissioning process, ensuring systems are buildable, testable and ready when required    Drive EHS compliance, promoting safe systems of work and leading by example on site    Oversee procurement from a technical perspective, including RFQs, technical evaluations, equipment selection and delivery tracking    Control quality from design through installation and commissioning, including ITPs, test packs, FATs, SATs, walkdowns and system handover    Coordinate closely with Electrical and CSA counterparts to ensure clear system boundaries and responsibilities    Manage system trackers, technical submittals, RFIs, deviations and change from a technical standpoint    Lead commissioning activities, flushing, balancing, pressure testing and certification    Identify risks early, own mitigation plans and escalate when required    Engage in programme development, commissioning sequencing and look‑ahead planning    Support business development through strong client, designer and contractor relationships    Mentor project and graduate engineers, building capability across the team    Provide clear, structured reporting to senior engineering and business leadershipIn short, you make sure the mechanical scope works — technically, safely and commercially.The ProjectThis is a large‑scale, mission‑critical data centre build.It’s fast, complex and highly coordinated. The client expects certainty, not excuses. Engineering decisions matter, sequencing matters and leadership matters.If you’ve worked on data centres, pharma or advanced industrial projects before, you’ll understand the pace and precision required.Who We Are – Kirby Group EngineeringKirby is one of Europe’s leading mechanical and electrical engineering contractors, delivering complex projects across data centres, life sciences, industrial and advanced manufacturing sectors.We are engineers first. We self‑deliver, we take responsibility, and we are trusted on projects where failure is not an option.While Kirby is well established across Ireland, the UK and mainland Europe, Italy is a strategic growth market for us. This project is part of that expansion.That means this role comes with real influence. You are not joining a mature, over‑layered organisation — you are helping to shape how Kirby is delivered and recognised in Italy.If you want to be known for delivery rather than job titles, this matters.About YouYou’ll likely have:    Strong senior‑level mechanical engineering experience on large, complex projects    Experience in data centres, pharmaceutical, industrial or mission‑critical environments    The ability to lead engineers without micromanaging them    Confidence working with clients, designers and site teams    A practical mindset — structured, calm and solutions‑focusedYou don’t need to be the loudest voice in the room. You do need to be the one people trust when things get difficult.Why Join Kirby Group Engineering?    A flagship data centre project in Denmark    Real ownership of mechanical engineering delivery    Strong backing from a proven European engineering contractor    Long‑term career opportunity as Kirby grows    A culture that values engineering judgement over box‑tickingFor more information on this role, or other Construction / Engineering opportunities across Ireland, the UK, Europe, or South Africa please review our careers page (Vacancies – Kirby Group Careers) or contact the Talent Acquisition Team at Kirby Group in confidence on +353 (0)1 454 0411.Kirby Group Engineering is an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace and welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates, regardless of race, gender, disability, religion, sexual orientation, or age.

title: PhD Student in Robotics and Artificial Intelligence
description: Are you ready to take the next step in your academic journey? As a doctoral student with us, you will work closely with leading researchers in a strong, international research environment, with access to advanced laboratory equipment and solid funding opportunities. You will be offered secure employment, high-quality supervision, and room to grow, both as a researcher and as a person.https://www.ltu.se/research/subjects/RoboticsAI?l=en subject, RAI, at the Department of Computer Science and Electrical and Space Engineering at Luleå University of Technology, is now looking for a PhD student to contribute to our growing activities. The RAI team is conducting fundamental research in all the aspects of robotics with a specific focus on aerial, space and bioinspired robotics. Subject description Robotics and artificial intelligence aim to develop novel robotic systems that are characterised by advanced autonomy for improving the ability of robots to interact with the surrounding environment and humans during the execution of specific tasks. Project description The vision of RAI is aiming in closing the gap from theory to real life, while the team has a strong expertise in field robotics. Specific application areas of focus are robotics for mines, aerial inspection of aging infrastructure, multi-robotic search and rescue, multi sensorial fusion and multirobot coordination, including multirobot perception, decentralization and mission execution. The RAI team has a strong European and National participation in multiple R&D&I projects. Duties As a PhD student you will perform research with substantial theoretical and experimental components that should be published in peer-reviewed major international journals and at major conferences. The position will include supervision of MSc and to assist in grant applications from research funding agencies/councils, the EU framework program or the industry. The position might also involve teaching assistance, seminars and presentations. You will be working in the field of robotic autonomy and all activities will be linked with National, European and worldwide R&D Projects. The research topic is in the area of Robotics and Artificial Intelligence. title: Orthopedic Surgeon to AniCura Kalmar Animal Hospital
description: Orthopedic Surgeon to AniCura Kalmar Animal Hospital About AniCura Kalmarsund Animal Hospital Imagine stepping into an animal hospital where the possibilities are extensive, the equipment is state-of-the-art and the ambitions are high. A place where ideas are encouraged, expertise can flourish and where, together, we can make a real difference for animals and their owners in entirely new ways. In early 2027, we will open the doors to a brand-new animal hospital in the heart of Kalmar. This is a major investment in the future of veterinary care and will be the only animal hospital in Kalmar County. We are building a facility with the capacity, expertise and equipment to handle everything from emergency cases to complex medical and surgical challenges. The hospital will feature four state-of-the-art operating theatres, an intensive care unit (ICU), an inpatient ward, an emergency department, rehabilitation facilities and a completely separate dental department. In addition, we will offer advanced diagnostic imaging, including MRI and CT, orthopaedics, modern medical technology that opens up new treatment possibilities, and an advanced laboratory. But what will truly make this hospital exceptional is not just the building, equipment or technology. It is the people who will bring it to life. Their expertise, curiosity, willingness to develop and ambition to continuously improve. This is your opportunity to be part of something significant from the very beginning. To influence, develop and build a new operation alongside colleagues who share your passion for veterinary medicine. The animal hospital of the future is taking shape in Kalmar. The question is - will you be part of it? Who We Are Looking For: We are now looking for an experienced veterinary surgeon with a strong interest and proven expertise in orthopaedics, soft tissue surgery and arthroscopy. You will play a central role in developing and shaping our orthopaedic service, with access to a state-of-the-art surgical environment featuring four spacious operating theatres, two of which are dedicated to orthopaedics. Our equipment includes CT, an arthroscopy tower and a C-arm fluoroscopy system - providing excellent conditions for advanced diagnostics and surgical procedures. You will become part of an experienced and dedicated team of veterinary nurses, veterinary surgeons and veterinary care assistants, all accustomed to working with advanced surgical cases. Together, you will manage everything from orthopaedic investigations to complex surgical procedures, treating both referral patients and emergency cases. You will also work closely with colleagues in anaesthesia, neurology, diagnostic imaging and rehabilitation. About the Role As an Orthopaedic Veterinary Surgeon, you will play an important role in establishing and developing our service. You will have considerable scope to influence both clinical practice and the future direction of our orthopaedic offering. Your responsibilities will include: Performing advanced orthopaedic investigations and surgical procedures. Carrying out procedures such as TPLO, fracture repair, arthroscopy, patellar surgery and other orthopaedic interventions. Managing both referral patients and emergency orthopaedic cases. Working closely with our teams in surgery, neurology, anaesthesia, diagnostic imaging and rehabilitation. Contributing to the development of clinical practices, protocols and future treatment opportunities. Sharing your expertise, mentoring colleagues and fostering a strong culture of knowledge exchange. This is more than the next step in your veterinary career. It is an opportunity to build something from the ground up, influence its direction and leave your mark on an entirely new orthopaedic service. We are building the animal hospital of the future in Kalmar. Would you like to help write its first chapter? About AniCura Sweden Since 2018, AniCura Sweden has been part of Mars Veterinary Health, a global network that creates excellent opportunities for knowledge sharing, innovation and professional development. With more than 450 clinics and animal hospitals across Europe, AniCura is one of the leading providers of advanced veterinary care. In Sweden, we are one of the largest veterinary care providers, with hospitals and clinics across the country and a strong local presence. Our dedicated teams work together to provide the best possible care for every patient, every day. Through a culture built on collaboration, continuous learning and medical excellence, we offer opportunities to grow, make an impact and truly make a difference. We are covered by collective bargaining agreements and offer secure employment conditions, including occupational pension, insurance and a wellness allowance, as well as excellent opportunities for continuous professional development throughout your career. Salary and benefits We offer competitive compensation packages based on your experience, competencies and role. Salary and benefits are discussed individually and transparently during the recruitment process. Interested? We warmly welcome your application! Applications and interviews are reviewed on an ongoing basis. The starting date is negotiable. Please note that the position may be filled before the application deadline of 31 December 2026. We value diversity and welcome applicants with different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives - we believe this contributes to greater quality and innovation in everything we do. Please attach a copy of your veterinary licence issued by the Swedish Board of Agriculture (Jordbruksverket) when submitting your application. For questions about the recruitment process or the position, please feel free to contact: Talent Acquisition Partner Emma Idman talent@anicura.se

title: Head of Engineering & Operations / CTO
description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Head of Engineering &amp; Operations / CTO--- Head of Engineering \& Operations / CTO=======================================**Über cyon**Seit 2003 helfen wir Menschen, ihre Ideen ins Internet zu bringen, heute für rund 50'000 Kundinnen und Kunden. Wir sind ein inhabergeführtes Unternehmen mit rund 50 Mitarbeitenden und betreiben unsere Plattform in Basel mit 100 % erneuerbarer Energie.Wir stehen für persönlichen Support, einfache Produkte und digitale Selbstbestimmung. Unsere Kundinnen und Kunden sollen ihren digitalen Raum unabhängig von grossen Plattformen gestalten können. Ihre Daten bleiben in der Schweiz.Wir entwickeln cyon vom erfolgreichen Hosting\-Anbieter zu einer Plattform, auf der Menschen und KI\-Agenten digitale Projekte einfach, sicher und selbstbestimmt umsetzen können. Dafür suchen wir eine technische Führungspersönlichkeit, die unseren zuverlässigen Betrieb sichert und gleichzeitig die technologische Zukunft von cyon gestaltet.  **Deine Aufgaben*** **Führung** Du führst und entwickelst unsere Mitarbeitenden in Engineering \& Operations. Du stärkst Eigenverantwortung, entwickelst Führungspersönlichkeiten und schaffst Strukturen, in denen Teams wirksam zusammenarbeiten und gute Entscheidungen treffen können.* **Strategie und Prioritäten** Als Mitglied der Geschäftsleitung trägst du Verantwortung für cyon als Ganzes. Du verantwortest Budget, Personalplanung und Ressourcenallokation deines Bereichs und übersetzt Produktziele gemeinsam mit Business Development in eine verbindliche technische Roadmap.* **Architektur und Betrieb** Gemeinsam mit erfahrenen Engineers entwickelst du die Zielarchitektur unserer Software und Infrastruktur weiter und sorgst dafür, dass Entscheide getroffen und umgesetzt werden. Mit deinen Teams gewährleistest du einen sicheren Betrieb rund um die . Dazu gehören Monitoring, Pikett, Incident Management, Backup und Disaster Recovery. Gleichzeitig modernisierst du gezielt unsere bestehenden Systeme.* «**AI first, human accountable»** Du machst KI\-gestützte und agentische Arbeitsweisen zum selbstverständlichen Bestandteil unserer Engineering\-Organisation. Du erkennst, wo KI echten Mehrwert schafft, förderst den gezielten Einsatz und stellst Qualität, Sicherheit und menschliche Verantwortung sicher.* **Sicherheit und Datenschutz** Du verantwortest die technische Informationssicherheit, den Schutz unserer Infrastruktur und die Umsetzung technischer Datenschutzanforderungen. Du entwickelst Sicherheitsstandards und Risikomanagement gemeinsam mit der Geschäftsleitung weiter.**Das bringst du mit*** **Führungserfahrung** Du hast technische Organisationen geleitet und Führungskräfte entwickelt. Dein Führungsstil verbindet Vertrauen und Freiraum mit klaren Erwartungen und Verbindlichkeit.
