Ces compétences répondent aux exigences de nos clients aussi bien au niveau technique qu’esthétique.Afin de renforcer notre Département **« Maintenance** **»**, nous recherchons un :Electricien de Maintenance (H/F)================================ **Missions :*** Réaliser les travaux de maintenance préventive, corrective et curative des machines conventionnelles, automatisées et à commande numérique pour les secteurs saphir et plasturgie ;  * Assurer la disponibilité, la fiabilité et la sécurité électrique des équipements de production ;  * Contribuer à l’amélioration des équipements afin de garantir la continuité de production et la qualité des produits, en collaboration avec les équipes techniques et de production.    **Responsabilités :*** Diagnostiquer les pannes électriques et les dysfonctionnements des systèmes de commande afin de rétablir la production ;  * Construction et/ou modification électriques des installations de production  * Appliquer les procédures de consignation et les règles de sécurité dans les limites de ses compétences et autorisations ;  * Contrôler le fonctionnement des équipements et des dispositifs de sécurité avant leur remise à disposition de la production ;  * Analyser les pannes récurrentes et mettre en œuvre des actions visant à fiabiliser les équipements ;  * Participer aux déménagements des machines et à l’installation, la mise en service et la modernisation des moyens de production ;  * Organiser ses interventions avec la production et les autres intervenants de maintenance selon les priorités définies ;  * Documenter les interventions et mettre à jour les schémas électriques et les dossiers techniques ;  * Identifier les besoins en pièces de rechange et contribuer à la disponibilité des composants critiques  * Accompagner les prestataires externes et transmettre aux équipes les bonnes pratiques d’utilisation et de surveillance des équipements ;  * Veiller à la sécurité des personnes, au respect des consignes et au maintien en bon état des équipements.   **Profil :** * CFC d’automaticien, d’électricien ou formation équivalente, avec au moins 5 ans d’expérience en maintenance de machines de production industrielle ;  * Maîtrise du diagnostic électrique, des appareils de mesure et de la lecture des schémas électriques ;  * Compétences en diagnostic sur automates et interfaces opérateur, avec des connaissances de base des commandes numériques et automates Fanuc, Siemens et Beckhoff ;  * Bonne compréhension des systèmes de chauffe et de régulation de température, ainsi que des interactions électriques, mécaniques, pneumatiques et hydrauliques ;  * Aisance avec les outils informatiques de maintenance et la documentation technique ; connaissances de base en anglais ;  * Des connaissances en robotique ( , Universal Robots) et en vision industrielle (Cognex) constituent des atouts ;  * Rigueur et sens des responsabilités en matière de sécurité ;  * Esprit d’analyse et approche méthodique de la résolution de problèmes ;  * Autonomie et fiabilité dans l’exécution des interventions ;  * Capacité à collaborer avec les équipes de production et de maintenance ;  * Sens de l’organisation et capacité à gérer les priorités ;  * Réactivité et maîtrise de soi face aux arrêts de production ;  * Esprit d’initiative, bonne communication et orientation vers des solutions durables.   **Horaires de travail :** Service de piquet et 2x8 possible **Nous offrons :*** Vacances : 5 semaines par année \+ 1 semaine sur rattrapage ;  * Pause de 15min offerte ;  * Salaire versé sur 13 mois ;  * Participation au paiement de votre caisse maladie ;  * Evénements réguliers (repas d'été, brunchs mensuels, sorties d'entreprise, etc.) ;  * Rabais chez différents partenaires (rabais flotte, ventes privées chez des marques prestigieuses, etc.) ;  * Environnement de travail sain, valorisant, dynamique et en constante évolution.   ![R. title: Internisten (m/w/d) für die umfassende Patientenversorgung in der Schweiz (Facharzt/-ärztin - Innere Medizin)
description: Für mehrere Regionen in der Schweiz suchen wir zur erweiterten Grundversorgung von Patienten mehrere Internisten und Internistinnen. Die Kliniken, für die wir aktiv suchen, engagieren sich nach neuestem Wissensstand in der Inneren Medizin.Indem sie sich mit anderen Gesundheitsexperten in der Schweiz vernetzen, ermöglichen sie eine umfassende und hochwirksame Versorgung. Man legt großen Wert auf medizinische Qualität und persönliche Behandlung. Dazu gehört, dass für jede Patientin und Patienten eine individuell abgestimmte Therapie ermöglicht wird. Die Bedürfnisse aller Patientinnen und Patienten stehen stets an erster Stelle.Unsere starke Partnerschaft mit Kliniken aus dem ganzen Land ermöglicht Ihnen eine hochwertige Arbeitsumgebung und eine schnelle Anstellung.Für mehrere äußerst interessante Arbeitgeber suchen wir per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung fachlich qualifizierte und engagierte Personen alsInternistin oder Internist für die Patientenversorgung in einem Schweizer Kanton Ihrer Wahl.Zuständigkeiten / HauptaufgabenDie folgenden Punkte variieren je nach Standort ein wenig.- **Diagnose, Behandlung und Prävention:** Internisten befassen sich mit der Vorbeugung, Diagnose und konservativen (nicht-chirurgischen) Behandlung von Krankheiten der inneren Organe. Dazu gehören unter anderem Herz-Kreislauf-Erkrankungen, Diabetes, Erkrankungen der Atemwege (Lunge), Verdauungserkrankungen, Nierenleiden, hormonelle Störungen, rheumatische Erkrankungen, Infektionskrankheiten und Bluterkrankungen.- Patientenanamnese und körperliche Untersuchung:Sie erheben eine detaillierte Krankengeschichte (Anamnese) und führen umfassende körperliche Untersuchungen durch.- Anordnung und Interpretation von Untersuchungen:Sie entscheiden, welche Labor-, bildgebenden (z.B. Röntgen, Ultraschall) oder funktionellen Untersuchungen (z.B. EKG, Lungenfunktion) notwendig sind, ordnen diese an und interpretieren die Ergebnisse.- Erstellung von Behandlungsplänen:Basierend auf der Diagnose entwickeln sie individuelle Behandlungspläne, verschreiben Medikamente und überwachen den Therapieerfolg.- Betreuung chronischer Erkrankungen:Sie sind häufig die erste Anlaufstelle und betreuen Patienten mit chronischen Erkrankungen.- Beratung zu Krankheitsmanagement und Prävention:Sie beraten Patienten umfassend zum Umgang mit ihrer Krankheit, zu präventiven Maßnahmen und zur Gesundheitsförderung.- Koordination der Patientenversorgung:Sie arbeiten eng mit anderen Fachärzten (z.B. Chirurgen, Kardiologen, Rheumatologen) und anderen Gesundheitsberufen zusammen, um eine ganzheitliche und interdisziplinäre Betreuung zu gewährleisten. Sie überweisen Patienten an Spezialärzte, wenn spezielle Behandlungen erforderlich sind.- Notfallmedizinische Versorgung:In der Notfallversorgung überwachen und behandeln Sie Patienten mit akut bedrohlichen Zuständen.- Umfassende Betreuung:Sie kümmern sich um Patienten aller Altersstufen, wobei besonders in der Praxis ältere und multimorbide Patienten (Patienten mit mehreren chronischen Erkrankungen) häufig sind. Sie sind auch in der Palliativmedizin tätig, um Patienten mit nicht heilbaren Krankheiten zu betreuen.- Führungsverantwortung, Lehre und Forschung:Sie übernehmen auch Führungsaufgaben in Kliniken, engagieren sich in der Ausbildung des medizinischen Nachwuchses und sind an wissenschaftlicher Forschung beteiligt.Qualifikationen / Anforderungen- Facharzttitel für Allgemeine Innere Medizin (AIM) gerne mit Spezialisierung sowie erfüllte Voraussetzungen für die MEBEKO-Anerkennungen(EU-Facharzttitel, EU-Approbation und EU-Staatsbürgerschaft)- Berufserfahrung mindestens 2 Jahre- Freude an Teamarbeit, am Teaching von Kolleginnen/Kollegen in Weiterbildung und an konstruktiver, interdisziplinärer Zusammenarbeit- Eine offene, kommunikative Persönlichkeit mit einer patienten-, kunden- und mitarbeiterorientierten Grundhaltung und hohem Engagement- Erfahrung in einer angiologischen (Kader-)StellungQualifikation für die Durchführung von PTA von Vorteil- Interesse und Freude an interdisziplinärer Zusammenarbeit- Die MEBEKO-Anerkennungen müssen beim Bewerbungsbeginn nicht vorhanden sein, jedoch beim Stellenantritt. Bei der Einreichung der Unterlagen kann auf unsere Erfahrung zurückgegriffen werden.- Stilsicheres Deutsch, resp. title: Curator
description: About HELVETIKA 1575HELVETIKA 1575 AG is a contemporary art gallery based in Zug, with a new gallery space opening on Rennweg in Zurich. We represent a deliberately small and selective group of international artists – from established names to mid\-career and emerging positions – and work closely with collectors, foundations and museums.We are looking for a Curator who will shape our exhibition programme and strengthen the gallery's institutional profile.The role**Position:** Curator  **Location:** Zurich, Switzerland  **Workload:** 100%  **Start date:** by arrangement  **Reports to:** Management (Stephan Jöbstl, Katerina Maliakina)You are responsible for the artistic programme of the gallery: exhibitions, artist development and institutional relationships. You work hands\-on in a small team and turn ideas into finished exhibitions, publications and placements.Key responsibilities* Develop and realise the annual exhibition programme in Zurich, including solo shows, group exhibitions and art fair presentations* Build and maintain close working relationships with our artists, including studio visits, production of new works and exhibition planning* Scout new artists and prepare well\-founded proposals for onboarding (established, mid\-career and emerging)* Develop institutional placements and partnerships with museums, foundations, biennials and curators* Write and edit exhibition texts, artist biographies, CVs, press releases and catalogue content* Coordinate exhibition logistics: loans, transport, insurance, installation and condition reports, together with the team* Represent the gallery at openings, art fairs and professional events, and contribute to collector and press relations* Plan your work in clear blocks with measurable goals and report progress in the weekly team meetingQualifications* A completed university degree in Art History, Curatorial Studies, Fine Arts, Cultural Management or a related field – or equivalent professional experience* At least 3 years of curatorial experience in a gallery, museum, foundation or art institution* A track record of exhibitions you have curated or co\-curated* A solid network among artists, curators and institutions, ideally in Switzerland and the DACH region* Excellent writing skills in English; German is a strong advantage, French a plus* Strong organisational skills, reliability and the ability to work independently and proactively in a small team* Confident, professional presence with artists, collectors and institutional partners* Willingness to travel (art fairs, studio visits, international exhibitions)What we offer* Real creative responsibility for the programme of a growing gallery with a new space in Zurich* Direct collaboration with the founders and short decision paths* Work with internationally recognised artists and institutional partners* A competitive salary based on experienceHow to applyPlease apply online with your CV, a short cover letter and a selection of exhibitions or projects you have curated. We look forward to hearing from you.j4id10475537jm j4it1146jm j4iy26jm

Rund 700 Mitarbeitende aus 54 Nationen sorgen für exzellente Gastfreundschaft und bieten den perfekten Rahmen für Momente jenseits der Vorstellungskraft.    Drei exklusive Hotels, das Bürgenstock Hotel \& Alpine Spa (5\* Superior) mit den beiden Übernachtungsmöglichkeiten The Contemporary und The Heritage, das Waldhotel by Bürgenstock (5\* Superior) und die Taverne 1879 (3\*) stehen den Gästen zur Verfügung. Jedes dieser Häuser versteht es, eine einzigartige Atmosphäre zu kreieren. Sie verfügen über einen Ausbildung an einer Massageschule oder vergleichbare Zertifikate. Surface Treatment   *  Acting as a business partner to key stakeholders in business (Business Units, Engineering, etc.) and Operations (Product Line Supply Chain, Supplier Quality, Production, Materials Management, etc.)  *  The global category manager shall sustain the Global Strategic Sourcing Operating Model and provide the supply capability and capacity at best cost to support the company’s future business needs and protection of brand value  *  Application of aligned sourcing processes, sustainable supplier assessments and development approach, a performing and regulatory compliant supply base footprint shall be established and actively managed, contributing to the enhancement of the supply base performance on Quality, Delivery and Cost (QCD)  *  Realization of a measurable value &gt;3% in recurring and P&amp;L effective cost reductions per year across the global 3rd party spend in the assigned spend categories accompanied by a leveraged and benchmarked supply base management  *  Grow and further develop a qualified and performing Best Cost Country Supply Base in line with the companies and operations BCC objectives preferably in Eastern Europe and manage a sustainable spend allocationResponsibilities:  *  Management of own material categories (capacity, knowledge management, performance)                   *  Accountable for contributing to the global Direct Material &amp; Supply Base Performance (QCD)           *  Representing own direct material categories within the VAT organization                                *  Accountable for the category specific achievement of the objectives of cost optimization, supply base optimization, geographic sourcing footprint and Best Cost Country Sourcing                             *  Providing forward-looking guidance on trends, threats and opportunities in own categories (eg. raw materials etc.)                             *  Active contribution to the bottom up alignment of the Direct Materials Category Team with the defined / set company objectives                                   *  Interface to BU / Engineering for Strategic Sourcing activities along with the PDP (IP07) process     *  Act as a change agent in regards to main stakeholders  *  Perform the development of category sourcing strategies applying and complying with defined methods and tools  *  Active supplier relationship management of the global supply base within its own category perimeter in alignment with the category teams in Switzerland, Malaysia and Romania  *  Ensure consistent application of all Sourcing Levers  *  Contribution to main Sourcing KPIs  *  Assembles and actively leads category specific / cross-functional sourcing board  *  Actively monitors and performs a supply base risk assessment across its own categories  *  Participates in and contributes to continuous improvement of direct material practices  Qualifications:    *  5+ years in-depth strategic and operational sourcing experience with a solid working knowledge of global category management  *  Demonstrated work experience on category specific production techniques and processes  *  Knowledge about category sourcing markets  *  Office Software / IT application (esp. Excel, Word, Power Point etc.)  *  Sourcing in Eastern Europe, Asia and experience in Best Cost Country and spend relocation activities  *  Working experience within a global complex organization  *  Experience in the field of machine building, vacuum technology and semiconductors  *  Cross-function / category team management (min. functional)  *  Sensible and emphatic communication skills with suppliers, colleagues, internal stakeholders, etc.  *  Strong analytical skills (risk based) and focus on the essential facts  *  Able to get results through others, able to multi-task, sense of priority, able to handle stress levels  *  Good communication skills in German and English (any other language will be a plus)

title: Field Application Engineer
description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Field Application Engineer---Field Application Engineer==========================  **Are you ready to shape a brighter future?** Did you know that every second, an aircraft takes off somewhere in the world, and that 90% of them are equipped with a component produced in Fribourg? We are Hannifin, a global leader in motion and control technologies, with more than 58,000 team members across 44 countries. Our Business Unit in Fribourg, Switzerland, part of the Motion, Power, and Sensing division, is a technological and manufacturing center of excellence specializing in the development and production of measurement, control, and protection solutions for the aerospace and energy sectors. With around 400 employees, we design, qualify, and manufacture high\-performance sensors, electronic systems, and software monitoring solutions for critical and extreme environments. We are proud to work with passion, to enable engineering breakthrough and innovation. Joining Fribourg means contributing to high\-value international technology projects, growing in a collaborative and innovative environment, and developing your full professional and personal potential.  **Your responsibilities***       Perform on\-site installation, wiring verification, configuration, functional testing, commissioning, and troubleshooting of vibration monitoring systems, sensors, protection racks, and related software; resolve hardware, software, and industrial networking issues at customer sites.  *       Coordinate with customer site personnel to confirm requirements and site readiness, apply applicable safety standards and site rules, and prepare field service reports, troubleshooting summaries, and root\-cause analysis logs.  *       Translate rotating machinery and condition monitoring requirements into technical proposals, system architectures, feasibility studies, system sizing, and technical solutions using proprietary sensor and monitoring product lines.  *       Coordinate technical input between customers, sales teams, distributors, OEMs, and local R\&D/Product Management teams in Fribourg; deliver technical presentations and solution explanations.  *       Support sales teams, distributors, and OEMs during customer discussions, new projects, and retrofit or modernization opportunities, including management of technical inquiries through the Customer Service Desk or Salesforce in line with defined KPIs.  *       Support project engineering teams during project execution, technical clarifications, Pre\-FAT, and FAT activities, ensuring customer requirements are understood and implemented.  *       Deliver advanced technical training and prepare customer\-facing and internal documentation, including commissioning records, intervention reports, and technical summaries.  *       Support investigation, testing, validation, and internal simulation activities related to customer issues, product behavior, and application performance; provide structured field feedback to R\&D/Product Management.    **Who we are looking for***       Degree in Electrical, Mechanical, Microengineering, Automation, Systems, Mechatronics, or equivalent.  *       Minimum 5 years of experience in application engineering, field service, commissioning, troubleshooting, and customer support within an industrial environment.  *       Experience in the energy sector or other industrial environments is an asset (Aerospace, heavy machinery or equivalent).  *       Strong technical knowledge of vibration monitoring, condition monitoring, rotating machinery, sensors, protection racks, and related software. understanding of signal processing, vibration analysis, electronics, and industrial communication protocols such as Modbus, Profibus, Profinet, and OPC. Vibration Analyst Category 2 certification is considered a strong asset  *       Excellent communication and interpersonal skills  *       Strong customer\-focused approach, curious and hands\-on  *       Professional fluency in English; French and/or considered as a strong asset  *       Willingness to travel up to 30% of the time    **What we offer***       Solid employer on the market for over 100 years, we manage the full product lifecycle and support leading aerospace and energy companies worldwide  *       Career growth, opportunities and training: we hire from within!  *       Collaborative and empowered work environment where team spirit is at the center of our success.  *       Company values that encourage trust, respect, collaboration and professional growth.  *       Open environment: we are excited to hear your ideas!  *       Attractive compensation packages designed to hire and retain the best talents in the industry.  *       Company restaurant and other benefits    If you don’t find yourself in all points, apply anyways, because all competencies are valued! Have we sparked your interest? We look forward to getting to know you!  Please apply with your complete application documents directly online. If you are selected for a first interview, we will arrange a meeting on Teams. Some stages of the recruiting process will include professional situational exercises.   Please note that only selected candidates will be contacted for the next steps in the recruitment process.   *is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on grounds of age, race, religion, ethnic origin, gender, sexual orientation or disability in relation to recruitment and employment* .  *Hannifin EMEA Sàrl (“PHEMEA”), based in Etoy, Switzerland, is the Principal Operating Company for in the EMEA region. It is supported by a network of Manufacturing Divisions and Company Entities. The Aerospace Group EMEA is a strategic business Group within PHEMEA, and its Motion, Power, and Sensing Division is a key service provider to PHEMEA.* ![MEGGITT SA]()* Rte de Moncor 4 PO Box 1616 1701 Fribourg** ![MEGGITT SA]()* Rte de Moncor 4 PO Box 1616 1701 Fribourg**jideaa0d9ejm jit1146jm jiy26jm

title: Responsable des relevés et décomptes
description: Responsable des relevés et décomptes  Introduction  Nous donnons un avenir aux maisons. Nous le faisons avec des produits et services qui aident à réduire les émissions de CO2 des bâtiments. Pour ce faire, nous gérons des données et des processus permettant de rendre les propriétés plus écologiques, sûres et confortables. La base de nos produits et services est numérique. Nous veillons à faciliter la transition vers nos technologies durables pour tous. Ainsi, nous permettons à chaque personne de contribuer à la protection du climat.  Nous avons déjà déployé plus de 48 millions d'appareils connectés dans le monde et développons des solutions pour des bâtiments écoénergétiques et résilients. Nous employons plus de 6 600 personnes dans 21 pays et nos produits et services sont utilisés dans plus de 14 millions de logements et bâtiments commerciaux dans le monde, chez plus de 460 000 clients. En 2025, le groupe ista élargi a généré un chiffre d'affaires de 1'287 millions d'euros.  Pour renforcer notre équipe en Suisse, nous recherchons un·e Responsable des relevés et décomptes motivé·e et engagé·e.  Ce qui t'attend chez nous  En tant que Responsable du suivi administratif et de la gestion des consommations, tu joueras un rôle essentiel dans notre structure. Tes missions principales:  Calcul des consommations: Tu analyses les relevés de consommation et établis les décomptes individuels de chauffage et d’eau chaude destinés aux propriétaires, gérances et locataires.  Relation client: Tu es en contact direct avec nos clients et tu assures un accueil téléphonique de qualité.  Collaboration: Tu travailles de manière autonome tout en coordonnant avec les gérances et/ou les propriétaires.  Polyvalence: Tu prends part à d’autres tâches administratives selon les besoins.  Ce poste est fait pour toi si :  Tu es titulaire d’un CFC d’employé(e) de commerce.  Tu as plusieurs années d’expérience en comptabilité immobilière, notamment réalisation de décomptes de frais de chauffages et frais accessoires.  Tu es organisé(e), rigoureux(se) et autonome.  Tu aimes les chiffres et tu sais traiter les données avec précision.  Tu sais gérer une charge de travail importante sans compromettre la qualité.  Tu as le sens du service client.  Tu apprécies les contacts avec de nombreux interlocuteurs et gardes ton calme même lorsque les délais sont serrés.  Tu apprécies le travail en équipe.  Tu maîtrises les outils informatiques nécessaires dans un environnement numérique.  Tu parles aussi l’allemand au moins niveau B2 ? C’est un critère indispensable !  Tu parles aussi l’anglais ? C’est un atout !  Ce que nous t'offrons  De nombreuses opportunités et possibilités de faire bouger les choses activement et d'y contribuer.  Une activité variée, exigeante et autonome au sein d'une entreprise à envergure internationale.  Des conditions d'engagement attractives et des perspectives de développement à long terme.  De très bonnes offres pour ton perfectionnement personnel et professionnel.  Un environnement de travail performant et agréable au sein d'une équipe qui vise ensemble le succès.  Une organisation du travail flexible, adaptée à tes besoins.  Envie de nous rejoindre ?  Alors nous nous réjouissons de faire ta connaissance. Postule dès maintenant en ligne. jpid5eeeeb5jm jpit0937jm jpiy26jm

title: Chief Executive Officer (CEO) – Asset & Wealth Management (100%)
description: Chief Executive Officer (CEO) – Asset & Wealth Management (100%)Pfäffikon SZ, SwitzerlandAbout the Company:We are an internationally focused Swiss asset management company based in the Canton of Schwyz. As an asset manager within the meaning of the Swiss Financial Institutions Act (FinIA), we provide our clients with asset management, financial advisory and related financial services.We operate in an international environment and act both on our own account and on behalf of third parties. In doing so, we combine financial expertise with an entrepreneurial approach to identifying and developing investment opportunities.As we enter the next phase of our corporate development, we are seeking an accomplished and internationally experienced Chief Executive Officer (CEO) to lead the company, strengthen the existing business and drive strategic expansion into new markets and investment sectors, with a primary focus on Life Sciences (particularly artificial intelligence) and international markets – with an emphasis on the United Kingdom, Asia and Eastern Europe.Your Role:As CEO, you will have overall responsibility for the strategic, operational and commercial development of the company. Working closely with the Board of Directors, shareholders and other senior stakeholders, you will define and implement the corporate strategy and lead the continued development of the company as an internationally focused Swiss asset manager.You will combine strong leadership and investment expertise with entrepreneurial thinking, extensive transaction experience and a deep understanding of international financial markets.How You Will Contribute to Our Success:•    Assume overall responsibility for the strategic, operational and commercial management of the company and translate its long-term vision into measurable business objectives.•    Identify, assess and develop new markets, with a focus on the United Kingdom, Asia and Eastern Europe, as well as investment opportunities and strategic partnerships in the Life Sciences sector (particularly artificial intelligence).•    Drive fundraising initiatives and further expand the company’s international investor and business network, particularly in the United Kingdom, Asia and Eastern Europe, within the aforementioned financial sectors.•    Lead and oversee investment activities across asset and portfolio management, corporate finance, M&A, private equity and fundraising.•    Lead, develop and support the management team and employees, while establishing a culture of excellence, accountability, integrity and entrepreneurial thinking.Requirements:•    A university degree (Master) with excellent academic results from a top-tier university in Life Science Entrepreneurship.•    Strong industry knowledge and relevant professional experience in Life Sciences and AI, including the ability to assess companies, technologies, markets and investment opportunities in these sectors.•    Several years of international leadership experience in the financial sector, ideally in asset or wealth management, investment management, private equity, corporate finance, investment banking or a comparable environment.•    A proven track record in several of the following areas: corporate finance and financial analysis, M&A and transaction execution, fundraising, private equity, portfolio management and investment management, with a particular focus on Life Sciences (especially artificial intelligence).•    A demonstrated ability to identify and develop new markets and business opportunities and to translate strategic opportunities into sustainable commercial growth – preferably with leadership experience in Asia and the United Kingdom.•    Excellent communication, representation and negotiation skills, together with the ability to build trusted relationships with boards of directors, shareholders, investors, clients and other senior stakeholders.•    A high degree of integrity, discretion, resilience and sound judgement, including when handling confidential information and complex decisions.•    Languages: English and Russian.•    Willingness to be based in Switzerland for this role.What We Offer:•    A top-level executive position with overall responsibility for an internationally focused Swiss asset management company.•    The opportunity to play a significant role in shaping the company’s strategic direction and to lead it through its next phase of growth and international development.•    A central role in expanding the company’s activities in some of the most dynamic investment sectors, particularly Life Sciences (artificial intelligence).•    A high degree of responsibility and autonomy in developing new markets, investment opportunities and strategic partnerships in the aforementioned area, particularly in the United Kingdom, Asia and Eastern Europe.•    Close collaboration with the Board of Directors, shareholders, investors and senior stakeholders across the Swiss and international financial ecosystem.•    A professional, ethical and performanceoriented working environment that encourages initiative, accountability and long-term professional development.Interested?If you are an internationally experienced financial services executive with a strong investment and transaction background and the ambition to help shape the future of an entrepreneurial asset management company, we look forward to hearing from you.We look forward to receiving your application, including your CV and relevant supporting documents, by email to:Markus Marthalercontact@golden-hawk-invest.com

description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Sr. ICT Service Manager---Sr. ICT Service Manager=======================Rund 3000 Mitarbeitende von RUAG und RUAG Real Estate leisten jeden Tag einen wesentlichen Beitrag zur Sicherheit der Schweiz. Manager=======================100Emmen  **Das kannst du bewegen*** IT Service Management strategisch weiterentwickeln – ITSM\-Strategie, Governance und Prozesse gestalten und die Service\-Management\-Organisation kontinuierlich professionalisieren.* Service Portfolio verantworten – Business Services, Service\-Katalog, Budgetierung, Leistungsverrechnung und Provider\-Management aufbauen und weiterentwickeln.* End\-to\-End\-Servicequalität sicherstellen – Service\-Standards, SLAs und OLAs definieren, verhandeln und deren Einhaltung auf übergeordneter Ebene steuern.* Service weiterentwickeln und Wirtschaftlichkeit sowie Service Excellence sicherstellen.* Finanzielle Transparenz schaffen – Service\-Kostenmodelle entwickeln, Budgetierung professionalisieren und eine verursachergerechte Leistungsverrechnung etablieren.* Transformation und Continual Service Improvement vorantreiben – Management beraten, Optimierungspotenziale identifizieren und nachhaltige Veränderungen in der Serviceorganisation verankern.  **Das bringst du mit*** Abgeschlossenes Studium in (Wirtschafts\-)Informatik, gleichwertige Ausbildung oder vergleichbare Qualifikation mit langjähriger relevanter Berufserfahrung.* Mindestens 8 Jahre Berufserfahrung im IT Service Management, davon mehrere Jahre in einer Senior\-, Lead\- oder vergleichbaren verantwortungsvollen Funktion.* Nachweisbare Erfahrung im strategischen Aufbau, in der Transformation oder in der umfassenden Weiterentwicklung von IT\-Service\-Management\-Strukturen und \-Organisationen.* Sehr gute Kenntnisse in ITIL, idealerweise ITIL 4 Managing Professional oder vergleichbare Qualifikation.* Fundierte Erfahrung in Service Governance, Service Portfolio Management, Provider Management sowie der Gestaltung von SLA\-/OLA\-Strukturen.* Erfahrung in IT\-Sourcing, finanzieller Steuerung von IT\-Services, Budgetierung und Kostenmodellen.* Fundiertes technisches Verständnis moderner IT\-Infrastrukturen sowie Erfahrung mit ITSM\-Plattformen wie ServiceNow.* Sehr gute Deutsch\- und gute Englischkenntnisse, und ausgeprägte strategische und konzeptionelle Fähigkeiten, Durchsetzungsvermögen und Erfahrung im Stakeholder\- und Change\-Management. *Diese Position richtet sich an erfahrene IT Service Management Professionals, die ITSM\-Strukturen und Governance strategisch gestalten und weiterentwickeln. Eine rein operative Service\-Delivery\- oder Provider\-Management\-Funktion entspricht nicht dem Anforderungsprofil.*Erfüllst du nicht alle Voraussetzungen hundertprozentig? Bewirb dich trotzdem. Wir sind stets auf der Suche nach talentierten und motivierten Personen, die unser Team bereichern möchten. Wir legen grossen Wert auf Vielfalt und Chancengleichheit und unser Ziel ist es, ein vielfältiges Team aufzubauen, in dem alle ihre persönlichen Stärken voll entfalten können. Wir ermutigen insbesondere alle Personen, unabhängig von ihrem Geschlecht, die möglicherweise Bedenken haben, eine Stelle in einem armeenahen Umfeld anzunehmen, sich zu bewerben. **Über den Bereich**RUAG ICT Digital Transformation begleitet die RUAG auf dem Weg in die digitale Zukunft. Das erreichen wir durch ein tiefes Verständnis und Empathie für die Bedürfnisse unserer Kunden sowie durch gemeinsames Gestalten und aktives Mitwirken im Team – als ICT Service Manager. **Deine Vorteile**  **Lohn und Nebenleistungen**Wir bieten dir ein leistungsorientiertes\- und marktgerechtes Salär, 13 Monatslöhne sowie grosszügige Prämien\- und Zulagen. Zusammen mit weiteren Nebenleistungen ergibt sich daraus ein attraktives Gesamtpaket.Wir legen grossen Wert darauf, dass unsere Mitarbeitenden ein gesundes Gleichgewicht zwischen Beruf und Privatleben finden. Darum bieten wir unter anderem flexible Arbeitszeiten und Homeoffice\-Optionen an.  **Flexibles Arbeiten**  **Vergünstigungen**Bei RUAG profitierst du von Vergünstigungen in den Bereichen Mobilität und Verpflegung. description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Field Application Engineer---Field Application Engineer==========================  **Are you ready to shape a brighter future?** Did you know that every second, an aircraft takes off somewhere in the world, and that 90% of them are equipped with a component produced in Fribourg? We are Hannifin, a global leader in motion and control technologies, with more than 58,000 team members across 44 countries. Our Business Unit in Fribourg, Switzerland, part of the Motion, Power, and Sensing division, is a technological and manufacturing center of excellence specializing in the development and production of measurement, control, and protection solutions for the aerospace and energy sectors. With around 400 employees, we design, qualify, and manufacture high\-performance sensors, electronic systems, and software monitoring solutions for critical and extreme environments. We are proud to work with passion, to enable engineering breakthrough and innovation. Joining Fribourg means contributing to high\-value international technology projects, growing in a collaborative and innovative environment, and developing your full professional and personal potential.  **Your responsibilities***       Perform on\-site installation, wiring verification, configuration, functional testing, commissioning, and troubleshooting of vibration monitoring systems, sensors, protection racks, and related software; resolve hardware, software, and industrial networking issues at customer sites.  *       Coordinate with customer site personnel to confirm requirements and site readiness, apply applicable safety standards and site rules, and prepare field service reports, troubleshooting summaries, and root\-cause analysis logs.  *       Translate rotating machinery and condition monitoring requirements into technical proposals, system architectures, feasibility studies, system sizing, and technical solutions using proprietary sensor and monitoring product lines.  *       Coordinate technical input between customers, sales teams, distributors, OEMs, and local R\&D/Product Management teams in Fribourg; deliver technical presentations and solution explanations.  *       Support sales teams, distributors, and OEMs during customer discussions, new projects, and retrofit or modernization opportunities, including management of technical inquiries through the Customer Service Desk or Salesforce in line with defined KPIs.  *       Support project engineering teams during project execution, technical clarifications, Pre\-FAT, and FAT activities, ensuring customer requirements are understood and implemented.  *       Deliver advanced technical training and prepare customer\-facing and internal documentation, including commissioning records, intervention reports, and technical summaries.  *       Support investigation, testing, validation, and internal simulation activities related to customer issues, product behavior, and application performance; provide structured field feedback to R\&D/Product Management.    **Who we are looking for***       Degree in Electrical, Mechanical, Microengineering, Automation, Systems, Mechatronics, or equivalent.  *       Minimum 5 years of experience in application engineering, field service, commissioning, troubleshooting, and customer support within an industrial environment.  *       Experience in the energy sector or other industrial environments is an asset (Aerospace, heavy machinery or equivalent).  *       Strong technical knowledge of vibration monitoring, condition monitoring, rotating machinery, sensors, protection racks, and related software. understanding of signal processing, vibration analysis, electronics, and industrial communication protocols such as Modbus, Profibus, Profinet, and OPC. Vibration Analyst Category 2 certification is considered a strong asset  *       Excellent communication and interpersonal skills  *       Strong customer\-focused approach, curious and hands\-on  *       Professional fluency in English; French and/or considered as a strong asset  *       Willingness to travel up to 30% of the time    **What we offer***       Solid employer on the market for over 100 years, we manage the full product lifecycle and support leading aerospace and energy companies worldwide  *       Career growth, opportunities and training: we hire from within!  *       Collaborative and empowered work environment where team spirit is at the center of our success.  *       Company values that encourage trust, respect, collaboration and professional growth.  *       Open environment: we are excited to hear your ideas!  *       Attractive compensation packages designed to hire and retain the best talents in the industry.  *       Company restaurant and other benefits    If you don’t find yourself in all points, apply anyways, because all competencies are valued! Have we sparked your interest? We look forward to getting to know you!  Please apply with your complete application documents directly online. If you are selected for a first interview, we will arrange a meeting on Teams. Some stages of the recruiting process will include professional situational exercises.   Please note that only selected candidates will be contacted for the next steps in the recruitment process.   *is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on grounds of age, race, religion, ethnic origin, gender, sexual orientation or disability in relation to recruitment and employment* .  *Hannifin EMEA Sàrl (“PHEMEA”), based in Etoy, Switzerland, is the Principal Operating Company for in the EMEA region. title: Business Development Director
description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Business Development Director--- Business Development Director=============================**Entdecke deine nächste Karrierechance bei einem der größten Logistikdienstleister der Welt. Stelle dir die Vielzahl an Möglichkeiten vor, etwas zu bewegen und werde Teil eines großartigen Teams aus ganz unterschiedlichen Kulturen. Bei uns arbeitest du mit talentierten Kolleginnen und Kollegen, die dir dabei helfen, jeden Tag über dich hinauszuwachsen. Wir wissen, was nötig ist, um UPS in die Zukunft zu führen: Menschen mit einer einzigartigen Kombination aus Können und Leidenschaft. Wenn du die Eigenschaften und die Motivation besitzt, dich selbst oder dein Team zu führen, findest du bei uns den , der zu dir passt. Bei UPS erhältst du die Möglichkeit, deine Fähigkeiten unter Beweis zu stellen und deine Karriere auf ein neues Level zu bringen.** **Tätigkeitsbeschreibung:** Marken, UPS Healthcare Precision Logistics (formerly Marken, MNX \& Polar Speed), the clinical and advanced therapy subsidiary of UPS Healthcare, unites expertise across healthcare and complex secure logistics to drive the success of our clients through innovation.  **Purpose:**A Business Development Director works to improve an organization’s market position and achieve financial growth. This person defines long\-term organizational strategic goals, builds key customer relationships, identifies business opportunities, negotiates and closes business deals and maintains extensive knowledge of current market conditions. Business Development Directors work in a senior sales position within the company. It is their job to work with their internal team, marketing staff, and other Directors and Managers to increase sales opportunities and thereby maximize revenue for Marken. To achieve this, they need to find potential new customers, present to them, ultimately convert them into clients, and continue to grow business in the future. The Business Development Director will also help manage existing clients and ensure they stay satisfied and positive. They call on clients, often being required to make presentations on solutions and services that meet or predict their clients’ future needs. **Main Duties and Responsibilities:**The primary role of the Business Development Director is to prospect for new clients by networking, cold calling, advertising or other means of generating interest from potential clients. They must then plan persuasive approaches and pitches that will convince potential clients to do business with the company. They must develop a rapport with new clients, and set targets for sales and provide support that will continually improve the relationship. They are also required to grow and retain existing accounts by presenting new solutions and services to clients. Business Development Directors work with mid and senior level management, marketing, and technical staff. He/she may manage the activities of others responsible for developing business for the company. Strategic planning is a key part of this job description, since it is the business manager’s responsibility to develop the pipeline of new business coming in to the company. This requires a thorough knowledge of the market, the solutions/services the company can provide, and of the company’s competitors. While the exact responsibilities will vary the main duties of the Business Development Director can be summarized as follows: **New Business Development*** Prospect for potential new clients and turn this into increased business.* Cold call as appropriate within your market or geographic area to ensure a robust pipeline of opportunities.* Meet potential clients by growing, maintaining, and leveraging your network.* Identify potential clients, and the decision makers within the client organization.* Research and build relationships with new clients.* Set up meetings between client decision makers and company’s practice leaders/Principals.* Plan approaches and pitches.* Work with team to develop proposals that speaks to the client’s needs, concerns, and objectives.* Participate in pricing the solution/service.* Handle objections by clarifying, emphasizing agreements and working through differences to a positive conclusion.* Use a variety of styles to persuade or negotiate appropriately.* Present an image that mirrors that of the client **Client Retention*** Present new products and services and enhance existing relationships.* Work with technical staff and other internal colleagues to meet customer needs. Arrange and participate in internal and external client debriefs. **Business Development Planning*** Attend industry functions, such as association events and conferences, and provide feedback and information on market and creative trends.* Present to and consult with mid and senior level management on business trends with a view to developing new services, products, and distribution channels.* Identify opportunities for campaigns, services, and distribution channels that will lead to an increase in sales.* Using knowledge of the market and competitors, identify and develop the company’s unique selling propositions and differentiators. **Management and Research*** Ensure that data is accurately entered and managed within SalesForce.* Track and record activity on accounts and help to close deals to meet these targets.* Research and develop a thorough understanding of the company’s people and capabilities.* Understand the company’s goal and purpose so that will continual to enhance the company’s performance. **Requirements: Education*** Bachelor’s degree* Minimum 5\-7 years of sales or marketing experience.  **der Anstellung:** Unbefristet UPS hat sich verpflichtet, einen Arbeitsplatz zu schaffen, der frei von Diskriminierung, Belästigung und Vergeltungsmaßnahmen ist.![UPS United Parcel Service (Schweiz) AG]()* UPS United Parcel Service (Schweiz) AG  Binningerstrasse 2, Spenglerpark  4142 Münchenstein*jid09b6c45jm jit1146jm jiy26jm

Look forward to working together with some of the largest organisations in Switzerland and across the world to introduce the change that will create real impact for their business.**Life at Deloitte**At Deloitte, your ideas create impact and spark meaningful change for our clients, people and society. description: --- base: meta-keywords: meta-viewport: width=device-width, title: Basketball for Good Intern --- Basketball for Good Intern ========================== FIBA, with global headquarters in Mies, Switzerland, is the world governing body of basketball and an independent association formed by 212 National Basketball Federations throughout the world. Our mission is to develop and promote the game of basketball, uniting the wider basketball community, which counts more than 450 million players and fans. The FIBA Foundation is the social and legacy arm of FIBA that addresses the role of sport, and particularly basketball, in society while preserving and promoting basketball's values and cultural heritage. Through our Basketball For Good initiatives, we support projects and social entrepreneurs around the world who use basketball to create positive change in their communities. To support the continued growth of our programs, we are looking for an enthusiastic and motivated intern to join our team for a period of six months. The internship offers a unique opportunity to gain practical experience in project administration, grant\\-making, storytelling and sport for development within a dynamic and multicultural environment. Working closely with the Senior Project Associate, you will provide hands\\-on operational support for Propose a Project, FIBA Open and the wider Basketball For Good portfolio, including community engagement and storytelling activities with the specific responsibilities outlined below: \*\*Propose a Project\*\* \* Coordinate the administrative process for Propose a Project applications, including application tracking, completeness checks and applicant follow\\-up. \* Support the review and evaluation of applications by preparing assessment materials, consolidating reviewer input, and maintaining accurate selection records. \* Coordinate approved project support, including the allocation and follow\\-up of financial and Value\\-in\\-Kind support such as Molten basketballs and PEAK equipment. \*\*FIBA Open\*\* \* Support team registration and maintain accurate participant and competition information. \* Coordinate volunteer recruitment, registration, scheduling, briefing, and on\\-site support. \* Assist with event logistics, participant communication, and the operational delivery of FIBA Open. \*\*Basketball For Good Portfolio Support\*\* \* Support the coordination and administration of Basketball For Good activities across the portfolio, including maintaining trackers, preparing working documents and following up on agreed actions. \* Support Basketball For Good communications and storytelling by coordinating project updates, participant stories, photos and other content from programs and partners. \* Support fundraising and partnership activities, including preparing donor and grant reporting materials, maintaining grant trackers through the CRM platform, and assisting with data collection. The earliest engagement date is the 1st of February 2027\\. Please apply exclusively on with your CV along with a cover letter. We will only respond to profiles corresponding to the demands of the position. \*\*Required Profile:\*\* \* University degree or ongoing studies in sport management, international relations, project management, communications, event management or a related field \* Team player, basketball background, and/or experience in sport for development \* Great written and verbal communication skills, with an interest in storytelling and stakeholder engagement \* Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint; confidence working with trackers, registration data and shared files \* Well organized, detail oriented, proactive and comfortable managing several operational workstreams in an intercultural environment \* Proficiency in English and French; Spanish is an asset !\[Fédération Internationale de Basketball (FIBA)\]( ) \* Fédération Internationale de Basketball (FIBA) Chemin de la FIBA 1 1295 Mies \* \[ \](\< \>) jpidd39f256jm jpit1146jm jpiy26jm

title: Content & Product Specialist
description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Content &amp; Product Specialist---Content \& Product Specialist=============================  ***Dear applicants, you have an assignment to complete at the bottom of this job add.***  ***Applications will not be considered if not complete.*** Definition of function and missionClinique La Prairie is a science\-based longevity company. Its value comes from turning medical innovation into programmes that people can understand, trust and book. As Product Content \& Education Specialist, you will know that science and that offer better than anyone outside the medical team. You will turn them into the content every team uses to explain the offer, sell it and prove it.This is a hands\-on expert role, built on writing and product knowledge. You write most of what you deliver yourself: brochures, web and sales copy, scripts, training content and briefs. Your value comes from how deeply you know the product and how well you write.The role sits in Strategic \& Product Marketing and reports to the Head of Strategic \& Product Marketing. On one side are Innovation and Medical; on the other are , Digital, PR, APAC and the properties. Product creates the content and those teams use it. Your work covers the whole guest journey, from the first video a prospect sees to the brochure a sales advisor sends and the e\-learning module a new team member completes.In 2027, CLP's priority is to own scientific and medical excellence in longevity. No competitor holds this ground yet, and CLP's programmes and doctors already earn it. Most of the evidence exists inside the company but has not yet been made public. Your mission is to publish it accurately, in the brand's voice, across every destination.The role succeeds when:* Every destination presents the offer the same way, using the latest version.  * Each programme or offer update reaches every material quickly and without errors.  * Public content relies more on science, in line with the 2027 mix for Longevity Talks: 40% science, 30% performance, 30% personalities.  * The content supports the 2027 KPIs: programmes sold and average price in Montreux, content performance, and CLP's share of AI answers on scientific and medical excellence.   ResponsibilitiesA. Product Expertise \& Innovation\-to\-Market *Purpose: be the marketing team's reference on what CLP offers and why it works, and make sure every innovation reaches the market accurately.** Master the full portfolio, by destination (Montreux, Health Resorts, Longevity Hubs): every programme, protocol, pillar, diagnostic and treatment, plus the CLP Method and the science behind it.  * Build and maintain the Product Knowledge Base, with one source of truth per programme: content, duration, price structure, inclusions, approved claims, medical references and differences by destination.  * Build and maintain, with Medical, a library of evidence that can be made public: studies, the scientific committee, doctor profiles, results and data.  * Be marketing's day\-to\-day contact for Innovation and Medical on product content. Follow the innovation pipeline, attend product reviews and learn about changes before they launch.  * Check scientific accuracy and claims with Medical, and with Legal where needed, before any content is published.  * For each programme or offer change, list every affected asset (brochures, toolkit, e\-learning, website, guest communications) and track it until all are updated.  * Write the launch package for each new programme or update: key messages, sales narrative, FAQs and internal briefing.  * Answer product questions from , Digital, PR, Regional teams and the properties.  * Provide verified product and scientific content for the website and its knowledge base.   B. Offer \& Content ( \& Marketing Enabling Toolkit) *Purpose: give and every property the tools to present one standard offer and to hold a consultative, client\-led conversation.** Write and maintain the content of the \& Marketing Enabling Toolkit, covering Global , Health Resorts, Longevity Hubs and internal enablement. Keep its SharePoint structure and version control up to date.  * Write and update brochures, one\-pagers, commercial fact sheets and programme summaries, all built on one standard offer across Resorts and Hubs.  * Write pre\-booking templates, welcome communications and guest preparation materials.  * Prepare the content package for new openings, such as the upcoming Longevity Hub in New York  * Send each update to the markets with a short note on what changed, and withdraw outdated versions.   C. Scientific \& Content for the Funnel *Purpose: turn CLP's science, doctors and guest stories into content that Digital, PR, and regional teams can use at each stage of the funnel.** Write storylines, scripts and briefs for video shoots with doctors and experts, so that medical expertise becomes clear and engaging content.  * Develop topics, storylines and briefs for Longevity Talks and Guest Testimonials, with science at the centre of the mix.  * Create content for each stage of the funnel, from awareness to consideration and conversion, and adapt it to CLP's customer personas (Achiever, Optimiser, Purist), including their motivations, expectations and preferred formats.  * Write the content for educational formats aimed at prospects, such as webinars, and prepare the experts who present them.  * Provide scientific and product content for digital channels such as the website, newsletter and social media, which the Digital team then publishes. The scope may later extend to newsletter strategy.  * Write background content on programmes, experts and CLP's scientific credentials to support PR.  * Brief regional adaptations so that each market has relevant proof, voices and language versions.  * Give product and scientific input to brand campaigns and video productions.   D. Internal Education \& Enablement *Purpose: make sure everyone who speaks for CLP understands the offer, the science and the brand, and can explain them with confidence.** Write the annual brand and product education agenda.  * Lead the e\-learning project end to end: write the scripts for the quarterly modules, organise and brief the video shoots, and coordinate the launch with HR, building on the three chapters already delivered.  * Write and present product training for and property teams at each launch and opening.  * Write onboarding materials and internal fact sheets for new and existing teams.  * Propose a simple way to check product knowledge after each module, such as a short quiz or certification.   Profile requirementsEducation \& experience* A degree in communication, journalism, literature or marketing. A background in life sciences, health or nutrition is a strong plus. A science degree combined with a proven copywriting record will also be considered.  * 3 to 5 years as a copywriter, content writer, editor or journalist, ideally for scientific, medical, health, beauty or luxury brands (for example pharma, medtech, dermo\-cosmetics, medical wellness or luxury hospitality).  * A writing portfolio is required. It should show premium brand copy and complex science explained for non\-specialists. Shortlisted candidates complete a writing test.  * Fluent English (written to publication standard) and French. , Italian, Spanish or Mandarin is a plus.   Skills \& competenciesCopywriting and editorial (the core of the role)* An outstanding copywriter in English, writing to publication standard: headlines, brochure and web copy, sales copy, video and webinar scripts, social captions and newsletter content.  * Writes long\-form content (brochures, dossiers, e\-learning) and short\-form content (one\-pagers, captions, hooks) with the same precision.  * Turns complex medical and scientific information into clear, accurate and compelling copy, without overclaiming.  * Adapts tone for guests, sales advisors, partners, press and internal teams, and keeps the CLP brand voice consistent across every destination.  * Edits and proofreads rigorously, both their own copy and other people's.  * Has a strong visual eye for photography, video and layout, in line with CLP's luxury and scientific identity.   Product and scientific mastery* Able to read a clinical study or scientific paper and explain it accurately in plain language.  * Understands longevity, diagnostics, biomarkers and cellular health, and knows the difference between evidence, claims and marketing language.  * Learns a complex portfolio quickly and keeps the details precise.  * Asks the questions that doctors and Innovation need to answer before content is published.   Organisation and ownership* Owns recurring content cycles and completes updates without senior follow\-up.  * Keeps many documents, versions and deadlines moving at the same time, with strict version control.   Collaboration* Works easily with doctors, scientists, Innovation, Operations, , PR, Creative, Digital and local teams, across cultures.  * Proactive, autonomous and solution\-oriented.   Tools* Strong PowerPoint ,Word, and Excel skills; Indesign and other graphic tools are a plus.  * Comfortable with SharePoint libraries and structured content systems.   APPLICATION ASSIGNEMENT TO BE ADDED WITH YOUR CV: * Time: around 3 hours.  * Language: English.  * Format: one Word or PDF document, with each piece clearly titled.  * Sources: use credible public sources, such as scientific studies, medical societies and recognised market research. Name the source of every figure or study you use.  * Judgement: you may define what the programme includes, based on what you know of CLP's approach: a medical assessment and our four pill

description: **Senior Operations \& NPI Engineer – New Product Introduction****Shape the Future of Mechanical Circulatory Support**Join **Abbott's Heart Failure** business and play a key role in bringing the next generation of **Circulatory Support Systems** from development into global manufacturing.As a **Senior Operations \& NPI Engineer,** you will lead the industrialization, validation, and manufacturing scale\-up of complex electromechanical medical devices that directly support critically ill cardiac patients. This is a highly visible role with the opportunity to influence product design, manufacturing strategy, supplier readiness, and production ramp\-up from early development through commercial launch.A unique aspect of this position is the close collaboration between our teams in Zurich, Switzerland and Pleasanton, California. Working as part of a highly integrated global organization, you will partner with experts across R\&D, Quality, Regulatory, Operations, and Supplier Engineering to bring innovative technologies to market.If you enjoy solving complex technical challenges, working hands\-on with manufacturing processes, and turning innovative concepts into scalable products that improve patients' lives, we'd love to hear from you.**What You'll Do*** Lead the transfer of new products from R\&D into manufacturing, ensuring a smooth transition from prototype and low\-volume production to scalable serial production.* Develop and implement manufacturing processes, production workflows, work instructions, and manufacturing documentation for new products.* Define manufacturing requirements and provide Design for Manufacturing (DfM), Design for Assembly (DfA), and Design for Test (DfT) feedback to R\&D throughout the product development lifecycle.* Design, develop, qualify, and release production test systems, measurement equipment, fixtures, and tools required for manufacturing.* Establish manufacturing routings, Bills of Materials (BOMs), production versions, and associated master data within SAP.* Coordinate product industrialization activities with R\&D, Project/Program Management, Supply Chain, Quality, Manufacturing, Procurement, and external suppliers.* Define process validation and product qualification strategies, including IQ/OQ/PQ activities where applicable.* Analyze manufacturing data using statistical methods to assess process capability, yield, throughput,
